items.english: The letters आ, ऐ and  औ are called 'वृद्धि'.
The letters अ, ए and ओ are called 'गुण'.
If the words गुण or वृद्धि are used to denote the operation of  गुणादेश or वृद्धि-आदेश without specifying where such an आदेश happens, then this आदेश should be done in place of the 'इक्' letter.
If a part of धातु gets removed due to an आर्धधातुक प्रत्यय, then that प्रत्यय cannot cause any  गुण or वृद्धि on the इक् letter of the remaining part of that धातु.
In presence of a कित्,  गित् or a ङित् प्रत्यय, any गुण or वृद्धि that might happen on an इक्-letter of an अङ्ग is prohibited.
The इक् letter of - (a) the verb दीधीङ्,  (b) The verb वेवीङ् , and (c) इडागम - do not undergo a गुण or a वृद्धि.
Group of two or more  व्यञ्जनानि pronounced together without any स्वर or a pause between them is referred as संयोग.
A letter whose pronunciation needs the usage of nose as well as mouth is called an अनुनासिक.
Two letters are called सवर्ण of each other if their mouth-based location of pronunciation and their आभ्यन्तरप्रयत्न are same as of each other.
A स्वर and a व्यञ्जन cannot be सवर्ण of each other.
दीर्घ-ईकारान्त, दीर्घ-ऊकारान्त and एकारान्त forms of द्विवचन are known as 'प्रगृह्य'.
The forms of the अदस् word which end in मी / मू / मे are known as 'प्रगृह्य'.
'शे' is called प्रगृह्य.
Except for the word आङ्, all other निपाताः that contain only one स्वर (and no व्यञ्जन) are known as प्रगृह्य.
All ओकारान्त निपातs are known as प्रगृह्य.

items.anvaya: शाकल्यस्य (मतेन) सम्बुद्धौ ओत् अनार्षे इतौ प्रगृह्यम्
items.english: According to Shakalya, the ओकार at end of the सम्बोधन-एकवचन form, when followed by the word 'इति' in a non vedic context, gets the term प्रगृह्य.
According to Shakalya, the निपात 'उञ्', when followed by the word 'इति' in a non vedic context, gets the term 'प्रगृह्य'.
An  ईकारान्त and an ऊकारान्त word that represents the meaning of सप्तमी gets the term 'प्रगृह्य'.
Except for the verbs दाप् and दैप्, all other verbs that are referred to as 'दारूपाः' or 'धारूपाः' are known as 'घु'.
If a word has a single letter, it acts as the first letter, and it also acts as the last letter.
The तरप् प्रत्यय and the तमप् प्रत्यय are known as 'घ'
The words बहु and गण, and the words ending in the वतुँप् and डति प्रत्यय are known as 'संख्या'.
The षकारान्त and the नकारान्त words which are referred to as 'संख्या' are also called 'षट्'.
The word ending in the डति प्रत्यय which is referred to as 'संख्या' is also called 'षट्'.
The 'क्त' and 'क्तवतु' pratyayas are called 'निष्ठा'.
The words belonging to the सर्वादिगण are called सर्वनाम.
The words of सर्वादिगण in a दिशावाची बहुव्रीहि समास are optionally considered सर्वनाम.
The words of सर्वादिगण, when used to create a बहुव्रीहिसमास are not called सर्वनाम.
The words of the सर्वादिगण participating in a तृतीयासमास are not called सर्वनाम.
The words formed by the द्वन्द्व समास of the words of सर्वादिगण are not called सर्वनाम.
The words formed by the द्वन्द्व समास of the words of सर्वादिगण are optionally called सर्वनाम when they get the 'जस्' pratyay.
The words - प्रथम, चरम, अल्प, अर्ध, कतिपय, and नेम ; and also the words ending in the 'तयप्' प्रत्यय are optionally called सर्वनाम when they get the 'जस्' प्रत्यय.
The words 'पूर्व', 'पर', 'अवर', 'दक्षिण', 'उत्तर', 'अपर' and 'अधर'; when used in the sense of 'limit' but not as a proper noun; are optionally called सर्वनाम when followed by the जस् प्रत्यय.
The word 'स्व', when used in a meaning different than 'relatives' and 'money'  is optionally called सर्वनाम when followed by the जस् प्रत्यय.
The word  'अन्तर', when used in the meaning of 'outside a certain place' or 'undergarment', is optionally called 'सर्वनाम' when followed by the 'जस्' प्रत्यय.
The words of the स्वरादिगण and the words which are called 'निपात' are all also known as 'अव्यय'.
A तद्धितान्त word to which all the विभक्तिप्रत्ययाः cannot be attached is known as 'अव्यय'.
A word that ends in - (a) a मकारान्त कृत्-प्रत्यय,  or (b) a कृत्-प्रत्यय that ends in the एच् letter - is known as 'अव्यय'.
The words ending in क्त्वा, तोसुन् and कसुन् प्रत्यय are known as 'अव्यय'.
The word formed using an अव्ययीभाव समास are known as अव्यय.
'शि' is also called 'सर्वनामस्थान'.
The सुँ, औ, जस्, अम्, and औट् प्रत्ययाः attached to a non-नपुंसकलिङ्ग word are called 'सर्वनामस्थान'.
The word विभाषा is used to indicate the meaning of 'optional negation' and 'optional application'.
An 'इक्' letter that comes as a replacement for a 'यण्' letter is known as सम्प्रसारण.
A टित्-आगम is attached before its substrate, and a कित्-आगम comes after its substrate.
A मित्-आगम is attached after the last स्वर of its substrate.
When an 'एच्' letter undergoes a हस्वादेश, it is replaced by an 'इक्' letter.
When the षष्ठी विभक्ति occurring in a sutra does not indicate a clear relationship,  it is considered to indicate the स्थानी.
Out of multiple आदेशाः possible in a place, the one that is closest in properties gets selected.
Any अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ letter appearing as an आदेश in place of a ऋकार/ऌकार is always followed by the letter र्/ल् respectively.
आदेश told in a sutra happens in the place of the last letter of the स्थानी.
A ङित्-आदेश happens to the last letter of the  स्थानी.
The आदेश told on the latter word of a given निमित्त happens on its first letter.
An आदेश which either has more than one letters, or is शित् - replaces the entire स्थानी.
An आदेश acts like a स्थानी in the context of the operations that are not associated with a single letter.

An आदेश done in place of an अच् letter due to the परनिमित्त acts like the स्थानी even in the context of कार्याणि that are associated with a single letter; as long as the कार्याणि are on an entity prior to the location of the स्थानी.

An आदेश done in place of an अच् letter due to the परनिमित्त never acts like a स्थानी; even for the single-letter-कार्याणि done on an entity prior to the location of the स्थानी; in the context of -  (1) पदान्तकार्य  (2) द्वित्वकार्य  (3) 'वरच्' प्रत्ययकार्य (4) यकारलोप  (5) स्वरविधि (6) सवर्णकार्य (7) अनुस्वारविधि (8) दीर्घादेशकार्य (9) जश्त्वकार्य and (10) चर्त्वकार्य.

items.anvaya: अचः आदेशः परस्मिन् अचि द्विर्वचने पूर्वविधौ स्थानिवत्
items.english: An आदेश done in place of an अच् letter acts like a स्थानी for the द्वित्वकार्य, provided that such a द्वित्वकार्य is caused by an अजादि षनिमित्त.
non-appearance of a letter or a group of letters is called लोप.
The elision of a प्रत्यय done using the specific words लुक्, श्लु and लुप् is respectively known by the terms लुक्, श्लु, लुप्.
The कार्य associated with a प्रत्यय happens even when the प्रत्यय undergoes a लोप.
A प्रत्यय that has been removed लुक् , श्लु or लुप् does not cause any अङ्गकार्यम्.
The fragment of a word starting from its last अच् letter till the end is called टि.
The second-last letter of a word is called उपधा.
The words in the सप्तमी विभक्ति are used to indicate that the कार्य happens on an immediately previous entity.
The words in the पञ्चमी विभक्ति are used to indicate that the कार्य happens on an immediately next entity.

The words used in the rules of the grammar represent the verbatim sequence of the letters (and not their underlying meaning); except for the technical terms which represent the meaning rather than the verbatim sequence of the letters.
An अण् letter which does not represent an आदेश, and an उदित letter (one of कु, चु, टु, तु, पु) used in a sutra represent all the सवर्ण forms.
A letter that follows or is followed by 'त्' represents only those सवर्णाः which require the same time for pronunciation as that letter.

items.anvaya: अन्त्येन इता सह आदिः स्वस्य रूपस्य
items.english: A beginning letter, when combined with an ending इत् letter, stands for itself and for all the letters in between.
A विधि mentioned using an adjective happens in the context of that adjective, and also in context of the words which end in that adjective.
A word whose first स्वर is वृद्धि is called 'वृद्ध'.
The words of the त्यदादिगण are called  'वृद्ध'.

The non-ञित् and non-णित्  प्रत्ययाः attached to the - (1) the 'गाङ्' आदेश (that happens to the धातु 'इङ् अध्ययने'), and (2) the verbs of the कुटादिगण (an अन्तर्गण of तुदादिगण) - behave as if they are ङित्.
A प्रत्यय that gets an इडागम is considered ङित् when attached to the dhatu 'विज्'.
After the verb ऊर्ण 'to cover', the affix beginning with the augment इट् is regarded optionally like ङित्।
An अपित् सार्वधातुकप्रत्ययः behaves like a ङित् प्रत्यय.
For a verb root that does not end in a संयोग, the अपित् प्रत्यय of  लिट्-लकार behaves like a कित् प्रत्यय.
The लिट् (Perfect Tense) affixes after the roots इन्धि 'to kindle' and भू 'to become' are also कित्।
The affix क्त्वा is कित् after मृड् 'to be gracious', मृद् 'to squeeze', गुध् 'to wrap up', कुष् 'to tear', क्लिश् 'to suffer', वद् 'to speak' and वस् 'to dwell'.
The affixes क्त्वा and सन् [[3.1.7]] are कित् after रुद् 'to weep', विद् 'to know', मुष् 'to steal', गृह् 'to seize', स्वप् 'to sleep' and प्रच्छ् 'to ask'.
The affix सन् beginning with a letter of the प्रत्यहार झल् is like कित् after the verbs ending in इक् vowels.
And after a root ending in a consonant and preceded by a vowel of the प्रत्यहार इक् , the affix सन् beginning with a झल् consonant, is like कित् ।

After roots ending in a consonant, that adjoins a vowel of इक् प्रत्यहार , the substitutes of the -- विधिनिमन्त्रणामन्त्रण अधीष्टसम्प्रश्नप्रार्थनेषु लिङ् [[3.3.161]] and सिच् -- च्लेः सिच् [[3.1.44]], when they begin with a consonant of झल् प्रत्यहार , are कित् when the आत्मनेपद affixes follow.
And after the verbs ending in ऋ , the substitutes of लिङ् and the affix सिच् , are कित् , when they begin with झल् and the आत्मनेपद affixes follow.
Optionally after the verb गम् , the लिङ् and the सिच् beginning with झल् consonants, in the आत्मनेपद , are कित्।
The सिच् आत्मनेपद affixes are कित् after the root हन् 'to kill'.
The affix सिच् before आत्मनेपद affixes is कित् after the verb यम् when meaning 'to divulge'.
The affix सिच् before आत्मनेपद affixes is कित् optionally when यम् means 'to expose'.
The affix सिच् before आत्मनेपद affixes is कित् after स्था 'to stand' and घु मृषस्तितिक्षायाम् [[1.2.20]] verbs, and these verbs change their आ into इ before these terminations.
The affix क्त्वा when it takes the augment इट् (i.e. when it is सेट्) is not कित् ।
The सेट् निष्ठा affixes are not कित् after the verbs शीङ् 'to lie down', स्विद् 'to sweat', मिद् 'to melt', क्ष्विद् 'to be unctuous', and दृश् 'to offend'.
The सेट् निष्ठा affix is not कित् after the verb मृष् 'to forbear'.
The सेट् निष्ठा affix is optionally not कित् after the verbs with a penultimate उ if used impersonally or denoting the beginning of action.
The सेट् निष्ठा affix and the सेट् क्त्वा are not कित् after the verb पुङ् 'to purify'.
The सेट् क्त्वा is optionally कित् after the verbs having a penultimate न् ending in a थ् and फ्।
The सेट् क्त्वा is optionally कित् after the verbs वञ्च् 'to cheat', लुञ्च् 'to pluck' and ऋत् 'to dare or abhor'.
The सेट् क्त्वा is optionally कित् , according to the opinion of ऋषि काश्यप after the verbs तृष् 'to be thirsty', मृष् 'to sprinkle' and कृश् 'to become lean'.
After a verb which begins in a consonant and ends in a letter of रल् प्रत्यहार and has as its penultimate इ or ई and उ or ऊ , the क्त्वा and सन् affixes are optionally कित् ।
Vowels are classified as ह्रस्व, दीर्घ and प्लुत based on the time taken for their pronunciation, as compared against the time of उ, ऊ and उ3 respectively.
Action denoted by the words ह्रस्व / दीर्घ / प्लुत happens in place of an अच् letter.
A vowel that is pronounced using the upper-half portion of its उच्चारणस्थान is known as उदात्त.
A vowel that is pronounced using the lower-half portion of its उच्चारणस्थान is known as अनुदात्त.
A vowel that is pronounced using the upper as well as lower portions of its उच्चारणस्थान is known as  स्वरित.
The first half part of a स्वरित-स्वर is considered उदात्त.
In addressing a person from a distance the tone is called एकश्रुति or monotony.
In sacrificial works there is Monotony, except in जप (silent repetition of a formula), न्यूङ्ख vowels (16 sorts of ओम्) and the साम Vedas.
The pronunciation of the word वषट् , may optionally be by raising the voice (acutely accented), or it may be pronounced with monotony.
The monotony is optional in the recitation of the Vedas or they may be recited with accents.
There should be no Monotony in the recitation of the सब्रह्मण्य hymns and in those hymns, the vowels, that would otherwise have taken the स्वरित accent, take the उदात्त accent instead.
The words देवा and ब्राह्मण in those hymns have अनुदात्त accent.
The Monotony takes the place of the अनुदात्त vowels which follow the स्वरित vowels, in close proximity (संहिता).
The accent called सन्नतर is substituted in the room of an अनुदात्त vowel, which has an उदात्त or स्वरित vowel following it.
A प्रत्ययः that contains only one letter is called अपृक्त ।
A तत्-पुरुष compound, the case of each member is the same, is called कर्मधारय or Appositional Determinative compound.
In (this book, in the sūtras relating to) compound, the word that is exhibited in the Nominative -1st case, is called उपसर्जन or the secondary word.

A word which is one fixed case, (while the word compounded with it may vary its case) is also उपसर्जन , except for the purposes of the the rule which requires the उपसर्जन to stand first in a compound.
A meaningful word which is not a धातु, not a प्रत्यय, and which does not end in  प्रत्यय is called a 'प्रातिपदिक'.
कृत्-प्रत्ययान्त words, तद्धितप्रत्ययान्त words and the सामासिकशब्दाः are known as प्रातिपदिक.
The last letter of an अजन्त प्रातिपदिक is becomes हस्व in context of नपुंसकलिङ्ग.
A short vowel is the substitute of प्रातिपदिक which ends with the word गो 'a cow' and of that which ends with what has as its termination a feminine affix, when regarded as उपसर्जन।
When a तद्धित affix is elided by the word लुक् there takes place the elision by लुक् of feminine affix of the उपसर्जन।
The short is substituted in the place of गोणी , when the तद्धित affix is elided by लुक्।
When a तद्धित affix is elided by using the word लुप् , then the gender and number (of the derivative word) agree with those of the original word.

And of adjectives (the gender and number are the same as of the word formed by लुप् elision of the तद्धित and which they qualify) so far as the जाति (or kind of species) is concerned, (or when not expressing जाति).

This (concord or gender and number, of primitive and derivative nouns, and of attributes and substantives need not be taught (or approved), because it has the authority of संज्ञा (conventional term or idiom).
The sūtras declaring लुप् elision need not also be taught, because of the non-currency of the etymological meaning of the words supposed to be formed by लुप् elision.
And if the etymological meaning 'be held authoritative', then when such meaning is absent, the word also should vanish.

(Nor need be taught) the rule relating to the dependance of the meaning of a word on the principal (प्रधान in a compound) or on the affix (प्रत्यय) because the authority of the meaning (of a word, compound or derivative) consists in something else.
And a rule fixing the meaning of Tense (काल) and उपसर्जन (sequence) is equally (unnecessary, and need not be taught).
In (a common) name (expressive of) class, in denoting the singular, the plural is optionally used.
The plural of the pronoun अस्मद् 'I', is used optionally, though the sense requires a singular or a dual number.
And the dual of फाल्गुनी and प्रष्ठपदा , when signifying asterisms, (also connotes optionally plural).
In the Vedas, the two stars, पुनर्वासू , may optionally be singular, (and connote a dual).
In the Vedas, the two stars विशाखा may optionally be in the singular number.
In the द्वन्द compounds of the stars तिष्व and पुनर्वसू , the dual constantly comes in place of the plural.
If two or more words have identical forms for all विभक्तिs, then in usage only one word is used by applying appropriate वचन to it.

The वृद्ध (or patronymic गोत्र word becomes एकशेष and is retained, when compounded) with a patronymic word युवन् , provided that the specific difference in form between them be in their signs (affix) only.
And so also a feminine word, ending with a वृद्ध affix, when similarly spoken along with the same word but which ends with a युवन् affix, is only retained and it is treated like a masculine.
A word in the masculine gender, similarly spoken along with the same word, but ending with the feminine affix, becomes एकशेष and the latter is dropped.
The words भ्रातृ 'brother' and पुत्र 'son', when spoken of along with स्वसृ 'sister' and दुहितृ 'daughter' respectively are only retained and the latter are dropped.
A neuter noun, which has the same form, only differing in affix, is optionally retained and the other is dropped and it is like a singular number.
The word पितृ 'father' is optionally only retained when spoken of along with मातृ 'mother'.
The word श्वशुर 'father-in-law', is optionally only retained, when spoken of along with श्वशुरू 'mother-in-law'.
The pronouns त्यद् etc. when spoken of along with any other noun, (pronoun other than त्यद् etc.) are always retained as एकशेष (to the exclusion of others).
The feminine noun is only retained when denoting a collection of domestic animals, not being young.
The words भू and others, when used to denote an action, are called 'धातु'.
An अनुनासिक स्वर present in an उपदेश is called 'इत्'.
The ending हल् letter of  an उपदेश is called 'इत्'.
The letters - त्, थ्, द्, ध्, न्, स्, म् - occurring in the औपदेशिक form of a विभक्ति are not called 'इत्' ।
The groups ञि, टु and डु occurring at the beginning of an उपदेश are called 'इत्'.
The letter ष् at the beginning of the औपदेशिक form of a प्रत्यय is called 'इत्' ।
The letters - च्, छ्, ज्, झ्, ञ्, ट्, ठ्, ड्, ढ्, ण् -  at the beginning of the औपदेशिक form of a प्रत्यय are called इत् ।

items.anvaya: उपदेशे अतद्धितस्य  प्रत्ययस्य आदिः ल-श-कु इत्
items.english: The letters ल्, श्, क्, ख्, ग्, घ्, ङ्  at the beginning of the औपदेशिक form of a non-तद्धित प्रत्यय are called इत् ।
The इत् letter is elided during the प्रक्रिया.
When a certain relation is given between two groups having same number of elements, then the relation is considered to exist only between the correspondingly positioned members of the two groups.
In this सूत्रपाठ, a स्वरित स्वर is used to denote अनुवृत्तिs.
A verb that contains (a) इत्संज्ञक ङकारः, or (b) an इत्संज्ञक अनुदात्त स्वर gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
A verb gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद in the भावे and the कर्मणि प्रयोग.
A verb gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, even in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, in the context of व्यतिहार (exchange of actions).
The verbs indicating the action of - (a) movement,  or (2) violence - do not get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, in the context of व्यतिहार (exchange of actions).

A verb does not get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद  in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, in the context of व्यतिहार (exchange of actions) when either of the words 'इतरेतर' or 'अन्योन्य' is used to describe the situation.
When the उपसर्ग 'नि' is attached to the verb 'विश्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
When any of the उपसर्गs - परि, वि, अव - is attached to the verb 'क्री', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
When any of the उपसर्गs -  वि or  परा - is attached to the verb 'जि', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
When the उपसर्ग आङ् is attached to the verb 'दा'; it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided that the  meaning is something other than 'opening the mouth'.
When any of the उपसर्गs - आङ् , अनु, सम or परि - is attached to the verb 'क्रीड्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
When any of the उपसर्गs - सम् , अव, प्र, वि - is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
The verb स्था gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद when used in the meaning of - (a) Clearing explaining own opinion, and (b) Putting and end to a question / debate.
When the उपसर्ग 'उत्' is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided that the meaning is not 'moving upwards / standing up'.
When the उपसर्ग 'उप' is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided the meaning is 'to approach using the मन्त्रs'.
When the उपसर्ग 'उप' is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verb is used in an अकर्मक sense.
When either of the उपसर्गs  - 'उत्', 'वि' - is attached to the verb 'तप्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of 'आत्मनेपद' ; provided that the verb is used in an अकर्मक sense.
When the उपसर्ग 'आङ्' is attached to verbs यम् /  हन् , they get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verbs are used in an अकर्मक sense.
When the उपसर्ग 'सम्' is attached to any of the verbs -  गम्,  ऋच्छ्, प्रच्छ्, स्वर्, ऋ, श्रु, विद् - they get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verbs are used in an अकर्मक sense.
When any of the उपसर्गs - नि, सम्, वि - is attached to the verb 'ह्वे', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
When the उपसर्ग 'आङ्' is attached to the verb 'ह्वे', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of 'आत्मनेपद', provided the meaning is 'to complete / to wish to defeat'.

The verb कृ gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, when used in the meanings of  - 
(1) गन्धनम् - To backbite, 
(2) अवक्षेपणम् - To defame, 
(3) सेवन् -  To serve or help out 
(4) साहसिक्यम् - To force someone to do something against their wish, To rape
(5) प्रतियत्न -To make someone change their character, 
(6) प्रकथनम् - To narrate, 
and
(7) उपयोग - To bring in practice, to use.
When the उपसर्ग 'अधि' is attached to the verb 'कृ', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the meaning is 'to forgive / to obtain victory'.
When the उपसर्ग 'वि' is attached to the verb 'कृ', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided the meaning is 'to make sound / to pronounce'.
When the उपसर्ग 'वि' is attached to the verb 'कृ', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verb is used in an अकर्मक sense.

The verb नी  gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद  ; when used in the meaning of - (1) सम्मानन, To respect in an appropriate way (2) उत्सञ्जन, To lift up, to toss (3) आचार्यकरण, To convert someone into a teacher (by imparting proper knowledge to them) (4) ज्ञान, To decide, fix upon (5) भृतिः, Employ someone by giving money (6) निगणन, To pay off, to give loan ;  and (7) व्यय, To spend.
The verb 'नी' when used in the कर्तरि  सकर्मकप्रयोग gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided that the कर्मपद does not represent either the body or a part of the body of an animal.
The verb 'क्रम्' gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, when it is used in the meaning of - (1) वृत्तिः , To progress without getting stuck  , (2) सर्गः, enthusiasm, (3) तायनः, expansion, elaboration.

When the verb 'क्रम्' comes with an उपसर्ग, it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद only in the meaning of - (1) वृत्तिः , To progress without getting stuck  , (2) सर्गः, enthusiasm, (3) तायनः, expansion, elaboration.
When the उपसर्ग 'आङ्' is attached to the verb 'क्रम्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided the meaning is 'to rise, to travel upwards'.
When the उपसर्ग 'वि' is attached to the verb 'क्रम्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided the meaning is 'to roam around with feet'.
When the उपसर्ग 'प्र' or 'उप' is attached to the verb 'क्रम्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the meaning expressed is 'the beginning of'.
When the verb क्रम् is used without any उपसर्ग, it optionally gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.
After the verb ज्ञ , when used in the sense of 'denying', the आत्मनेपद is used.
And when used intransitively after the verb ज्ञ , the आत्मनेपद is used, when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.
After the verb ज्ञ , preceded by सम् and प्रति , the आत्मनेपद is used, when Not Used in the sense of 'remembering with regret'.
After the verb वद् , the आत्मनेपद is used, when used in the senses of 'showing brilliance, or proficiency in', pacifying', 'knowledge', 'effort', 'difference of opinion' and 'flattering'.
After the verb वद् , the आत्मनेपद is used, when used in the sense of 'speaking articulately in a similar manner'.
After the verb वद् , preceded by अनु when it is intransitively used, the आत्मनेपद is used, when the sense is that of 'speaking articulately in a similar manner'.
After the verb वद् , the आत्मनेपद is used optionally, when the sense is that of 'contradicting with each other'.
After the verb गॄ 'to swallow', when preceded by अव, the आत्मनेपद is used.
After the verb गॄ 'to swallow', when preceded by सम् , the आत्मनेपद affix is used in the sense of 'promising'.
After the verb चर् 'to walk' preceded by उत् , when used intransitively, the आत्मनेपद is used.
After the verb चर् 'to walk' preceded by सम् , and when connected with a noun in the Instrumental - 3rd Case, the आत्मनेपद is used.

And after the verb दा 'to give', preceded by सम् , and connected with a noun in the Instrumental - 3rd Case, the आत्मनेपद affix is used, provided this Instrumental Case has the sense of the Dative - 4th Case.
After the verb यम् 'to give', preceded by उप , when used in the sense of 'espousing', the आत्मनेपद is used.
After the Desideratives formed by the affix सन् , of the verbs ज्ञा 'to know', श्रु 'to hear', स्मृ 'to remember' and दृश् 'to see', the आत्मनेपद is used.
After the Desiderative of ज्ञा 'to know' when preceded by अनु , the आत्मनेपद affix is Not used.
After the Desideratives of श्रु 'to hear', when preceded by प्रत and आङ् , the आत्मनेपद affix is Not used.
After the verb शद् 'to decay', when it has one of the affixes with an indicatory श् (शित्) the आत्मनेपद is used.

After the verb मृ 'to die', when it has one of the affixes having an indicatory श् , as well as when it takes the affixes लुङ् (Aorist [[3.2.110]]) and लिङ् (Benedictive [[3.3.159]]), the आत्मनेपद is used.

The verb which is आत्मनेपदि in its primitive form before taking of the affix सन् , will also be आत्मनेपदि when it ends in the affix सन्। in other words; after a Desiderative verb, आत्मनेपद is used, if it would have been used after the primitive verb.
When the verb root कृ is used after the आम् प्रत्यय, the verb root कृ gets the same पद as the original verb to which the आम् प्रत्यय has been attached.
After the verb युज् 'to join', the आत्मनेपद is used, when it is preceded by प्र and उप except with reference to sacrificial vessels even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.
After the verb क्षणु 'to sharpen', preceded by सम् , the आत्मनेपद is used.
After the verb भुज् , the आत्मनेपद is used, except in the sense of protecting.

items.sanskrit_text: णेरणौ यत् कर्म णौ चेत् स कर्ताऽनाध्याने
items.english: After a verb ending in the affix णि (causal) the आत्मनेपद is used, provided that when the object in the non-णि or non-causal sense becomes the agent in the causal; and when it does not mean 'to remember with regret', even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

After the causatives of the verbs भी 'to fear' and स्मि 'to wonder' even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent the आत्मनेपद is employed, when the fear is produced directly by the causative agent.
After the causatives of the verbs गृध 'to covet' and वञ्च 'to go' the आत्मनेपद is used in the sense of 'deceiving' even though the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

After the causative of the verb लि 'to melt or stick', the आत्मनेपद is employed, when used in the sense of showing respect, subduing and deceiving, even though the fruit of action does not accrue to the agent.

After the causative of the verb कृ , the आत्मनेपद is used, when it has the word मिथ्या 'incorrect', as an उपपद or dependent word and is used in the sense of 'repeated wrong utterance', even when the fruit of action does not accrue no the agent.
A verb that contains इत्संज्ञक ञकार or an इत्संज्ञक स्वरित स्वरः gets the प्रत्यया of आत्मनेपद when the doer of the action does the action for himself.
After the verb वद् 'to tell', preceded by अप , when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent, the terminations are of the आत्मनेपद।
After a verb ending in the affix णि (causal) when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent, the आत्मनेपद is used.
After the verb यम् 'to strive', preceded by सम् , उत् and आङ् , when it does not refer to a book, the आत्मनेपद is used, when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.
After the verb ज्ञा , when not preceded by any उपसर्ग , the terminations are of the आत्मनेपद , when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.
The आत्मनेपद is optionally used, when the fact of the fruit of the action accruing to the agent is indicted by an उपपदग i.e. by a word used along with the verb.
The verbs that do not get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद will get the प्रत्ययाः of परस्मैपद.
After the verb कृ 'to make' preceded by the अनु and पर , परस्मैपद is used, even the fruit of the action goes to the agent and when the sense is that of 'divulging' etc.
After the verb क्षिप् 'to throw', coming after अभि , प्रति and अति , परस्मैपद is used, even though the fruit of the action goes to the agent
After the verb वह् 'to bear', coming after प्र , परस्मैपद is used, even though the fruit of the action accrues to the the agent.
After the verb मृष् 'to bear', preceded by परि , परस्मैपद is used when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.
After the verb रम् 'to sport', preceded by वि and आङ् , परस्मैपद is used.
And also after उप , the verb रम् takes the affixes of the परस्मैपद।
After the verb रम् 'to sport', preceded by उप , परस्मैपद is optionally used, when employed intransitively.

After the verbs बुध् 'to know', युध् 'to fight', नश् 'to destroy', जन 'to be born', एङ् 'to go', प्रु 'to move', द्रु 'to run' and स्रु 'to flow', ending in the affix णे (i.e. when used in the causative), परस्मैपद is used, even when the fruit of the action goes to the agent.
And after the causatives of verbs which have no sense of the 'eating or swallowing' and 'shaking or moving' परस्मैपद is used, even when the fruit of the action goes to the agent.

The affixes of the परस्मैपद are used after the causal of that verb, which in its non-causal state was intransitive and had a being endowed with reason for its agent, even when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

But the affixes of the परस्मैपद are not used after the causals of the verbs पा 'to drink', दम् 'to tame', आयम् 'to extend', आयस् 'to exert oneself', परिमुह 'to be bewildered', रुच् 'to shine' नृत् 'to dance', वद् 'to speak' and वस् 'to dwell'.
The affixes of the परस्मैपद are used optionally after the denominative verbs ending in the affix क्यष।
After the verbs द्युत् 'to shine' etc., the terminations of the परस्मैपद are optionally employed, when the affixes of लुण् (Aorist) follow.
After the verbs वृत् 'to exist' etc., परस्मैपद is optionally used when the affixes स्य (Future and conditional) and सन् (Desiderative) follow.
After the verb क्लिप् 'to be fit', परस्मैपद is optionally used, when लुट् (1st Future) is affixed, as well as when स्य and सन् are affixed.

If a word is given two संज्ञाs  under this अधिकार, and if the संज्ञा given by the later sutra can only be given whenever the संज्ञा given by the earlier sutra is given, then under such circumstances, the word gets only the संज्ञा given by the later sutra, not the earlier sutra.
If two sutras that can be invoked independent of each other happen to conflict at the same step during a प्रक्रिया, then the later occurring sutra gets applied by precedence.
The दीर्घ-ईकारान्त and दीर्घ-ऊकारान्त words which are only used as स्त्रीलिङ्ग forms get the term 'नदी'.
Except for the word 'स्त्री', any other word which is eligible for getting an इयङ्-आदेश or an उवङ्-आदेश is not referred to as नदी.

items.anvaya: इयङ्-उवङ्-स्थानौ यू स्त्र्याख्यौ आमि नदी वा, अस्त्री
items.english: Except for the word 'स्त्री', any other word which is eligible for getting an इयङ्-आदेश or an उवङ्-आदेश optionally gets the term नदी in presence of the आम् प्रत्यय of षष्ठी बहुवचन.

items.anvaya: इयङ्-उवङ्-स्थानौ यू स्त्र्याख्यौ, ह्रस्वः च, ङिति नदी वा, अस्त्री
items.english: Except for the word 'स्त्री', any other word which is eligible for getting an इयङ्-आदेश or an उवङ्-आदेश, and any ह्रस्व-इकारान्त/हस्व-उकारान्त word optionally gets the term नदी in presence of a ङित् प्रत्यय.
Except for the word सखि, all ह्रस्व-इकारान्त and ह्रस्व-उकारान्त words get the term घि whenever they do not get the term नदी.
The word पति gets the term घि only when used in a समास.
The word पति, when associated with a word of षष्ठी विभक्ति, optionally gets the term घि in वेदाः.
A ह्रस्व स्वर gets the term लघु.
A ह्रस्व स्वर which is followed by a संयोग gets the term गुरु.
A दीर्घ स्वर gets the  term गुरु.
When a प्रत्यय is attached to a word, everything that begins with the first letter of that word up to (and excluding) the first letter of the प्रत्ययः itself, is called the an अङ्गम् of that प्रत्यय.
Any word ending in a सुप् प्रत्यय or a तिङ् प्रत्यय is called a पद.
A नकारान्त word gets the term 'पद' when followed by a प्रत्यय that begins with क्य.
In presence of a प्रत्यय having सकार as इत्संज्ञक, the प्रकृति gets the term पद.
If a प्रत्यय which is not a सर्वनामस्थान and which is specified in the fourth or fifth chapter gets attached to an प्रकृति , the प्रकृति gets the term पद.
If a यकारादि or an अजादि प्रत्यय which is not a सर्वनामस्थान and which is specified in the fourth or fifth chapter gets attached to a प्रकृति , the प्रकृति gets the term भ.
A तकारान्त or a सकारान्त word gets the term 'भ' when followed by a  मत्वर्थीय प्रत्यय.
The 'अयस्मय' and other words should be considered valid words in the वैदिक literature.
For referring to many, the बहुवचन forms are used.
For referring to two, the द्विवचन forms are used, where as for referring to one, the एकवचन forms are used.
The phrase कारक (meaning 'in the special relation to a word expressing an action') is to be understood in the following aphorisms.
A noun whose relation to an action is that of a fixed point from which departure takes place is called अपादान or Ablation.
In case of words implying 'fear' and 'protection from danger' that from which the danger of fear proceeds is called अपादान कारक।
In the case of the verb पराजि 'to be tired or weary of', that which becomes unbearable, is called अपादान कारक।
In case of verbs having the sense of 'preventing, the desired object from which one is prevented or warded off', is called Ablation or अपदान कारक।

items.anvaya: अन्तर्धौ येन अदर्शनम् इच्छति तत् कारकम् अपादानम्
items.english: When concealment is indicated, the person whose sight one wishes to avoid, is called अपादान कारक।
The noun denoting the teacher is called Ablation or अपादान , in relation to the action signifying formal teaching.
The prime cause of the agent of the verb जन् 'to be born', is called अपादान।
The source of the agent of the verb भू 'to become' is called अपादान।
The person whom one wishes to connect with the object of giving, is called सम्प्रदान or recipient.
In case of verbs having the signification of the root रुच् 'to like', the person or thing that is pleased or satisfied, is called सम्प्रदान or recipient.
In case of verbs श्लाघ् 'to praise', ह्नु 'to take away', स्था 'to stand', शप् 'to curse', the person whom it is intended to inform of or persuade by, these actions, is called सम्प्रदान।
In the case of the verb धारि 'to owe', the creditor is called सम्प्रदान।
In the case of the verb स्पृह् 'to desire', the thing desired is called सम्प्रदान कारक।

In the case of the verbs having the sense of क्रद्ध् 'to be angry', द्रुह् 'to injure', ईर्ष्या 'to envy', असूया 'to detract', the person against whom the feeling of anger etc. is directed is called सम्प्रदान।
But in the case of the verbs क्रुद्ध् and द्रुह् , when preceded by prepositions, the person against whom the feeling of anger etc. is directed is called कर्म कारक or object.
In the case of the verbs राध् 'to propitiate' and ईक्ष् 'to look to', the person about whose good or bad fortune questions are asked is called सम्प्रदान।

In the case of the verb श्रु preceded by the prepositions प्रति and अङ् and meaning 'to promise', the person to whom promise is made (literally: the person who as the agent of the former verb) is called सम्प्रदान।
In the case of the verb गृ preceded by अनु and प्रति and meaning 'to encourage by repeating', the person who was the agent of the prior action, which is repeated, is called सम्प्रदान।
That which is especially auxiliary in the accomplishment of the action is called Instrument or करण कारक।
That which is especially auxiliary in the accomplishment of the action, of the verb दिव् 'to play' is called कर्म - object, as well as करण।

In the case of hiring on wages, that which is especially auxiliary in the accomplishment of the action of the verb परिक्री 'employing on stipulated wages', is optionally called सम्प्रदान or recipient.
That which is related to the action as the site where the action is performed by reason of the agent or the object being in that place is called अधिकरण or location.
That which is the site of the verbs शीङ् 'to lie down', स्था 'to stand', आस् 'to sit', when preceded by the preposition अधि , is however called कर्म कारक or object.
That which is the site of the verb अभिनिविश् 'to enter', is also called कर्म कारक।
That which is the site of the verb वस् 'to dwell', when preceded by उप , अनु , and आङ् is called कर्म कारक।
That which is intended should be most effected by the act of the agent is called the object or कर्म।
If that which is not intended to be most affected by the act becomes however similarly connected with the action it also is called कर्म।
And if that कारक which is not spoken of as coming under any of the special relations of Ablation etc., is also called कर्म।

For verbs indicating motion (गति), knowledge (बुद्धि), eating (भक्षण); for verbs whose action involves a word (शब्दकर्म) ; and for the अकर्मक verbs the  कर्ता of the अप्रयोजक sentence becomes कर्म in the प्रयोजक sentence.
The agent of the verb in its non-णि (primitive) form in the case of हृ 'to lose' and कृ 'to make', is optionally called कर्म or object when these verbs take the affix.
Whatever the speaker chooses as the independent, principal and absolute source of action is called कर्ता or agent.
That which is the mover thereof, i.e. of the independent source of action, is called हेतु or cause, as well as कर्ता or agent.
The words discussed till <<अधिरीश्वरे>> [[1.4.97]] are known as निपात.
The words included in the चादिगण are called निपात when used in a sense that does not denote an object.
The words belonging to the प्रादिगण are called उपसर्ग  when used along with a verb.
The words belonging to the प्रादिगण are also called गति when used along with a verb.
The words उरी 'assent' etc. and those that end with च्वि [[5.4.50]] and those that end with डाच् [[5.4.57]] (when in composition with the verb भू , कृ or अस् ) are called गति।
A word imitative of sounds is also called गति when it is not followed by the word इति।
The words सत् and असत् when in composition with a verb is called गति , when used in the sense of 'respect or love' and 'disrespect or indifference'.
The word अलम् when in composition with a verb is called गति , when used in the sense of 'ornament'.
The word अन्तर् is called गति , when used in the sense of 'non-accepting', when in composition with a verb.
The words कणे and मनस् are गति when in composition with a verb and used in the sense of 'reaction by satiation'.
The word पुरः 'in front of', when indeclinable and in composition with a verb, is called गति।
And the indeclinable word अस्तम् 'at home' is called गति , when in composition with a verb.
The indeclinable word अच्छ 'before in the presence of' is called गति , when used in the composition with verbs denoting 'motion' or with the verb वद् 'to speak'.
The word अदस् 'that' is called गति when in composition with a verb and not implying a direction to another.
The word तिरस् when used in the sense of 'disappearance' is called गति when in composition with a verb.
The word तिरस् 'disappearance' is optionally called गति when the verb कृ follows.
The words उपाजे and अनवाजे both meaning 'supporting or assisting the weak', are optionally called गति when used along with the verb कृ।
The words साक्षात् 'in the presence of' etc. are optionally called गति when used along with the verb कृ।
The word उर्सि 'in the breast' and मनसि 'in the mind' ae optionally called गति when the verb कृ follows, provided that they are not used in the sense of 'placing'.
And the words मध्ये 'in the middle', पदे 'in the foot' and निवचने 'speechless' are optionally called गति , when कृ follows, the sense not being of placing.
The word हस्ते 'in the hand', पाणौ 'in the hand' are always necessarily called गति when used with the verb कृ in the sense of 'marriage'.
The indeclinable word प्रध्वम् followed by the verb कृ , is always called गति when in used in the sense of 'binding'.
The words जीविका and उपनिषद् followed by the verb कृ are called गति when used in the sense of 'likeness and resemblance'.
Words referred as उपसर्ग or गति are attached before the verb root.
In the छन्दस् (Veda) these गति and उपसर्ग are employed indifferently after the verbal root, as well as before it.
In the छन्दस् (Veda) these गति and उपसर्ग are also seen separated from the verb by intervening words.
From this point as far as aphorism [[1.4.97]] treated of, are to be understood as having the name of कर्म-प्रवचनीय।
The word अनु , when it denotes a sign, is called कर्म-प्रवचनीय।
The word अनु , कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it has the force of the 3rd case.
The word अनु , कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it is used in the sense of 'inferior or subordinate to'.
The word उप when it means 'superior' or 'inferior to' is कर्म-प्रवचनीय।
The words अप and परि are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when meaning 'exclusion'.
The word आङ् 'as far as', is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it expresses limit (e.g. when it means 'as far as inclusive of' or 'as far as exclusive of').

The words प्रति , परि and अनु are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of 'sign' ('in the direction of') , 'mere statement of circumstances' ('as regards'), 'division', 'share of' and 'pervasion', severally.
The word अभि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the above senses of 'in the direction of', 'as regards', and 'each severally', but not when it means 'division', 'share of'.
The word प्रति is कर्म -प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of representative ('representative of') or exchange ('in exchange for').
The words अधि and परि are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used as mere expletives.
The word सु is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of respect, (when it means 'excellently').
The word अति in the sense of super-abundance ('excessively') and 'excellently' is कर्म-प्रवचनीय।

The word अपि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it implies, the sense of word 'understood' ('somewhat') or 'possibility' (e.g. 'even' in the sense of such a great person), or permission to do as one likes, ('if you like'), or censure ('even' in the sense of what is disgraceful); or collection ('and').
The words अधि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of 'lord' ('being as a lord' or 'having as a lord')
The words अधि is optionally कर्म-प्रवचनीय when the verb कृ follows.
The आदेशा that occur in place of a लकार are known as परस्मैपद.
The तङ्, शानच् and कानच् आदेशाः that occur in place of a लकार are known as आत्मनेपद.
The तिङ्-प्रत्ययाः, when grouped into groups of three, are sequentially known as प्रथम, मध्यम and उत्तम.

items.anvaya: तानि त्रीणि त्रीणि तिङः एकवचन-द्विवचन-बहुवचनानि एकशः
items.english: The तिङ्-प्रत्ययाः are sequentially referred as एकवचन, द्विवचन and बहुवचन.
The सुप्-प्रत्ययाः are sequentially referred as एकवचन, द्विवचन and बहुवचन.
The सुप्-प्रत्ययाः and the तिङ्-प्रत्ययाः are called विभक्ति.

items.anvaya: युष्मदि उपपदे समानाधिकरणे स्थानिनि अपि मध्यमः
items.english: Where a form of the word  युष्मद् shows the same substance which is shown by the लकार, there the तिङन्तपद must be expressed using the मध्यमपुरुष प्रत्ययाs.

items.anvaya: मन्य-उपपदे प्रहासे मध्यमः । मन्यतेः उत्तमः एकवत् च ।
items.english: When one person wants to make fun of what other person thinks, and he uses the verb 'मन्' to indicate the thinking process, the verb मन् is used in उत्तमपुरुष-एकवचन and the other verb is used in  मध्यमपुरुष. For example, consider this statement - 'Do you think you can eat the rice' (एहि मन्ये ओदनम् भोक्ष्यसे)? Here the speaker is making fun of the thinking process of other person, saying that the other person is thinking he could eat the rice, but he would not be able to. In such a case, the verb मन् would get उत्तमपुरुष (instead of ideally getting मध्यमपुरुष), and the other word  (भुज् in this case) would get मध्यमपुरुष instead of ideally getting उत्तमपुरुष). So, instead of saying  रे बुभुक्षित, किम् त्वं एतत् मन्यसे यत् अहम् ओदनम् भोक्ष्ये, we would say - एहि मन्ये ओदनम् भोक्ष्यसे?

items.anvaya: अस्मदि उपपदे समानाधिकरणे स्थानिनि अपि उत्तमः
items.english: Where a form of the word अस्मद् shows the same substance which is shown by the लकार, there the तिङन्तपद must be expressed using the उत्तमपुरुष प्रत्ययाs.

items.anvaya: शेषे उपपदे समानाधिकरणे स्थानिनि अपि प्रथमः
items.english: Where a form of the word other than अस्मद् or युष्मद् shows the same substance which is shown by the लकार, there the तिङन्तपद must be expressed using the प्रथमपुरुष प्रत्ययाs.
Extreme closeness of letters is called संहिता.
The 'पदविधि' given in the व्याकरणशास्त्र happens only for the words that exhibit सामर्थ्य (that is, those which are related to each other).
A सुबन्त that is followed by an आमन्त्रित will behave exactly like the अङ्ग of that आमन्त्रित,when it comes to determination of the स्वर in that सुबन्त.
The समास term is discussed from this sutra onwards till the end of second पाद of the second chapter.
A समास is formed when one सुबन्त combines with another related सुबन्त.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: The समासाः told till 2.1.22 are called अव्ययीभावसमासाः ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: An अव्यय that is used in any of these meanings- विभक्तिः (e.g. 'अधि'), समीपम् (near, e.g. 'उप'), समृद्धिः (prosperity, e.g. 'सु') , व्यृद्धिः (deterioration, e.g. 'दुस्','दुर्'), अर्थाभावः (absence, e.g 'निर्'), अत्ययम् (expiry, e.g. 'अति'), असम्प्रतिः (non-presence, e.g. 'अति'), शब्दप्रादुर्भावः (appearance of the word, e.g. 'तत्'), पश्चात् (later, e.g. 'अनु'), यथा (eligibility, e.g. 'यथा'), आनुपूर्व्य (sequentially, e.g. 'अनु'), यौगपद्य (simultaneously, e.g. 'स'), सादृश्य (similarity, e.g. 'स'), सम्पत्ति (appropriate, e.g. 'स'), साकल्यार्थः (entirety, e.g. 'स'), अन्तवचनम् ('till', e.g. 'स') - undergoes a समास with a related सुबन्त, and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.

items.anvaya: यथा असादृश्ये सुपा सह अव्ययीभावः समासः
items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: The word 'यथा', when used in a meaning different than 'similarity', undergoes a समास with a related सुबन्त, and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.

items.anvaya: यावत् अवधारणे सुपा सह अव्ययीभावः समासः
items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: When the word 'यावत्' is used in the the meaning of अवधारणा (indication of a number, For example - 'as many'), it undergoes a समास with a related सुबन्त, and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.

items.anvaya: सुप् मात्रार्थे प्रतिना सुपा सह समासः
items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: The word 'प्रति' when used in the meaning of 'मात्रा' (little, a small amount) undergoes a समास with related सुबन्त, and the समास is called अव्ययीभाव.

items.anvaya: अक्ष-शलाका-सङ्ख्याः परिणा सुपा सह अव्ययीभावः समासः
items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: The word अक्ष (dice), the word शलाका (stick) and the words indicating a number - all undergo a समास with a related 'परि' शब्द, and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.

items.anvaya: अप-परि-बहिः-अञ्चवः  पञ्चम्या  सुपा सह विभाषा अव्ययीभावसमासः
items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: The words 'अप', 'परि', 'बहि' and the words generated from the verb 'अञ्च्' (E.g. प्राच्, प्रत्यच्, उदच् etc) optionally undergo a समास with related पञ्चम्यन्त word; and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.

items.anvaya: मर्यादा-अभिविध्योः आङ् पञ्चम्याः विभाषा अव्ययीभावः समासः
items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: The word 'आङ्' used in the meaning of मर्यादा (exclusive limit) and अभिविधि (inclusive limit) optionally undergoes a समास with a related word in पञ्चमी, and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: The words अभि and प्रति when implying direction (towards), are optionally compounded with a word ending in a case-affix denoting the limit, or the goal which regulates or marks the direction and the resulting compound is अव्ययीभाव।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: The word अनु 'near to' is optionally compounded with that word, nearness to which is indicated by the particle and the resulting compound is अव्ययीभाव।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: The word अनु 'alongside of' is optionally compounded with the word indicative of that whose length the particle expresses and compound so formed is called अव्ययीभाव।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: And the words तिष्ठद्गु 'at the time when the cows stand to be milked', etc. are अव्ययीभाव compounds.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: The words पार 'across' and मध्य 'middle' may optionally be compounded with a word ending in the 6th-Case-affix, when they take forms परे and मध्ये and the compound so formed is अव्ययीभाव।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: A numeral (संख्या) may be compounded with a word denoting 'one belonging to a family' and the resulting compound is अव्ययीभाव ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: A numeral (संख्या) may be compounded with the names of 'rivers' and the resulting compound is अव्ययीभाव denoting an aggregate.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः
items.english: A word ending in a case-affix is compounded with words denoting the names of rivers, when the compound word denotes a thing other than that expressed by the terms of the compound and is an appellative, the compound so formed being an अव्ययीभाव ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: From this sūtra as far as sūtra [[2.2.23]], the word तत्-पुरुष is governing word, and is understood in all the following sūtras.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: And the compound called द्विगु (Numeral Determinative Compound) is all called तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending in a 2nd case-affix is compounded with the words श्रित 'who had recourse to', अतीत 'gone by', पतित 'who has fallen upon', गत 'who has gone to', अत्यस्त 'who has passed', प्राप्त 'who has obtained' and अपान्न 'who has reached' and the resulting compound is called तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The indeclinable word स्वयम् 'oneself' is compounded with a word ending in the affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The word खट्वा in the Accusative -2nd case is compounded with a word ending in the affix क्त , when censure is implied and the compound so formed is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The indeclinable word सामि 'half' is compounded with a word ending in the affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The words denoting time, being in the Accusative -2nd case, are optionally compounded with a word ending in the affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: Words denoting time being in the Accusative -2nd case, are optionally compounded with a word ending in a case-affix, when used in the sense of complete connection throughout with the time (i.e. duration of time) and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix is optionally compounded with what denotes quality, the quality being that which is instrumentally caused by the thing signified by what ends with the 3rd case-affix and with the word अर्थ 'wealth' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending in Instrumental -3rd case-affix is compounded with the words पूर्व 'prior', सदृश 'like', सम 'similar', अनर्थ 'words having the sense of less', कलह 'quarrel', निपुण 'proficient', मिश्र 'mixed' and श्लक्षण 'polished sleek', and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix, when it denotes the agent or instrument -- [[2.3.18]], is compounded diversely with what ends with a कृत् affix and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix when it denotes the agent or the Instrument, is compounded optionally with a word ending in a कृत्य affix, when exaggerated statement (whether of praise or of censure) is implied and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix and denoting a condiment, is optionally compounded with a word ending in a case-affix, signifying food and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix and denoting a relish giving or refining ingredient, is compounded with a word meaning, victuals and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Dative -4th case is compounded with what denotes that which is for the purpose of what ends with the Dative -4th case and so too with the words अर्थ 'on account of', बलि 'a sacrifice', हित 'salutary', सुख 'pleasure' and रक्षित 'kept' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Ablative -5th case-affix is optionally compounded with the word भय 'fear' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Ablative -5th case-affix is compounded with the words अपेत 'gone away', अपोध 'carried away', मुक्त 'freed', पतित 'fallen', अपत्रस्त 'afraid of', when the event takes place in a gradual manner and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: Words with a sense of स्तोक 'a little', अन्तिक 'near', दूर 'far' and कृच्छ्र 'penance', ending in the Ablative -5th case are compounded with what ends in क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending in the Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with the words शौण्ड 'skilled' etc. and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with the words सिद्ध 'perfected', शुष्क 'dried', पक्व 'cooked', and बन्ध 'bound' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending in the Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with the words ध्वाङ्क्ष 'a crow' and synonyms of crow when contempt is implied and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with words ending with कृत्य-affix (a Future Passive Participle) and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the Locative -7th-case-affix is invariably compounded with a word ending in a case-affix, when the compound thus formed is used as an appellative and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The names of divisions of day or night ending with Locative -7th-case-affix are compounded with words ending with affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The word तत्र 'there' which is a word ending with Locative -7th-case-affix सप्तम्यास्त्रल् [[5.3.10]], is compounded with a word ending in क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The word ending in Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with a word ending with the affix क्त when 'censure' is implied and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The words like पात्रे-सम्मित 'a dish-companion' (a parasite) etc. are तत्-पुरुष compounds when contempt is implied.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A case-inflected word denoting an action which naturally precedes in time (पूर्वकाल) and the words एक 'one', सर्व 'all' जरत 'old', पुराण 'ancient', नव 'new', and केवल 'only' are compounded with their co-relative case-inflected words which are in the same case with them and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The words expressing a point of the compass or a number (संख्या ) enter into composition with the word correlated to them by being in the same case, when the sense of the compound is that of an appellative and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: In a case where the sense is that of a तद्धित-affix or when an additional member comes after the compound or when an aggregate is to be expressed, then a word signifying a point of the compass or a number, enters into composition with a case-inflected word which is in agreement with it by being in the same case and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: In a case where the sense is that of a तद्धित-affix or when an additional member comes after the compound or when an aggregate is to be expressed, the compound, the first member of which is numeral, is called द्विगु (Numeral Determinative Compound).

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: Case-inflected words expressing vileness are compounded with case-inflected words, expressing contempt and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The case-inflected words पाप 'sin' and अणक 'insignificant' are compounded with words expressive of vileness and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: Case-inflected words denoting objects of comparison are compounded with words denoting what is likened to them, by reason of the latter possessing qualities in common with the former and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A case-inflected word denoting subject of comparison is compounded with the words व्याघ्र 'tiger' etc., the latter being the standard of comparison and in construction with the former and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ; provided that any word expressing the common characteristic (सामान्य) as explained above, is not used.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A case-inflected word denoting the qualifier (the Adjective), is compounded diversely with a case-inflected word denoting the thing thereby qualified, (the Substantive), the latter being in agreement (same case) with the former and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A case-inflected words पूर्व 'prior', अपर 'other', प्रथम 'first', चरम 'last', जघन्य 'hindmost', समान 'equal', मध्य 'middle', मध्यम 'middle', and वीर 'hero' are compounded with words ending with a case-affix and which are in agreement (same case) with them and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The case-inflected words श्रेणी 'class' etc. are compounded with words कृत् 'made' etc. which are in agreement (same case), with them and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with the affix क्त and not having the negative augment नञ् is compounded with the same word ending with the affix क्त but which is distinguished from the former, by having the augment नञ् and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The words सत् 'good, महत् 'great', परम 'highest', उत्तम 'best' and उत्कृष्ट 'excellent' are compounded with the words denoting the person deserving the respect and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A case-inflected word denoting object deserving of respect is compounded with the words वृन्दारक 'eminent', नाग 'serpent or elephant', कुञ्जर 'elephant' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The words कतर 'which or who of two', and कतम 'which or who of many', when used in asking questions about the genus or class, are compounded with the other case-inflected words with which they are in construction and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The word किम् 'what', when implying 'contempt' is compounded with a word ending in case-affix and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A case-inflected word denoting a genus (जाति) is compounded with the words पोटा 'a hermaphrodite', युवति 'a young female', स्तोक 'a little', कतिपय 'a few', गृष्टि 'a cow which has had only one calf', धेनु 'milch cow', वशा 'a barren female', वेहद् 'a cow that miscarries', बष्कयणी 'a cow that has a full-grown calf', प्रवक्तृ 'an expounder', श्रोत्रिय 'a learned ब्राह्मण ', अध्यापक 'a teacher' and धूर्त 'a cunning fellow' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A case-inflected word denoting a genus (जाति) is compounded with a word denoting praise and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The word युवा 'young' is compounded with the words खलति 'bald headed', पलित 'grey-haired', वलिन 'wrinkled', जरति 'decayed', when they are in agreement (same case) and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: Words ending with कृत् -affix and the word तुल्य 'equal' and its synonyms are compounded with words which do not denote genus (जाति) being in the same case with them and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A case-inflected word denoting 'colour' is compounded with another case-inflected word which is in agreement with the former and also denotes colour and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The word कुमार 'a boy' is compounded with co-ordinate words श्रमण 'an ascetic' etc. and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A case-inflected word denoting a quadruped is compounded with the co-ordinate word गर्भिणी and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The words पूर्व 'front', अपर 'near', अधर 'lower', उत्तर 'upper', are compounded when in construction with a word signifying a thing that has parts, provided that the thing having parts is distinguished numerically by unity; and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The word अर्द्ध when it signifies exactly equal parts i.e. halves, is always neuter and is compounded with a word signifying a thing that has parts, provided that the thing halved is numerically one; and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The words द्वितीय 'second', तृतीय 'third', चतुर्थ 'fourth', तुर्य 'fourth', are optionally compounded with that word which signifies a thing that has parts, provided that the thing having parts is distinguished numerically by unity. The compound so formed is called तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The words प्राप्त 'obtained', and आपन्न 'obtained' are optionally compounded with words ending in a Second Case-affix and form तत्-पुरुष compound.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: Words denoting time are compounded when in construction, with words denoting the object whose duration is measured by the time, and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The negative word नञ् is compounded with a case-inflected word with which it is in construction, and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The word ईषत् 'a little' is compounded with a case-inflected word which does not end with a कृत् affix and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is compounded with a case-inflected word with which it is in construction and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is compounded with the word याजक 'sacrificer' etc. and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word in the genitive case is not compounded with another, when the force of the sixth case-affix is that of specification (निर्धारण).

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending in a sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word having the sense of an ordinal, an attribute, or satisfaction, or with a participle ending in the suffix सत् 3.2127, or an indeclinable, or ending with the affix तव्य , or with a word denoting the same object (i.e. when they are in apposition).

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with the affix क्त , when the force of क्त is to denote 'respect' etc.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with the affix क्त , when the force of the latter is to denote 'locality' in which something happened

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is not compounded with another, when the force of the genitive is that of the accusative.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with त्रिच् or अक , when the force of the genitive case is that of an agent.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with त्रिच् or अक affix when the force of these latter affixes is that of an agent.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is invariably compounded with a word ending with अक , when these affixes denote a sport or livelihood; and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: The indeclinable word कु 'bad' , the particles called गति and the prepositions प्र etc. are invariably compounded with other words with which they are in construction and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: An उपपद of attendant word तत्रोपपदं सप्तमीस्थम् [[3.1.92]] which does not end with a tense-affix [[3.4.78]] is invariably compounded with that with which it is in construction. The compound thus formed is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: When an उपपद is compounded with an indeclinable, then it is compounded only with those अव्ययs which end in the affix अम्।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: An उपपद ending in third case-affix [[3.4.47]] etc. is compounded optionally with an indeclinable formed by the affix अम् and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः
items.english: An उपपद ending in third case-affix or any other of the remaining four cases, is optionally compounded with a word ending with the affix क्तवा and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: The remaining compound is called बहुव्रीही।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: Two or more words, ending in any case-affix, form compound, denoting another new thing, not connoted by those words individually and the compound is called बहुव्रीही।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: indeclinable words and the words आसन्न 'near', अदूर 'near', अधिक 'more' and the words called संख्या (Numerals) are compounded with another संख्या word, when the sense is that of a numeral or संख्या। The compound is बहुव्रीही।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: Words which are the names of the points of the compass are compounded, when the compound signifies the intermediate point and the compound so formed is बहुव्रीही।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: Two homonymous words (both being in the locative case or both being in the instrumental case) are compounded, the sense being 'this happens therein or with that'. The compound so formed is बहुव्रीही।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: The word सह 'together' is compounded with a word ending with the third case-affix and the compound is बहुव्रीही ; provided that, the companion and the person accompanied are equally effected by any action or thing, in the same manner.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: When a set of several words ending with case-affixes stands in a relation expressable by 'and' the set is made into a compound and the compound so formed is called द्वन्द्व।

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: The उपसर्जन [[1.2.43]] is to be placed first in a compound.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: The उपसर्जन is to be put last in the words राजदन्त etc.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: In a द्वन्द्व compound, let a word called घि [[1.4.7]], stand first.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: In a द्वन्द्व compound, let a what begins with a vowel and ends with a short अ be placed first.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: In a द्वन्द्व compound, that word-form which has fewer vowels, is to be placed first.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: A word with the seventh case-affix and an epithet are to be placed first in the बहुव्रीही compound.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: What ends with a निष्ठा [[1.1.26]] shall stand first in a बहुव्रीही compound.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: In the compounds अहिताग्नि and the like, the निष्ठा-formed word may optionally be placed first.

items.adhikara: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा
items.english: The words कडाराः and the like, are optionally placed first in the कर्मधार्य।
The word अनभिहिते meaning 'not being specified' is to be understood as the governing word.
When the object is not denoted by the termination of the verb i.e. when the verb does not agree with it, the 2nd case-affix is attached to the word.
In the छन्दस् (Veda), the object of the verb हु 'to sacrifice' takes the affix of the 3rd case and of the 2nd case as well.
A word joined with (or governed by) the word अन्तरा or अन्तरेण takes the second case-affix.
After a word denoting time, or length, the affix of the 2nd case is used, when denoting a full duration.
The 3rd case-affix is used after the words denoting the duration of time or place, when the accomplishment of the desired object is meant to be expressed.

A noun denoting time or place gets the affix of the 7th or the 5th case when the sense applied is that the time or space is the interval between one action and another (or implies an interval of time and space between कारक-s.
The 2nd case-affix is employed after a word which is joined with a कर्मप्रवचनीयाः [[1.4.83]].
Where a word is governed by a कर्मप्रवचनीयाः [[1.4.83]] in the sense of 'more than' उपोऽधिके च [[1.4.87]] or 'lord of' अधिरीश्वरे [[1.4.97]] there the 7th case-affix (locative) is used.
The 5th case-affix (Ablative) is used when a word is governed by the following कर्मप्रवचनीयाः [[1.4.83]] i.e. अप , आङ् and परि।
The 5th case-affix (Ablative) is used after whatsoever is governed by a कर्मप्रवचनीयाः [[1.4.83]] in the sense of 'substitute' or 'exchange' -- प्रतिः प्रतिनिधिप्रतिदानयोः [[1.4.92]].

In the case of roots implying motion, the place which the motion is directed takes the affix of the 2nd (Accusative) or the 4th (Dative) case in denoting the 'object', when physical motion is meant and the object is not a word expressing 'road'.
In denoting the सम्प्रदान-कारक -- कर्मणा यमभिप्रैति स सम्प्रदानम् [[1.4.32]], the 4th case-affix of the Dative is used after the noun.

The 4th case-affix is employed in denoting the object (कर्म) of that verb, which is suppressed (स्थानी) in a sentence and which has in construction (उपपद) there-with another verb, denoting an action, performed for the sake of the future action -- तुमुन्ण्वुलौ क्रियायां क्रियार्थायाम्[[3.3.10]]. In other words, when the sense of an infinitive of purpose formed by तुमुन् and ण्वुल् -- [[3.3.10]], is suppressed in a sentence, the object of this infinitive is put in the Dative -- 4th case.
The 4th case-affix is used after a crude-form which ends in an affix denoting 'condition' (abstract noun -- भाववचनाश्च [[3.3.11]]) and having the force of the affix तुम् (or Infinitive or purpose).

The 4th case-affix is used in conjunction with the words नमः 'salutation', स्वस्ति 'peace', स्वाहा , स्वधा (terms used in offering oblations to Gods and पित्रि-s, respectively), अलम् , 'a match for', 'sufficient for' and वषट् , a term for oblation.
In denoting the indirect object, which is not an animal, of the verb मन्य 'to think', the Dative -- 4th case is optionally used, when contempt is to be shown.
In denoting the agent -- स्वतन्त्रः कर्ता [[1.4.54]], or the instrument -- साधकतमं करणम् [[1.4.42]], the 3rd case is used.
When the word सह 'with', is joined to a word the latter takes the 3rd case, when the sense is that the word in the 3rd case is not the principal but the accompaniment of the principal thing.
By whatsoever limb, being defective, is pointed out the defect of the person after that the 3rd case-affix is used.
Any mark or attribute, by which is indicated the existence of a particular state or condition, is put in the 3rd case to express this relation.
After the verb सम्-ज्ञः , the 3rd case-affix is optionally used in denoting the object.
When the word denotes 'cause' it takes the 3rd case-affix.
A word implying 'debt', considered as a 'cause' but not as कर्तृ or agent, takes the 5th case-affix.
