The 5th case-affix is used optionally when the noun expresses an attribute, being the cause of an action and not being of the feminine gender.
The 6th-Case-affix is used after a noun implying the cause of an action, when the word हेतु is used along with such a word.
After a सर्वनामस्थान -- सर्वादीनि सर्वनामानि [[1.1.27]], when it signifies the cause of an action and the word हेतु is used with it, the 3rd case-affix is used, as well as the 6th.
When the अपादान कारक -- ध्रुवमपायेऽपादानम् [[1.4.24]], is denoted, the 5th case-affix is used.

When a noun is joined with words meaning 'other than' or with आरात् 'near or remote', or इतर 'different from' or ऋते 'without', or words indicative of 'directions' (used also with reference to the time corresponding to them) or with words having अञ्चु 'to bend' as the last member of the compound and expressive of direction, or with words ending with the affix आच् -- दक्षिणादाच् [[5.3.36]] or आहि -- आहि च दूरे [[5.3.37]], the 5th case-affix is used.
The 6th-Case-affix is used when used in connection with words ending with affixes having the sense of the affix अतसुच -- दक्षिणोत्तराभ्यामतसुच् [[5.3.28]].
With a word ending with the affix एनाप् -- एनबन्यतरस्यामदूरेऽपञ्चम्याः [[5.3.35]], the 2nd case-affix is used, as well as the 6th.
When joined with the words पृथक् 'without', विना 'without' and नाना 'without', the 3rd case-affix is used, optionally (as well as the 5th and the 2nd).

When expressing an instrument-कारक, optionally after the words स्तोक 'little', अल्प 'little', कृच्छ्र 'difficulty' and कतिपय 'some', the 5th case-affix is used, when they do not denote material objects.
When in conjunction with words having the sense of दूर 'distant' and अन्तिक 'near', the 6th-Case-affix is optionally used.
After the words दूर 'distant' and अन्तिक 'near', the 2nd case-affix is used as well as the 5th and the 3rd.
The 7th case-affix is used when the sense is that of location -- आधारोऽधिकरणम् [[1.4.45]], as well as after the words meaning 'distant' and 'near'.
By the action (भाव) of whatsoever, the time of another action is indicated, that takes the 7th case-affix.
The 6th-Case-affix is used (as well as the 7th), when disregard is to be shown after that by whose action the time of another action is indicated.

The 6th and the 7th case-affixes are used after words when they are joined with स्वामिन् 'master', ईश्वर 'lord', अधिपति 'ruler', दायाद 'an heir', साक्षिन् 'witness', प्रतिभू 'a surety' and प्रसूत 'begotten'.
In conjunction with the words आयुक्त 'engaged', and कुशल 'skilful', when meaning entire absorption in an engagement, the 6th and the 7th case-affixes are used after a word.
The 6th and the 7th case-affixes are used after those words from which specification is made, (as of an individual from the whole class).
The 5th case-affix is used when the thing specified is different or divided from (and not included in) that from which specification is intended.
In conjunction with the words साधु 'good' and निपुण 'skilful' when they denote respect, the 7th case-affix is used, provided that the word प्रति is not used.
In conjunction with the words प्रसिक्त and उत्सुक 'greatly desirous of', the 3rd case-affix is used after the word, as well as the 7th.
When an affix declaring the time of an Asterism is elided by लुप् -- लुबविशेषे [[4.2.4]], the 7th and the 3rd case-affixes are used after the word, whose affix is also elided.
Where the sense is that of the Nominal-stem -- अर्थवदधातुरप्रत्ययः प्रातिपदिकम् [[1.2.45]], or of gender only, or measure only or number only, the 1st case-affix is used.
And when the sense is that of addressing, the 1st case-affix is used.
The word ending with the 1st case-affix, in the sense of addressing, is called आमन्त्रित or Vocative.
The प्रथमा-एकवचन when used in the context of  सम्बोधन gets the term  'सम्बुद्धि'.

The 6th-Case-affix is used in the remaining cases, that is to say, where there is a sense, such as the relation between property and its owner etc. different from that of a word related to a verb and from that of a Nominal-stem.
Of the verb ज्ञा , when not used in the sense 'to know', the instrument takes the 6th-Case-affix.
Of the verbs having the sense of 'remembering', (अधिक्), and of दय 'to give', 'to pity', 'to protect', 'to move' and of ईश 'to rule or be master of', the object takes the 6th-Case-affix.
The object of the verb कृ takes the 6th-Case-affix, when it means 'to impart a new quality or virtue' -- गन्धनावक्षेपणसेवनसाहसिक्यप्रतियत्नप्रकथनोपयोगेषु कृञः [[1.3.32]].

The object of verbs having the sense of रुज् 'to afflict', with the exception of the Causative verb ज्वरय 'to be feverish', takes the 6th-Case-affix, when the verb expresses a condition (i.e. when the subject is an Abstract noun).
Of the verb नाथ् when meaning 'to bless', the object takes the 6th-Case-affix.
The object of the verbs जासि 'to strike', 'to hurt', हन् 'to strike' preceded by नि and ग्र , नाट् 'to injure', क्राथ and पिष when they mean 'to injure', takes the 6th-Case-affix.
The object of the verbs व्यवहृ and पण् when they ae synonymous, that is when they mean 'dealing in sale and purchase transactions' or 'staking in gambling' takes the 6th-Case-affix.
The object of the verb दिव् when having the above-mentioned sense of 'dealing' or 'stalking', takes the 6th-Case.
The object of the verb दिव् when having the above-mentioned sense of 'dealing' or 'stalking', optionally takes the 6th-Case, when preceded by an उपसर्ग (preposition).
The object of the verb दिव् when having the above-mentioned sense of 'dealing' or 'stalking', takes the 2nd case, in the ब्राह्मण literature.

The object of the verb प्रेष्य and ब्रूहि (imperative singular of दिवादि verb, meaning 'send' and 'utter') denoting sacrificial food, takes the 6th-Case-affix, when making offerings to deity is meant or when deity is the recipient.
In the छन्दस् the 6th-Case-affix is used diversely with the force of the 4th case-affix.
The 6th-Case-affix is diversely used in the छन्दस् in denoting the instrument of the verb यज् 'to sacrifice'.

The 6th-Case-affix is used in denoting location (अधिकरण) after a word denoting time (काल) when used along with a word ending with an affix having the sense of कृत्वसुच् -- संख्यायाः क्रियाऽभ्यावृत्तिगणने कृत्वसुच् [[5.4.17]] 'so many times'.
The 6th-Case-affix is used after a word, in denoting the agent and the object, when used along with a word ending with a कृत्-affix --कृदतिङ् [[3.1.93]].

When the agent and the object of the action denoted by the words formed by कृत्-affixes, are both used in a sentence, in the object only, the 6th-Case-affix is employed and not in the agent (the object is put in the Genitive 6th-Case and not the Agent).
The past participle ending in क्त when used in the sense of the present tense, -- ञीतः क्तः [[3.2.187]] and -- मतिबुद्धिपूजार्थेभ्यश्च [[3.2.188]] , is used with the Genitive 6th-Case.
The past participle ending in क्त is used with the Genitive 6th-Case, when the former expresses location -- क्तोऽधिकरणे च ध्रौव्यगतिप्रत्यवसानार्थेभ्यः [[3.4.76]].

The 6th-Case-affix is not used the express the agent or the object, when the word is governed by an Active Participle ending in the affix ल , or उ , or उक or an indeclinable, or by a Past Participle in the क्त and क्तवतु or by a word ending in an affix having the sense of खल् or by a Noun of agency formed by तृन्।
The 6th-Case-affix is not used when the word is governed by a verbal noun in अक denoting futurity, or in a इन् denoting 'futurity and indebtedness'.
The 6th-Case-affix is optionally used in denoting the agent, (but not the object), when the word is governed by a Future Passive Participle (कृत्य).
The 3rd or the 6th-Case-affix may optionally be employed, when the word is joined with another word meaning 'like to or resemblance', excepting तुला and उपना।

The 4th as well as the 6th-Case-affix may be used, when blessing is intended in connection with the words आयुष 'long life', मद्र 'joy', भद्र 'good fortune', कुशल 'welfare', सुख 'happiness', अर्थ 'prosperity' and हित 'good'.

All affixes after the verb गाङ् 'to study' and the verb कुट् 'to be crooked' and the rest, are as if they had an indicatory ङ् (ङित्), except those affixes which have an indicatory ञ् (ञित्) or ण् (णित्).
An affix which begins with the augment इट् -- आर्धधातुकस्येड् वलादेः [[7.2.35]], is ङित् after the root विज् 'to fear, to move'.
A द्वन्द compound or words signifying persons belonging to the different Vedic-schools, when the sense is that of repetition is singular.
A द्वन्द compound of words denoting क्रतु (sacrifices) ordained by यजुर् (अध्वर्यु) Veda, is singular, provided they are never used in the neuter gender
A द्वन्द compound of words denoting (persons who have studied) subjects, which in their order of study are not remote from each other, is singular.
A द्वन्द compound of words signifying जाति (genus) which are not the names of living beings, is singular.
A द्वन्द compound of words of different genders, denoting names of rivers and countries, but not of towns, is singular.
A द्वन्द compound of words signifying small animals, is singular.
A द्वन्द compound of words signifying those animals only among whom there is permanent enmity i.e. natural and eternal antipathy or quarrel, is singular.
A द्वन्द compound of words denoting those classes of शुद्रा-s who have not been expelled from the communion of higher classes, is singular.
The word गवाश and others are also द्वन्द compounds which take the singular number.
A द्वन्द compound of words being the names of trees, wild animals, grass, corn, condiment, domestic beasts and birds and the compounds अश्व-वडव , पूर्व-पर and अधरोत्तर , are optionally singular.
A द्वन्द compound of words of contrary significations, but not being the names of concrete substances.
The द्वन्द compounds like दधिपय etc. are not singular.
A द्वन्द compound denoting a fixed number (एकत्व) of concrete things (अधिकरण) is not singular.
A द्वन्द compound denoting an approximate number of concrete substances, is optionally singular.
It, namely the द्विगु or द्वन्द compound, with regard to which singular number has been ordained by the above rules, is always neuter gender.
An अव्ययीभाव -- अव्ययं विभक्तिसमीपसमृद्धिव्यृद्ध्यर्थाभावात्ययासम्प्रतिशब्दप्रादुर्भावपश्चाद्यथाऽऽनुपूर्व्ययौगपद्यसादृश्यसम्पत्तिसाकल्यान्तवचनेषु [[2.1.6]], compound is also neuter gender.
A तत्-पुरुष compound, with the exception of that which is formed by the particle नञ् , and or the कर्मधारय compound, becomes neuter gender, in the cases explained in the following sūtras.
When denoting an appellative, a तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word कन्था 'town', is neuter in gender, provided that it is the name of a town situated in a country of the उशीनर-s.

A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the words उपज्ञा 'invention' and उपक्रम 'commencement' is neuter in gender, when it is intended to express the starting point of a work which is first invented or commenced.
A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word छाया 'shadow' in neuter in gender when the sense is that of profuseness of the thing indicated by the first term.
A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word सभा 'court' is neuter, provided that it is preceded by (a word synonymous with) the word राजा or by a word denoting a non-human-being.
A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word सभा 'court', when it does not mean a house but means concourse, is neuter.

A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the words सेना 'army', सुरा 'wine', छाया 'shadow', शाला 'house' and निशा 'night', is optionally neuter, with the exception of that which is formed by the particle नञ् -- नञ् [[2.2.6]], and the कर्मधारय compound.
The gender of द्वन्द compound or तत्-पुरुष compound is like that of the last word in it.
The gender of the compound of the word अश्व 'horse' and वडव 'a mare', is like that of the first word in it.
Of the compounds हेमन्त-शिशिरौ and अहोरात्रे , the gender is like that of the first word, in the छन्दस् ।
The द्वन्द and तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the words रात्र and अह्न are spoken of in masculine.
The तत्-पुरुष word अपथम् 'a bad road', is neuter.
The words अर्धर्च etc. are spoken of in masculine and neuter.

In the room of इदम् 'this', in the case of its re-employment in a subsequent member of the same sentence and referring to the same thing (अन्वादेश) there is the substitution of अश् which is अनुदात्त (gravely accented), when the Instrumental -3rd case-affix and the rest follow.

In the room of एतद् in the case of re-employment there is the substitution of the gravely accented अश् when the affixes त्र -- सप्तम्यास्त्रल् [[5.3.10]] and तस् -- पञ्चम्यास्तसिल् [[5.3.7]] follow, and the affixes त्र and तद् are अनुदात्त (gravely accented) also.
When an affix of the Accusative -2nd case or टा - Instrumental -3rd case singular or ओश् Locative -7th-case dual follows, एन् which is अनुदात्त is the substitute of इदम् and its re-employment.
The clause 'when the affix is आर्धधातुक is understood in the following sūtras up to sūtra [[2.4.58]].
The word जग्धि is the substitute of अद् 'to eat', when the affix ल्यप् -- समासेऽनञ्पूर्वे क्त्वो ल्यप् [[7.1.37]] or an आर्धधातुक कित् affix beginning with a त follows.
When लुङ् (Aorist) or सन् (Desiderative) follows घसॢ is the substitute of अद् 'to eat'.
And when the affix घञ् and अप् follow घसॢ is the substitute of अद्।
In the छन्दस् (Vedas), घसॢ is diversely substituted for अद्।
When लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows घसॢ is optionally the substitute of अद्।
When लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows, वयि is optionally the substitute follows of वेञ् 'to weave'.
बध् is the substitute of हन् 'to kill' when the आर्धधातुक लिङ् (Benedictive) follows.
And when लुङ् (Aorist) follows वध is the substitute of हन्।
When आत्मनेपद affixes follow, वध् is optionally the substitute of हन् in the लुङ् (Aorist).
गा is the substitute of the root इण् when लुङ् (Aorist) follows.
When the affix णि (causal follows, गामि is the substitute of इण् when the sense is not that of 'informing' but that of 'going'.
And when सन् (Desiderative) follows, गमि is the substitute of ण् when the sense is not that of 'informing'.
And of इङ् 'to study', गमि is the substitute when सन् follows.
गाम् is the substitute of इङ् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.
गाङ् is optionally the substitute of इङ् when लुङ् (Aorist) and ऌङ् (Conditional Future) follow.
गाङ् is optionally the substitute of इङ् is the causative णि , when that causative takes the affix सन् (Desiderative) and चन् (Aorist).
भू is the substitute of the verb अस् 'to be' when an आर्धधातुक affix is to be applied.
वचि is the substitute of ब्रू 'to speak' when any आर्धधातुक affix is to be supplied.
ख्याञ् is the substitute of चक्षिङ् 'to perceive, to tell', when any आर्धधातुक affix is to be applied.
ख्याञ् is optionally the substitute of चक्षिङ् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.
वी is the substitute of the verb अज् 'to drive', 'to lead', when an आर्धधातुक affix follows, with the exception of the affixes घञ् -- भावे [[3.3.18]] and अप् -- समुदोरजः पशुषु [[3.3.69]].
वी is optionally the substitute of अज् when the affix -- अनद्यतने लुट् [[3.3.15]] etc. follows.

After a word ending with the गोत्र affix ण्य -- कुर्वादिभ्यो ण्यः [[4.1.151]] and after a गोत्र word denoting the descendant of a क्षत्रिय or a ऋषि 'seer' and after a word ending with a गोत्र affix having an indicatory ञ् , the affix ञ् , the affix अण् and इञ् employed in the forming युवन् -- जीवति तु वंश्ये युवा [[4.1.163]], descendants, are elided by the substitution of लुक्।
And after the words पैल etc. there is the लुक् elision of the युवन् affix.
After a word ending in the गोत्र affix -- [[4.1.95]], there is elision of लुक् of the युवन् affix, when the गोत्र of the people called प्राच्य 'Eastern' is denoted.
After the words तौल्वलि and the rest, there is no लुक् elision of the युवन् affix.

There is लुक् elision of तद्राज -- ते तद्राजाः [[4.1.174]], affix, when the word is used in the plural number, provided that the plural number is taken by the base itself and not by its standing as a compound epithet dependent upon another word and provided that the base is not used in the feminine.

After the word यस्क etc. there is the लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix when the word of itself and not as part of a compound epithet dependent on another word, takes the plural; but not in the feminine.

And there is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix यञ् -- गर्गादिभ्यो यञ् [[4.1.105]] and अञ् -- अनृष्यानन्तर्ये बिदादिभ्योऽञ् [[4.1.104]], when the word of itself and not as part of a compound epithet dependent on another, takes the plural, but not in the feminine.
After the words अत्रि , भृगु , कुत्स , वशिष्ठ , गोतम , अङ्गिरस , there is elision of the गोत्र affix, when the word takes the plural, but not in the feminine.

And there is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix इञ् -- गोत्राद्यून्यस्त्रियाम् [[4.1.95]] after a word containing many vowels (a poly-syllabic word) which denotes the गोत्र of the people called प्राच्य and भरत when the word takes the plural.
After the words गोपवन etc. there is not लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix, when the word takes the plural.
After the words तिक , कितब etc. when used as द्वन्द compound, there is the लुक् elision of the गोत्र affixes when the compound word takes the plural.
After the words उपक etc. there is optionally लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix when the words take the plural whether they enter into द्वन्द compound or are used separately.

There is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affixes अण् and यञ् of the words अगस्त्य , and कौणडिन्य , when they take the plural and the words अगस्ति and कण्डिनच् are the substitutes of the bases so remaining after the elision.
A सुप् प्रत्यय that comes as a part of a धातु or a प्रातिपदिक is removed.
After the verb अद् 'to eat' and the rest there is लुक् elision of the विकरण शप् -- कर्तरि शप् [[3.1.68]].
In the छन्दस् (Vedas) there is diversely the लुक् elision of the विकरण शप् -- कर्तरि शप् [[3.1.68]].
And there is diversely the लुक् elision of यङ् -- धातोरेकाचो हलादेः क्रियासमभिहारे यङ् [[3.1.22]], when the affix अच् -- नन्दिग्रहिपचादिभ्यो ल्युणिन्यचः [[3.1.134]], follows.
After the verbs हू 'to sacrifice' and others there is श्लु elision of the विकरण शप् -- कर्तरि शप् [[3.1.68]].
In the छन्दस् (Vedas) there is elision of the शप् diversely.
For the verb roots गा, स्था, पा, भू and the verb roots referred as  'घु', the सिच्-विकरण is removed when followed by the  प्रत्यय of परस्मैपद.
For the verbs घ्रा, धेट्, शो, छो and सो, the सिच्-प्रत्यय is removed optionally when followed by a प्रत्यय of परस्मैपद.
After the verbs तन् 'to expand' and others there is optionally the लुक् elision of सिच् when the आत्मनेपद affixes त and थास् of the 2nd Person follow.

In the मन्त्र portion of the Vedas there is लुक् elision of the sign of the Aorist (& लिट् -Perfect Tense) after the verbs घस् 'to eat', हूर् 'to be crooked', णश् 'to destroy', वृ 'to choose, to cover', दह् 'to burn', verbs ending in long आ , वृच् 'to avoid', कृ 'to make', गमि 'to go' and जनि 'to be produced'.
The लकार that follows the 'आम्' प्रत्यय is removed.
The आप्-प्रत्ययाः and the सुप्-प्रत्ययाः attached to an अव्यय are removed by doing a लुक्.
There is not लुक् elision of the case-affix after an अव्ययीभाव compound that ends in आ ; आम् is the substitute of its case-affix es, but not when it is the 5th case-affix.
The change to अम् of the Instrumental -3rd case and Locative -7th-case-affixes coming after an अव्ययीभाव compound that ends in अ , occurs diversely.
The प्रथमपुरुष प्रत्ययाः of लुट्-लकार are converted respectively to डा, रौ and रस्.
Everything told in this अधिकार are known as प्रत्ययाः.
All the words told in this अधिकार are to be attached at the end of the प्रकृति.
The first स्वर of all the प्रत्ययाः mentioned in this अधिकार becomes उदात्त.
The first letter of the सुप् and the पित् प्रत्ययाः is अनुदात्त.
After the verbs गुप् , तिज् and कित् comes the affix सन्।

The affix सन् comes after the verbs मान 'to honour', बध् 'to bind', दान् 'to cut', and शान् 'to whet', and long ई is the substitute of इ -- सन्यतः [[7.4.79]] of the re-duplicate -- पूर्वोऽभ्यासः [[6.1.4]] syllable.
The affix is optionally attached, in the sense of 'wishing' after a root expressing the object wished and having the same agent of the action as the wisher thereof.
The affix क्यच् is optionally employed, in the sense of wishing after a word ending in a case-affix expressing the object wished as connected with the wisher itself.
And the affix काम्यच् is also used in the sense of 'wishing' after a word ending in a case-affix, expressing the object wished as connected with the wisher's self.
The affix क्यच् is optionally employed, in the sense of treatment after a word ending in a case-affix denoting the object of comparison.

The affix क्यङ् is optionally used in the sense of 'behaving' after a word ending in a case-affix denoting the object of comparison of the agent and there is लोप (elision) of the final स of the noun if it ends in a स।

The affix क्यङ् in the sense of becoming what the thing previously was not, is used after the crude forms भृश् etc. which do not end with the affix च्वि -- अभूततद्भावे कृभ्वस्तियोगे सम्पद्यकर्तरि च्विः [[5.4.50]], and there is लोप (elision) of the final consonant of these words, if they end in a consonant.

The affix क्यष् in the sense of becoming what the thing previously was not, is used after the words लोहित etc. and after those that end with the affix डाच् -- अव्यक्तानुकरणाद्द्व्यजवरार्धादनितौ डाच् [[5.4.57]], when these words do not take the affix च्वि -- अव्यक्तानुकरणाद्द्व्यजवरार्धादनितौ डाच् [[5.4.57]].
The affix क्यङ् in the sense of exerting in the dishonesty, is employed after the word कष्ट 'mischief' when the latter has the 4th case-affix in construction.
The affix क्यङ् is used after the words रोमन्य 'ruminating' and तपस 'austerity', when they are used as the objects of the action of repeating and performing respectively.
The affix क्यङ् is used in the sense of ejecting after the words वाष्प 'vapour' and ऊष्म 'heat' as the object of the action.
The affix क्यङ् , in the sense of 'making', comes after these words, as the object of the action, viz. शब्द 'sound', वैर 'hostility', कलह 'strife', अभ्र 'cloud', कण्व 'sin' and मेध 'cloud'.
The affix क्यङ् in the sense of 'feeling', comes after the words सुख 'pleasure' etc. when the pleasure etc. belong to the agent as feels thereof.
The affix in the sense of 'making', comes after these words, as the object of the action, viz. नमस् 'adoration', वरिवस् 'honour', चित्र 'wonder'.
The affix णिङ् , in the sense of making, comes after these words as the object of the action, viz. पुच्छ 'tail', भाण्ड 'pot' and चीवर 'rag'.

The affix णिच् , in the sense of 'making' comes after these words as the object of action viz. मुण्ड 'shaving', मिश्र 'mixture', श्लक्ष्ण 'soft', लवण 'salt', व्रत 'vow', वस्त्र 'dress', हल 'plough', कल 'strife', कृत 'done' and तूस्त 'matter hair'.
The affix वङ् , in the sense of repetition of the act, comes after a root, having a single vowel and beginning with a consonant.
The affix वङ् invariably comes in the sense of 'crookedness' after a simple verb expressing motion.

The affix वङ् when it is intended to convey the sense of contempt (गर्हा) in respect of the sense of the root (भाव) comes always after the following roots - लुप् 'to cut off', सद् 'to sit', चर् 'to walk', जप् 'to mutter silently any sacred formula', जभ 'to gape or yawn', दह् 'to burn', दश् 'to bite' and गृ 'to swallow'.

The affix णिच् is used after these words - सत्य 'truth' (which then takes the form of सत्याप as exhibited in the sūtra), पाश 'a fetter', रूप 'form', वीणा 'a lute', तूल 'cotton', श्लोक 'celebration', सेना 'army', लोम 'the hair of the body', त्वच 'skin', वर्म 'mail', वर्ण 'celebration', चूर्ण 'powder' and the verb of the चुरादि class.
The affix णिच् is used after a root, when the operation of a causer is to be expressed.
The affix यक् is used after the roots कण्डु 'to itch' etc.
The affix आय comes after गुपू 'to protect', धूप 'to heat', विच्छ 'to approach', पण 'to contract or praise' and पन 'to praise'.
The affix ईयङ् comes after the sūtra root ऋति 'to reproach'.
The affix णिङ् comes after the root कम 'to desire'.
The affixes आय and those that follow it i.e. आय , ईयङ् and णिङ् are optionally added, when it is desired to express one's self with an आर्धधातुक affix.
The words ending in a सनादि प्रत्यय are called 'धातु'.
In case of लृट् लकार and  लृङ्लकार, the अङ्ग gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'स्य'. In case of  लुट्लकार, the अङ्ग gets the विकरणप्रत्यय तास्.
सिप् is diversely the affix of a verbal root when लेट् follows.
आम् is the affix of the verb कास् 'to cough' and of those roots that are formed by affixes i.e. the derivative verbs, when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows, in the मन्त्र।

items.anvaya: इजादेः गुरुमतः अनृच्छः धातोः लिटि आम् प्रत्ययः परश्च
items.english: A verb which can be called as 'इजादिः गुरुमान्' gets an आम् प्रत्यय when followed by लिट्-लकार. However, this प्रत्यय is not seen for the verb root ऋच्छ्.
After the words दय 'to give', 'to go' and 'to protect', अय 'to go' and आस 'to sit', there is the affix आम् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.
The affix आम् is optionally used after these - उष् 'to burn', विद् 'to know' and जागृ 'to wake', when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

आम् is optionally affixed when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows after these verbs - भी 'to fear', ह्री 'to be ashamed', भृ 'to nourish', हु 'to sacrifice' and when आम् is affixed, the effect is as if there were श्लु elision and the roots belonged to ह्वादि class.
The लिट्-लकार forms of verb roots कृ, भू, and अस् are applied after the आम्-प्रत्यय.
The form विदाङ्कुर्वन्तु is optionally employed as an irregular form.
The forms अभ्युत्सादयामकः प्रजनयामकः चिकयामकः रमयामकः पावयांक्रियाद् विदामक्रन् are irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).
In case of लुङ्लकार, धातु gets the च्लि विकरणप्रत्यय.
The च्लि विकरण is converted to सिच्.
The च्लि प्रत्यय that follows a शल्-वर्णान्त, इगुपध and अनिट्-धातु is converted to 'क्स.
When used with the meaning of 'giving a hug', The च्लि-प्रत्यय that follows the verb root श्लिष् is converted to क्स.
For the verb root दृश्, च्लि is not converted to क्स.
For the verbs ending in णि-प्रत्यय, and for the verbs  श्रि, द्रु and स्रु, the  च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to चङ् in the  कर्तरि context.
For the verbs धेट् and श्वि , the च्लि प्रत्यय is optionally converted to चङ्.
After the verb गुप् 'to protect', चङ् is optionally the substitute of च्लि in the छन्दस् (Vedas).
After the causatives of the verbs ऊन 'to decrease', ध्वन 'to sound', इल् 'to send' and अर्द 'to go or to beg' चङ् is not the substitute of च्लि in the छन्दस् (Vedas).
For the verbs असुँ (क्षेपणे), वच्, and ख्या, the च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to अङ्.
For the verb roots लिप् , सिच् and ह्वे , the च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to अङ्.
For the verb roots लिप् , सिच् and ह्वे , the च्लि-प्रत्यय is optionally converted to अङ् when followed by a प्रत्यय of आत्मनेपद.
For the verbs of पुषादिगण and द्युतादिगण, as well as for the ऌदित verbs, च्लि is converted to अङ् when followed by a प्रत्यय of परस्मैपद.
For the verbs सृ, शास् and ऋ, the च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to अङ्.
For the इरित्-verbs, the च्लि प्रत्यय is optionally converted to अङ्.
For the verbs जॄ, स्तन्भ्, म्रुच्, म्लुच्, ग्रुच्, ग्लुच्, ग्लुञ्च्,  टुओश्वि - the  च्लि-प्रत्यय is  optionally converted to  अङ्.
After the words कृ 'to do', मृ 'to die', दॄ (9P) 'to tear' and रुह 'to rise', अङ् is the substitute of च्लि when used in छन्दस् (Vedas).
चिण् is the substitute of च्लि after the verb पद् 'to go' when the affix त follows.

चिण् is optionally the substitute of च्लि , when त - 3rd Person Singular of आत्मनेपद follows after the verbs दीप् 'to shine', जन् 'to be produced', बुध् 'to teach or know', पूर् 'to be full', ताय् 'to extend or protect' and प्याय 'to smell'.
चिण् is optionally the substitute of च्लि , when त - 3rd Person Singular of आत्मनेपद follows after a root which ends with a vowel and when the object itself is spoken of as the agent.
चिण् is optionally the substitute of च्लि after the verb दुह् 'to milk', when it is used reflexively and when त follows.
चिण् is not the substitute of च्लि after the verb रुध् 'to obstruct' when used in the reflexive sense in the 3rd Person Singular of आत्मनेपद ।
चिण् is not the substitute of च्लि after the verb तप् 'to suffer' when used reflexively and when the sense of experiencing remorse.
चिण् is the substitute of च्लि when त -3rd Person Singular आत्मनेपद follows, denoting the action (भाव) or the object कर्म्म।
In the कर्मणि and the प्रयोगे भावे प्रयोग, धातु gets 'यक्' प्रत्यय when followed by a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय.
A verb gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'शप्' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.

items.anvaya: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके तनूकरणे तक्षः श्नुः अन्यतरस्याम्

items.anvaya: कर्त्तरि सार्वधातुके स्तन्भुँ-स्तुन्भुँ-स्कन्भुँ-स्कुन्भुँ-स्कुञ्भ्यः धातोः परः श्नुः श्ना च

The श्ना प्रत्यय following a हल् letter is converted to शानच् when followed by the 'हि' प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: छन्दसि श्नः हौ शानच् शायज् अपि
items.english: The श्ना प्रत्यय following a हल् letter is seen converted either to शायच् or शानच् when followed by the 'हि' प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: छन्दसि आशिषि लिङि धातोः परः अङ् अपि कर्तरि सार्वधातुके
items.english: In the context of वेदाः - The सार्वधातुक forms of आशीर्लिङ्गलकार can also use अङ् as गणविकरणप्रत्यय.
The ल denoting the agent, when the action affecting the agent is similar to the action which affects the object, is treated as if it were a ल denoting the object.
The agent of the verb तप् 'to heat', becomes similar to the object, only when the object is the word तपस् itself.
The affix यक् -- सार्वधातुके यक् [[3.1.67]],and चिण् -- अचः कर्मकर्तरि [[3.1.62]] are not used in the reflexive voice of the verbs दुह् 'to milk', स्नु 'to fall in drops' and नम् 'to bow.
The affix श्यन् comes after the roots कुष् 'to pull' and रञ्ज 'to colour' in the reflexive voice, according to the opinion of Eastern Grammarians and these verbs take the affixes of परस्मैपद ।

As far as the end of the Third Chapter reckoning from the present sūtra, the affixes treated of are to be understood as coming after some verbal root. (Note: This is an अधिकार सूत्र। All these verbal affixes are broadly classified as कृत् and कृत्य affixes)
The words referenced by the सप्तमीस्थ words of the sutras in this धात्वधिकार get the term 'उपपद'.
In this portion of the sūtras in which there is a reference to verbal roots, any affix except तिङ् - tense affixes, is called कृत् ।

In this portion of the sūtras, in which there is reference to verbal roots, an affix which is calculated to debar a general one, not being of the same form, optionally debars it; but not so in the case of feminine affixes -- स्त्रियां क्तिन् [[3.3.94]].
From this sūtra up to ण्वुल्तृचौ [[3.1.133]] all the affixes treated will get the name कृत्य।
The affixes तव्यत् , तव्य and अनीयर् come after the verbal roots.
The affix यत् comes after a root that ends in a vowel.
The affix यत् comes after a root which ends in a labial letter preceded by a short अ।
The affix यत् comes after roots शकॢ 'to be able' and सह 'to bear'.
The affix यत् comes after roots गद् 'to eat', मद् 'to be mad', चर् 'to go, to eat' and यम् 'to restrain', when these roots do not take any preposition.
The words अवद्य , पण्य , वर्या are irregularly formed, having the sense of 'condemnable', saleable' and unobstructable', respectively.
The word वह्यं is irregularly formed when the meaning of the word is an instrument of carrying.
The word अर्य is irregularly formed when meaning 'lord' and a वैश्य।
The word उपसर्या is irregularly formed when meaning what has reached the time favourable to conception or ripe for fruition.
The word अजर्यंम् 'imperishable' is irregularly formed when qualifying the word संगतम् 'friendship' expressed or understood.
After the root वद् 'to speak', governing a case-inflected word as its उपपद and not having a preposition annexed to it, there comes the affix क्यप् also.
After the root भू 'to be', in construction with a case-inflected word as its उपपद and when used without a preposition, the affix क्यप् is used to denote condition - भाव।

After the root हनु 'to kill' when in construction with a case-inflected word as its उपपद and when used without a preposition comes the affix क्यप् in denoting condition and the letter त is the substitute of its final.
After the verbs इ 'to go', स्तु 'to praise', शास् 'to govern', वृ 'to respect' and जुष् 'to please' comes the affix क्यप्।
After the verbs having the penultimate short ऋ , the affix क्यप् is used, with the exception of the verbs कॢप् 'to be able' and वृत् 'to hurt'.
The affix क्यप् is used after the root खन 'to dig' and long ई is substituted for the final of the root.
The affix क्यप् is used after the root भृञ् 'to bear' when not used as a name.
The affix क्यप् is optionally used after the verb सृज् 'to cleanse'.
The words राजसूय , सूर्य , मृषोद्य , रुच्य , कुप्य , कृष्ट , पच्य and अव्यथ्य irregularly formed by the addition of the affix क्यप्।
The words भिद्य and उद्ध्यौ are irregularly formed by the affix क्यप् , when meaning 'river'.
The words पुष्य and सिद्ध्य् are irregularly formed by the affix क्यप् , when used as names of asterisms.
When the words विपूय , विनीय and जित्या are irregularly formed they mean 'the मुञ्ज grass', 'the sediment' and 'the plough', respectively.
The word ग्रह 'to seize', preceded by the prepositions प्रति and अपि , takes the affix क्यप् in the छन्दस् (Vedas).
The root ग्रह 'to seize' takes the affix क्यप् when it means a 'word', a 'dependent', 'outside' or a 'partisan'.
After the verbs कृञ् 'to do' and वृष् 'to rain', the affix क्यप् is optionally used.
The word युग्यम् is irregularly formed meaning 'a vehicle'.
Optionally the word अमावस्या is irregular.

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the following words are found, which are formed irregularly - निष्टर्क्य , देवहूय , प्रणीय , उन्नीय , उच्छिष्य , मर्य , स्तर्या , ध्वर्य , खन्य , खान्य , देवयज्या , आपृच्छ्य , प्रतिषीव्य , ब्रह्मवाद्य , भाव्य , स्ताव्य , and पचाय्यपृड।
The affix ण्यत् comes after a verb that ends in ऋ (long or short) or in a consonant.
The affix ण्यत् comes after a verb that ends in the letter उ - long or short, when the sense is that of 'necessity'.
The affix ण्यत् comes after the verbs आसु 'to distill', यु 'to join', वप 'to sow', रप् 'to speak distinctly', लप् 'to prate', अप् 'to be ashamed' and चम 'to drink'.
The word आनाय्यः is irregularly formed when meaning 'impermanent'.
The word प्रणाय्य is irregularly formed when meaning 'disapproved'.
The words पाय्य , सान्नाय्य , निकाय्य and धाय्या are irregularly formed meaning 'a measure', 'an oblation to fire', 'a dwelling' and 'a sacrificial prayer', respectively.
The words कुण्डपाय्यः and संचाय्यः are irregularly formed meaning 'a sacrifice'.
The words परिचाय्यः , पचाय्य and समूह्याः are irregularly formed when they are names of fire.
The words चित्य and ग्निचित्य are also irregularly formed.
The affixes ण्वुल् (अक्) and तृच् (तृ) are placed after all verbal roots, expressing the agent.
After the verbs classed as नन्द 'to be happy', ग्रह 'to take' and पच् 'to cook' there are the affixes ल्यु (अन), णिनि (इन्) and अच (अ) respectively.
After a verb ending in a consonant but preceded by इ , उ or ऋ -long or short, and after the verbs ज्ञा 'to know', श्री 'to please' and कॄ 'to scatter', comes the affix क (अ)।
Also after a verb ending in long आ when there is a preposition along with it, the affix क is placed.
The affix श (अ) is used after the roots पा 'to drink', घ्रा 'to smell', ध्मा 'to blow' and धेट् 'to suck' and दृश् 'to see' when there is a preposition along with these roots.
The affix श is used after the verbs - धारि , पारि , वेदि , उदेजि , चेति , साति and साहि , when used without a preposition.
The affix श is optionally used after the root दा 'to give' and धा 'to hold', when used without a preposition.
After the verbs beginning with ज्वल 'to shine' and ending with कस 'to go', when used without a preposition, the affix ण is optionally used.

The affix ण is also used after the verbs - श्यै 'to go', verbs ending in a long भा , व्यद् 'to pierce', आस्रु 'to pain', संत्रु 'to flow', अतीण् 'to pass on', अवसा 'to complete', अवह 'to take away', लिह 'to lick', श्लिष 'to embrace' and श्वस 'to breathe'.
The affix ण is used after the verbs दु 'to burn' and नी 'to lead', when used without a preposition.
The affix ण is optionally used after the verb ग्रह 'to seize'.
The affix क is used after the verb ग्रह 'to seize' when the agent so expressed denotes a house.
The affix ष्वुन् (अक्) comes after a verb when the agent so expressed denotes an artist.
The affix थकन् (थक) comes after the verb गै 'to sing' when the agent so expressed, denotes an artist.
The affix ण्युट् is also used after the verb गै 'to sing' when the agent so expressed denotes an artist.
After the verb हा , also the affix ण्युट् is used when the agent so expressed denotes 'rice' and 'time'.
After the verbs प्रु 'to go', सृ 'to move', स्रु 'to flow' and लू 'to cut', the affix वुन् is used, when repitition is meant.
The affix वुन् is applied after all verbs when Benediction is intended.
The affix अण् comes after a verbal root when the object (or whatever sort it may be), is in composition with it (an an उपपद).
The affix अण् comes after a root हूञ् 'to call' वेञ् 'to weave', माङ् 'to measure', when the object is in composition with it.
The affix क comes after a verbal root that ends in long आ when there is no उपसर्ग preceding it and when the object is in composition with it.
The affix क comes after the root स्था when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix, as an उपपद ।
The affix क comes after the verbs परिमृज् 'to wash out' and अपनुद् 'to drive away' when in composition with the words तुन्द 'navel' and शोक 'grief', as objects respectively.
The affix क comes after the root दा 'to give' and ज्ञ 'to know', when taking the preposition प्र in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.
The affix क comes after root ख्या 'to tell', when preceded by the preposition सम् and when the object is in compsition with it.
The affix टक comes after the verbs गै 'to sing' and पा 'to drink' when used without a preposition and when the object is in composition with it.
The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् when it does not mean 'to raise up', when the object is in composition with it.
The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् when the object is in composition with it and when the meaning of the word to be formed is descriptive of age.
The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् (when the object is in composition with it) the root taking the preposition आञ् and the sense of the word to be formed in inclination or accustomed occupation.
The affix अच् comes after the verb अर्ह 'to respect', when the object is in composition with it.
The affix अच् comes after the verb रम् 'to sport' and जप् 'to whisper' when the case-inflected words स्तम्भ 'a clump of grass' and कर्ण 'ear' are in composition with them respectively.
The affix अच् is used after the verbal roots when शम् 'well' is in composition and the word to be formed denotes a name.
The affix अच् comes after the verb शी 'to lie down' when in composition with a case-inflected word indicating location i.e. in the Locative -7th-case.
The affix ट comes after the verb चर् 'to go' when a case-inflected word in composition with it denotes a location.
The affix ट is used after the verb चर् 'to go' when the words in composition with it भिक्षा 'alms', सेना 'army' and आदाय 'having taken'.
The affix ट comes after the verb सृ 'to move' when the words in composition with it are पुरः , अग्रतः and अग्रे , all meaning 'in front or before'.
The affix ट comes after the verb सृ 'to go' when पूर्व in composition with it, denoting the agent.
The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the object is in composition with it denoting cause, habit and going with the grain (concession).

The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the following words are in composition with it - 1. दिवा 'by day' 2. विभा 'light' 3. निशा 'night' 4. प्रभा 'splendour' 5. भाः 'light' 6. कार 'work' 7. अन्त 'end' 8. अनन्त 'endless' 9. आदि 'beginning' 10. बहु 'many' 11. नान्दी 'benediction' 12. किम् 'what' 13. लिपि 'writing' 14. लिबि 'writing' 15. बलि 'oblation' 16. भक्ति 'devotion' 17. कर्तृ 'agent' 18. चित्र 'painting' 19. क्षेत्र 'field' 20. संख्या - words denoting numerals 21. जङ्घा 'thigh' 22. बाहु 'hand' 23. अहः 'day' 24. यत् 'what' 25. तत् 'that' 26. धनुस् 'bow' 27. अरुस् 'wound'.
The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the word कर्म is in composition with it and the sense of the word to be formed is that of wages.

The affix ट does not come after the verb कृ 'to make' when the following words are in composition with it - 1. शब्द 'sound' 2. श्लोक 'verse' 3. कलह 'quarrel' 4. गाथा 'praise' 5. वैर 'enmity' 6. चाटु 'flattery' 7. सूत्र 'thread' 8. मन्त्र 'hymns' 9. पद 'word'.
The affix इन् comes after the verb कृ when the objects in composition with it are the words स्तम्ब 'a sheaf' and शकृत् 'ordure'.
When the agent indicated is an animal, the affix इन् comes after the verb हृ 'to take', the object in composition with it being the words ददृति 'a leather bag' and नाथ 'a master'.
And the words फलेग्रहि and आत्मम्भरि are irregularly formed.
In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix इन् comes after the verbs वन् 'to honour', सन् 'to worship', रक्ष् 'to protect' and अथ् 'to agitate', when the object is in composition.
The affix खश् comes after the verb एजृ 'to tremble' when ending in शि and when the object is in composition with it.
The affix खश् comes after the verbs ध्मा 'to blow' and धे 'to suck' when नासिका 'nose' and स्तन 'breast' are in composition with them as object.
And when the words नाडी 'a tube' and मुष्टि 'a fist' are objects in composition with the verbs ध्मा 'to blow' and धे 'to suck', the affix खश् is used.
The affix खश् comes after the verbs रुजि 'to break into pieces' and वह् 'to carry', when preceded by the उपसर्ग उत् and the word कूल 'bank' is in composition with them as the object.
The affix खश् comes after the verb लिह 'to lick' when the object in composition with it, is the word वह 'the shoulder of an ox' or अभ्र 'a cloud'.
The affix खश् comes after the verb पच् 'to cook' when the object in composition with it denotes a measure.
The affix खश् is used after the verb पच् 'to cook' when मित 'a measured partition' or नख 'a nail' is the word in composition with it as an object.
The affix खश् comes after the verb तुद् 'to strike' when विधु 'the moon' or अरुस् 'a wound' is the word in composition with it as object.
The affix खश् comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' and तप् 'to heat' when असूर्य and ललाट are the words in composition with it as object.
The words उग्रम्पश्य , इरम्मद , पाणिन्धम are irregularly formed.
The affix खच् comes after the verb वद् 'to speak' when प्रिय or वश is the word in composition with it as an object.
The affix खच् comes after the verb ताप् 'to heat' when द्विषत् or पर is the word in composition with it as an object.
The affix खच् comes after the verb यस् 'to curb' when the word वाक् 'speech' is in composition with it as an object and the sense indicated is that of a vow.
The affix खच् comes after the verb दारि 'to split' and सह् 'to bear' when respectively in composition with the words पुर् 'a city' and सर्व 'all', as objects.
The affix खच् comes after the verb कष् 'to rub' when the words सर्व 'all', कूल 'bank', अभ्र 'cloud' and करीष 'a dry cow-dung' are in composition with it as objects.
The affix खच् comes after the verb कृ 'to make' when the words मेघ 'cloud' अर्ति 'misfortune' and भय 'fear' are in composition as objects.
And the affix अण् as well as खच् come after the verb कृ 'to make' when the words क्षेम 'happiness', प्रिय 'pleasant' and भद्र 'joy' are in composition as objects.
The affix खच् comes after the verb भू 'to be' when in composition with the case-inflected word आशित 'satisfied by eating' and the sense is that of instrument or condition.
The affix खच् comes after the verbs - 1. भृ 'to bear' 2. तॄ 'to cross over' 3. वृ 'to choose' 4. जि 'to conquer' 5. धारि 'to hold' 6. सहि 'to bear' 7. तपि 'to heat' 8. दम 'to subdue'
And the affix खच् comes after the verb गम् 'to go' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix and when the word to be formed denotes a name.

And the affix खच् comes after the verb गम् 'to go' when in composition with the verbs - 1. अन्त 'end' 2. अत्यन्त 'extreme' 3. अध्वम् 'road' 4. दूर 'far' 5. पार 'across' 6. सर्व 'all' 7. अनन्त 'endless'.
The affix ड comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the object is in composition with it and when benediction is intended.
The affix ड comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when it is compounded with the preposition अप् and when the object in composition with it, is the word क्लेश 'pain' or तमस् 'darkness'.
The affix णिनि comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the word in composition with it is कुमार 'a child' or शीर्ष 'head'.

The affix टक् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when it is in composition with the word जाया 'wife' or पति 'husband' as object and when the word so formed denotes the agent possessed of that attribute (or when the word so formed denotes a mark).
The affix टक् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the object is in composition with it and when the word to be formed denotes an agent other than a human being.
The affix टक् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the object is in composition with it as its object is हस्ति 'elephant' or कपाट 'gate' and when the sense indicated is that of power.
The word पाणिघ and ताडघ are irregularly formed when denoting an artificier.

The affix ख्युन् , when in the sense of the word to be formed is that of an instrumental agent, comes after the verb कृ 'to make', when the following words are in composition with it - 1. आढ्य 'rich' 2. सुभग 'fortunate' 3. स्थूल 'big' 4. पलित 'grey' 5. नग्न 'naked' 6. अन्ध 'blind' 7. प्रिय 'pleasant', provided these words formed by the affix च्वि though not actually ending in the affix च्वि।

The affixes खिष्णुच् and खकञ् , when the word to be formed denotes an agent comes after the verb भू 'to become', when it is in composition with the words formed by the affix च्वि though not actually ending in the affix च्वि।
The affix क्विन् comes after the verb स्पृश् 'to touch' when it is in composition with a case-inflected word other than उदक 'water'.

The words - ऋत्विक्, दधृष्, स्रज् , दिश्, उष्णिह् - are considered to be readymade forms made using the क्विन् प्रत्यय. Also, the verb अञ्च् gets the क्विन् प्रत्यय in presence of an उपपद, where as the verbs युज् and  क्रुञ्च् get the क्विन् प्रत्यय in absence of an उपपद.
And the affix कञ् comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' when it is in composition with त्यद् etc. and does not signify perception.

The affix क्विप्comes after the following verbs when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix, though it may be an उपसर्ग viz. 1. सत् 'to sit' 2. सू 'to bring forth' 3. द्विष् 'to hate' 4. द्रुह् 'to bear malice' 5. दुह् 'to milk' 6. युज् 'to join' , 'to concentrate the mind' 7. विद् 'to know', 'to consider' 8. भिद् 'to divide' 9. च्छिद् 'to cut' 10. जि 'to conquer' 11. नी 'to lead 12. राज् 'to shine'.
The affix ण्वि comes after the verb भज् 'to share' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix whether it be an उपसर्ग or not.
In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix णिव comes after the verb सह् 'to bear' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix.
The affix णिव after the verb वह् 'to carry' in the छन्दस् (Vedas), when the word ending in case-affix is in composition with it.
In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix ञ्युट् comes after the verb वह् 'to carry' when it is in composition with the words कव्य 'oblation of food to deceased ancestors', पुरीष 'faeces' and पुरीष्य 'water'.

The affix ञ्युट् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verb वह् 'to carry' when it is in composition with the word हव्य 'an oblation to gods', provided that the word so formed does not occur in the middle of a पाद (4th part of a stanza).

The affix विट् (the whole of which is elided) comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verbs 1. जन् 'to be born' 2. सन् 'to bestow' 3. खन् 'to dig' 4. क्रम् 'to pace' 5. गम् 'to go' when a word ending in case-affix is in composition and the final nasals are changed into long आ।
The affix विट् comes after the verb अद् 'to eat' when in composition with a case-inflected word other than अन्न 'food'.
The affix विट् comes after the verb अद् 'to eat' when the word क्रव्य is in composition with it.
The affix कप् comes after the verb दुह् 'to milk' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix and the letter घ replaces the final.
In the मन्त्र literature,the affix णिवन् comes after the words 1. श्वेतवह 2.उक्थश 3. पुरोडाश् ।
In the मन्त्र literature,the affix णिवन् comes after the verb यज् 'to sacrifice' when in composition the word अव्।
The affix विच् comes after the verb यज् 'to sacrifice' when उप precedes it, in the छन्दस् (Vedas).
The affixes मनिन् (मन्), वनिप् (वन्), विनय (वन्) and विच् come in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verbs which end in long आ , when used in a case-inflected word or उपसर्ग in in composition.
These affixes i.e. - मनिन् (मन्), वनिप् (वन्), विनय (वन्) and विच् are seen after other verbs also besides those ending in long आ।
And the affix क्विप् is also seen after all verbs, whether having an उपपद or not in the Vedic as well as in the modern Sanskrit.
The affixes क and क्विप् come after the verb स्था when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix or an उपसर्ग ।
When habit is to be expressed, the affix णिनि comes after a verb, provided the word with a case-affix in composition with it does not mean a genus.

The affix णिनि comes after a verb when in composition with a word denoting an object of comparison, expressing the agent, the sense of the affix being 'doing something like that', that is to say, when the उपपद agent is the standard of comparison of the agent denoted by the word to which the sense of the affix refers.
The affix णिनि comes after a verb, in composition with a word ending in a case-affix.
The affix णिनि comes after a verb diversely when continued repitition of an action is to be expressed.
The affix णिनि comes after the verb मन् 'to think' when there is a word with a case-affix in composition with it.

And the affix णिनि comes after the verb मन् 'to think' when the word in composition with it is a word with a case-affix and when it is used to signify thought, whereof the object is self (the sense of the affix being 'thinking himself as such').
All the affixes to be treated of hereafter should be understood to come in the sense of past time.
The affix णिनि comes after the verb यज् 'to sacrifice' with the sense of past time, when the word in composition is the Instrumental -3rd case.
The affix णिनि comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time, when the word in composition is in the Accusative -2nd case.
The affix क्विप्comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time when the following words in the Accusative -2nd case ae in composition - 1. भ्रूण 'a foetus' 2. वृत्र ।

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix क्विप्diversely comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time,ending with the word even when the word in composition with it is other than those mentioned in the last sūtra.

The affix क्विप्comes after the verb कृ 'to make' with the sense of past time, when the following words in the Accusative -2nd case are in composition - 1. सु 'action' 2. कर्म 'action' 3. पाप 'sin' 4. मन्त्र 'hymn' 5. पुण्य 'virtue'.
The affix क्विप्comes after the verb सु 'to press out juice' with the sense of past time, when the word सोम , in the Accusative -2nd case, is in composition.
The affix क्विप्comes after the verb चि 'to collect' with the sense of past time, when the word अग्नि , in the Accusative -2nd case, is in composition.

In expressing an object the affix क्विप्comes after the verb चि 'to collect' with the sense of past time when in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case, provided the word so formed is the name of fire.
The affix इनि comes after the compound verb विकृ 'to sell' in the sense of past time, when in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.
The affix क्वनिप् comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' in the sense of past time, when in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.
The affix क्वनिप् comes after the verbs युध 'to fight' and कृ 'to make' with a past signification when the word राजन् 'king' is in composition, in the Accusative -2nd case.
The affix क्वनिप् comes after the verbs युध 'to fight' and कृ 'to make' with a past signification when the word सह 'with', is in composition.
The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the word, in composition with it is in the Locative -7th-case.
The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the word, in composition with it is in the Ablative -5th case, which does not denote a genus.
The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when an उपसर्ग is in composition and when the sense is simply appellative.
The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the root takes the preposition अनु and is compounded with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.

The affix ड is seen to come after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification,though it be in composition with other nouns, having cases other than those mentioned in the previous sūtras.
The affixes called निष्ठा come after a verbal root used in the sense of past time.
The affix ङ्वनिप् comes after the verbs सु 'to press out or extract juice' and यज् 'to sacrifice', with a past signification.
The affix अतृन् comes after the verb जृ 'to grow old' with the sense of past time.
In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix लिट् (Perfect Tense) comes after a verb with a past signification.
In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix लिट् (Perfect Tense) is optionally replaced by the affix कानच्।
In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix क्वसु is optionally the substitute for लिट् ।
In modern Sanskrit the affix क्वसु optionally replaces लिट् (Perfect Tense) after the verbs सद् , वस् and श्रु with a past signification.
The forms उपेयिवान् , नाश्वान् , नूचान् are irregularly formed.
The लुङ्-प्रत्ययः is used to indicate the past tense.

items.anvaya: अनद्यतने भूते धातोः परः लङ् प्रत्ययः
items.english: लङ्-लकार is used to indicate actions that have happened yesterday or before.
When a word implying 'recollection' is in connection with it, a verb takes the affix लृट् (2nd Future) in the sense of the past before the commencement of the present day.
The affix लृट् (2nd Future) is not applied in the sense of the past when the उपपद denoting recollection has in connection with it the particle यत्।

The affix लृट् (2nd Future) is optionally applied in the sense of the past, when a word implying 'recollection' is in connection with it and whether such a word has the particle यत् or is used simply; provided that the two verbs, occurring in the same complex sentence, are also connected together, that each is necessary to the other , to complete the sense of the speaker.

items.anvaya: परोक्षे अनद्यतने भूते धातोः परः लिट् प्रत्ययः
items.english: लिट्-लकार is used to indicate an action which was done yesterday or before and which was not seen by the speaker of the sentence.

And the affix लङ् (Imperfect Tense) comes after the verb when the particles ह and शश्वत are in connection with it and when the verb denotes past action unperceived by the speaker and before the commencement of the current day.

The affixes लङ् (Imperfect Tense) and लिट् (Perfect Tense) come after a verb (in expressing a past time not belonging to the current day and unperceived by the speaker) when the past referred to is recent and the sentence is interrogative.

The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a verb when the particle स्म is in connection with it (and denotes a past time not belonging to the current day and unperceived by the speaker). Note : This debars लिट् (Perfect Tense) .

The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a verb when the particle स्म is in connection with it and denotes a past action not belonging to the current day and when the action is perceived by the agent.
The affix लट् (Present Tense) is used after a verb in denoting a past action when the word ननु is in connection with it and an answer is given to the question.
The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes optionally after a verb in denoting past time, in reply to an interrogation, when the words न 'not' and नु 'what of that' are in connection with it.

Optionally the affixes लुङ् (Aorist) and लट् (Present Tense) come after a verb in denoting past time not belonging to the current day, when the word पुरा is used in the sentence, provided that the word स्म is not used.
The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a verb when denoting a present action.

items.anvaya: लटः अप्रथमासमानाधिकरणे वर्तमाने शतृशानचौ धातोः परः
items.english: The लट्-लकार gets शतृ and शानच् as आदेशाः to denote the present-tense, provided a विभक्ति other than प्रथमा is used along with these.
The affixes शतृ and शानच् are substitutes of लट् (Present Tense) even when agreeing with what ends with a 1st (Nominative Case) case-affix, provided that it is in the Vocative Case.
The affixes शतृ and शानच् are substitutes of लट् (Present Tense) and come after a verb in expressing an attendant circumstance or characteristic and the cause of an action.
These two - शतृ and शानच् are called सत्.
The affix शानन् comes after the verbs पू 'to purify' and यज् 'to sacrifice'.
The affix चानश् comes after a verb in expressing 'habit', standard of age' and 'inability'.
The affix शतृ comes after the verb इङ् 'to go' and धारि 'to hold' in denoting that the agent does the action without trouble.
The affix शतृ comes after the verb द्विष् when the agent indicated means 'an enemy'.
The affix शतृ comes after the verb सु 'to press out or extract juice' when the sense is that of association with sacrifice.
The affix शतृ comes after the verb अर्ह in expressing praise.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: From this sūtra as far as क्विप् in sūtra [[3.4.177]] (inclusive), the affixes that we shall treat of, are to be understood in the sense of agents having such a habit or nature or having skill in such and such action.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: The affix तृन् comes after all verbs in the sense of 'agents having such a habit etc.'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: The affix इष्णुच् comes after following verbs in the sense of 'agents having such a habit etc.' - 1. अलंकृ 'to adorn' 2. ञ्निराकृ 'to expel' 3. प्रजन् 'to be born' 4. उत्पच् 'to be ripe' 5. उत्पत् 'to fly' 6. उन्मद् 'to be mad' 7. रुच् 'to shine' 8. अपत्रप् 'to be ashamed' 9. वृत् 'to move' 10. वृध् 'to grow 12. सह 'to bear' 13. चर् 'to walk'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: The affix इष्णुच् in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verb that ends in the causative णि।

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: The affix इष्णुच् in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verb भू 'to be' etc.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: The affix क्स्नु comes after the following verbs in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' viz. - 1. ग्ला 'to be weary' 2. जि 'to conquer' 3. स्था 'to stand', as well as after भू 'to be'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: The affix क्नु comes after the verbs - 1. त्रस् 'to tremble' 2. गृध् 'to be greedy' 3. धृष् 'to be bold' 4. क्षिप् 'to throw' in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: The affix घिनुण् comes after the 8 verbs beginning with शम् 'to be calm' in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: The affix वरच् comes, in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. स्था 'to stand' 2. ईश 'to rule' 3. भास् 'to shine' 4. पिस् 'to go' 5. कस् 'to go'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: The affix वरच् in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' comes after the verb या when it ends with the affix यङ्।

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · वर्तमाने · आ क्वेस्तच्छीलतद्धर्मतत्साधुकारिषु
items.english: The affix क्विप् comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. भ्राज 'to shine' 2. भास् 'to shine' 3. धुर्व 'to injure' 4. द्युत् 'to shine' 5. ऊर्ज 'to be strong' 6. पॄ 'to fill' 7. जु 'to move rapidly' 8. स्तु 'to praise', when preceded by the word ग्रवन् 'a stone'.
The affix क्विप् comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs other than those seen above.
The affix क्विप् comes after the verb भू 'to be' when the word so formed denotes a name or surety.
The affix डु comes after the verb भू 'to be' when it is preceded by the उपसर्ग वि , प्र and सम् provided that the word to be formed does not mean an appellative.
The affix ष्ट्रन् comes, in denoting the object after the verb धा 'to feed'.

The affix ष्ट्रन् with in the sense of instrument, comes after the verbs 1. दाप 'to cut' 2. नी 'to lead' 3. शस् 'to hurt' 4. यु 'to join' 5. युज् 'to join' 6. स्तु 'to praise' 7. तुद् 'to inflict pain' 8. सि 'to bind' 9. सिच् 'to sprinkle' 10. मिह् 'to urine' 11. पत् 'to fall' 12. दश् 'to bite' 13. नह् 'to bind'
The affix ष्ट्रन् is used after the verb पू 'to purify' with the sense of instrument when denoting a member of the body of a plough or of a hog.
The affix इत्र comes after the verbs 1. ऋ 'to go' 2. लू 'to cut' 3. धू 'to shake' 4. सू 'to bring forth' 5. खन् 'to dig' 6. सह् 'to bear' 7. चर् 'to go' , with the sense of instrument.
The affix इत्र comes after the verb पू 'to purify' with the sense of the agent so expressed being the instrument when the sense of the complete word is simply appellative and not descriptive.
The affix इत्र comes after the verb पू 'to purify' with the sense of the agent or instrument when it is respectively used in connection with a sage or a deity.
The verbal roots marked with an indicatory ञि , take the affix क्त , in denoting the present time.
And after the roots denoting inclination, understanding, or respect, the affix क्त is used with the force of the present
The affixes उण् and the rest with the force of the present and with a sense simply appellative are attached diversely.
The उणादि affixes are seen also attached with the force of the past time.
The words गामि etc. are valid forms having the sense of the future time.
The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a root with the force of futurity when it has in construction with it the particles यावत् and पुरा।
The affix लट् (Present Tense) is optionally used after a root with the force of the futurity when it has in construction with it the adverbs कदा and कर्हि।

When the word किम् or its derivatives are in construction with a verb, the affix लट् (Present Tense) is used optionally after a root, in denoting future time, provided that the sentences expresses a desire of gaining on the part of the speaker.
And when the success, that would accrue to another by fulfilling the desire of the speaker, is indicated in a sentence, the present tense may optionally be used with the force of the futurity.

The affix लट् (Present Tense) is optionally used with the force of futurity after that root, which is in a conditional sentence, is the condition precedent for the action indicated by another verb having the sense of the imperative mood.
The लट् (Present Tense) or the लिङ् (Potential) is used under similar conditions in denoting futurity, when the future time is future by a मूहूर्त (= 48 minutes).

The affixes तुमुन् and ण्वुल् are placed after a verbal root with the force of the future when the word in construction therewith is another verb, denoting an action performed for the sake of the (future) action.

And the affixes that are ordained to come after a root with the force of denoting the mere action of the verb, such as धञ् etc. -- लोहितादिडाज्भ्यः क्यष् [[3.1.3]], have also the force of the future, when the word in construction therewith is another verb denoting an action performed for the sake of the future action.
The affix अण् comes after a root with the force of the future when the word in construction with it is in the Accusative -2nd case and when the action is performed for the sake of another action.

items.anvaya: भविष्यति क्रियायाम् क्रियार्थायाम् , शेषे च लृट् ।
items.english: When a helper action is done for doing a main action in future (For example, 'going to school  for studying'), the लृट्लकार can be used to denote the main action ('studying' in this example). In addition, the लृट्लकार can also be used to indicate a general action to be done in future, even when no helper action is indicated.
The affixes called सत् i.e. शतृ and शानच् are optionally the substitutes of लृट् (2nd Future).
लुट्-लकार is used to indicate actions that will happen tomorrow or later.
The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. पद् 'to pace' 2. रुज् 'to pain 3. विश् 'to enter' 4. स्पृश् 'to touch'.
The affix घञ् comes after the verb शृ 'to move' when the agent is permanently fixed.
The affix घञ् comes after a root when mere action is denoted.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after a root when the sense is that of an appellative, the word being related to the verb from which its name is deduced, but not as agent.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after all roots when the word so formed is the name of a measure.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the root इङ् 'to study'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verb रू 'to roar' when it has an उपसर्ग in composition with it.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. यु 'to join' 2. द्रु 'to run' 3. दु 'to burn' when in composition with the preposition सम्।

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. शृ 'to go to' 2. नी 'to lead' 3. भू 'to be' when not in composition with an उपसर्ग ।

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. क्षु 'to sneeze' 2. श्रु 'to move and hear' when the preposition वि is in composition.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verb नी 'to lead' when the prepositions अव and उत् are in composition.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. द्रु 'to run' 2. स्तु 'to praise' 3. श्रु 'to move and hear' when the word in composition is प्र।

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. पू 'to purify' 2. लू 'to cut' when निर् and अभि are respectively in composition.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the root गॄ when the उपसर्ग-s उत् and नि are in composition.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verb कॄ when the prepositions उत् and नि are in composition and when the sense of the verb relates to grain.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verb स्तु 'to praise' when it is preceded by the उपसर्ग सम् and the word refers to sacrificial subjects.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verb स्तॄ 'to cover' when preceded by the preposition प्र ; provided that the word so formed does not refer to sacrifice.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verb स्तॄ 'to cover' when the preposition वि is in composition with it when the sense is that of extension and when such spreading does not refer to words.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verb स्तॄ 'to cover' with the उपसर्ग वि when the word so formed is the name of a metre.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verb ग्रह् 'to seize' when the preposition उत् is in composition.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verb ग्रह् 'to seize' when in composition with preposition सम् when the sense of the root refers to fist.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. नी 'to lead' 2. इ 'to go' when the prepositions परि and नि respectively in composition with them and when the words so formed respectively mean 'a game' and 'propriety or arrangement or law'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the root इ 'to go' in composition with the word परि when the sense is that of following in regular succession.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the root सी 'to lie down' when the prepositions वि and उप are in composition with it and when the sense of the word so formed is that of 'regular succession'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the root चि 'to collect' when the sense expressed is that of taking by hand provided it does not refer to stealing.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the roots चि 'to collect' and क is the substitute of the initial च in these senses viz. - 1. 'a dwelling' 2. 'a fire on the funeral pile' 3. 'the body' 4. 'collection'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the roots चि 'to collect' and क is the substitute of the initial च in the sense of 'a multitude or assembly' (of living beings possessing some common characteristics) but not merely a confused crowd of men.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix णच् comes after a root in denoting reciprocity of action and the word so formed is in the feminine gender.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix इनुण् comes after a root in denoting condition when co-extensiveness is meant.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with अव and नि when malediction is meant.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' when the word प्र is in composition and the sense denoted is the desire of acquisition.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with परि when it relates to sacrificial subjects.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verb वृ preceded by नि when the sense is that of grain.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् comes after the verbs 1. श्रि 2. यु 'to join' 3. पू 'to purify' 4. द्रु 'to run' when the preposition उत् is in composition.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the verbs 1. रू 'to roar' 2. प्लु 'to float' when the preposition अङ् is in composition.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' when the word अव is in composition, the sense being 'withholding the rain'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with प्र when the word so formed relates to commerce.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with प्र when the word so formed means 'a rein'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the verb वृ 'to choose' when प्र is in composition and the word so formed means 'a sort of covering'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix घञ् is optionally used after the verb भू 'to be', the word परि being in construction and the sense of the word so formed being 'disregard'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अच् comes after a root ending in इ or ई (when mere action is denoted or when the sense is that of an appellative, the word being related to the verb from which its name is deduced, but not as an agent).

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: After a root ending in long ॠ , short उ or long ऊ , there is the affix अप्।

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes after the verbs 1. ग्रह् 'to seize' 2. वृ 'to choose' 3. दृ 4. निश्चि 5. गम् 'to go'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes after the verb अद् 'to eat' when an उपसर्ग is in composition.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: And The affix ण as well as अप् come after the verb अद् 'to eat' when the उपसर्ग नि is in composition.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes after the verbs 1. व्यध् 'to hurt or to pierce' 2. जप् 'to mutter' when no उपसर्ग is in composition with them.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes optionally after the verbs 1. स्वन् 2. हस् when no उपसर्ग is in composition with them.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: And The affix अप् comes optionally after the verb यम् 'to surround' when the उपसर्ग -s सम् , उप , नि and वि are in composition ; or even when it is without उपसर्ग -less.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes optionally after the verbs 1. गद् 'to speak' 2. नद् 'to sound' 3. पठ् 'to read' 4. स्वन् 'to sound' when the उपसर्ग नि is in composition with them.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes optionally after the verb क्वन् 'to jingle' when नि is in composition with it, as well as when it is without any उपसर्ग or when 'flute' is meant.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes Invariably after the verb पण् 'to barter' when the sense is that of 'measure'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes after the verb मद् when not in composition with an उपसर्ग ।

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The words प्रमद and सम्मद are irregularly formed, meaning 'joy'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes after the verb अज् 'to go' when the preposition सम् and उत् are in composition and the word so formed refers to beasts.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The word ग्लह is irregularly formed when the sense of the root refers to gambling.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes after the verb श्रि 'to flow' in the sense of impregnating (the covering of cows etc.).

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes after the verb ह्वे 'to call' when the preposition नि , अभि , उप and वि are in composition with it and its semi-vowel is changed into the corresponding vowel.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes after the verb ह्वे 'to call' when the word in composition is the उपसर्ग आण् and the semi-vowel of the root is changed into its corresponding vowel, when the word so formed means 'battle'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The word आहाव is irregularly formed when meaning 'a trough'.

items.adhikara: प्रत्ययः · परश्च · आद्युदात्तश्च · धातोः · भावे · अकर्तरि च कारके संज्ञायाम्
items.english: The affix अप् comes after the verb ह्वे 'to call' and there is the change of the semi-vowel to its corresponding vowel, when the root is without an उपसर्ग and mere action is denoted.
