In the यजुर्वेद , the word उरस् when changed to उरो , retains it original form when followed by a short अ which is also retained.
In the यजुर्वेद , the short अ is retained after आपो , जुषाणो , वृष्णो , वर्षिष्ठे and also in and after अम्बे or अम्बाले when they stand before अम्बिके।
In the यजुर्वेद , when the word अङ्गे is followed by अङ्गे , the subsequent short अ is retained, as well as the preceding ए or ओ।
In the यजुर्वेद , when an अनुदात्त अ is followed by a Guttural or a ध, the antecedent ए or ओ retains it s form, as well as this subsequent अ।
In the यजुर्वेद , when the gravely accented अ of अवपथास् follows ए or ओ , the vowels retain their original form.

items.anvaya: पदान्तात् गोः एङः अति सर्वत्र प्रकृत्या विभाषा
items.english: In the context of संहिता, an ओकार occurring at the end of the पदसंज्ञक गो शब्द exhibits optional प्रकृतिभाव when followed by a ह्रस्व अकार.

items.anvaya: पदान्तात् गोः अचि अवङ् विभाषा स्फोटायनस्य
items.english: In the context of संहिता, The पदसंज्ञक गो word when followed by a स्वर gets an अवङ् आदेश optionally.
In the context of संहिता, The word गो when followed by the word इन्द्र gets the अवङ्-आदेश.
प्लुत letters and प्रगृह्य words do not undergo a सन्धि when followed by an अच्-letter, even when there is संहिता.
In the context of संहिता and in the derivation of the वैदिक forms, when आङ् is followed by an अच् letter, आङ् becomes अनुनासिक and does not undergo sandhi with the अच् letter.

items.anvaya: इकः पदान्तात् असवर्णे अचि प्रकृत्या ह्रस्वः च
items.english: According to शाकल्य, In the context of संहिता a पदान्त-इक्-letter, when followed by an असवर्ण अच्-letter undergoes ह्रस्वादेशः and then no other sandhi happens.

items.anvaya: पदान्तस्य  अकः असवर्णे ऋति ह्रस्वः  प्रकृत्या शाकल्यस्य
items.english: According to शाकल्य, In the context of संहिता a पदान्त-अक्-letter, when followed by a ह्रस्व ऋ/ऌ-letter undergoes ह्रस्वादेशः and then no other sandhi happens.
When followed by an अवैदिक 'इति' word, a प्लुत behaves as if it is not प्लुत in the context of संहिता.
According to चाक्रवर्मण, the प्लुतः ईकारः behaves as if it is not प्लुत when followed by an अच्-letter in the context of संहिता.
The 'दिव्' word that is a पद also gets the उत्-आदेश.

Except for the नञ् समास, when a form of एतद्/तद् word which does not contain a ककार is followed by a  सुँ-प्रत्यय which in turn is followed by a व्यञ्जन. the सुँ-प्रत्यय gets removed in the context of संहिता.
In the derivation of the Vedic words, the सुँ-प्रत्यय attached to the प्रथमा-एकवचन of the word त्यद् might or might not be removed when followed by a हल् in the context of संहिता.

items.anvaya: लोपे पादपूरणम् चेत् - सः अचि लोपः
items.english: The सुँ-प्रत्यय of सः gets removed when followed by an अच्, provided that (only) by doing so, the पाद can be completed.
The augment सुट् is placed before क even when the augment अट् [[6.4.71]] or the Reduplicate intervenes (between the preposition and the verb).
The augment सुट् is placed before क when सम् , परि , and उप are followed by the verb कृ and the sense is that of ornamenting.
The augment सुट् is placed before क even when सम् , परि , and उप are followed by the verb कृ and the sense being that of combining.
The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after उप , and the sense is that of 'to take pains for something, to prepare, and to supply and ellipses in a discourse'.
The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after उप , and the sense is that of 'to cut or to split'.
The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after उप and प्रति and the sense 'to cause suffering'.
The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after अप and the sense is 'the scraping of earth by four-footed animals or birds'.
The word कुस्तुम्बुरु is irregularly, formed with the augment सुट् and means 'a species of herb'.
The word अपस्पराः is formed by the augment सुट् when the sense is that of 'uninterrupted action'.
The word गोष्पद is formed by सुट् , when meaning a locality visited or not visited by cows, or when it means quantity.
The word आस्पद is formed by सुट् when meaning 'a place or position'.
The word आशचर्य is formed by सुट् when meaning something 'unusual'.
The word अवस्कर is formed by सुट् meaning 'excrement'.
The word अपस्कर is formed by सुट् meaning 'the part of a chariot'.
The word विषिकर is formed with सुट् optionally when denoting a kind of bird, the other form being विकार।
In a मन्त्र , the सुट् is added to चन्द्र when it is second member in a compound and is preceded by a short vowel.
To the root कश् 'to go, to punish', is added the augment सुट् , when preceded by the preposition प्रति , the form being प्रतिष्कशः।
The words प्रस्कण्व and हरिश्चन्द्र are formed by सुट् meaning the two Rishis of that name.
The word मस्कर means 'a bamboo', and मस्करिन् means 'a medicant monk'.
The words कास्तर and अजस्तुन्द are names of cities.
The words पारस्कर etc. are Names.
A word is, with the exception of one syllable, unaccented.
A stem formed with the कृत-affix घञ् has the acute accent on the end-syllable, if it is formed from the root कृष् (कर्षति) or has a long आ in it.
The words उच्छ etc. have acute accent on the last syllable.
An unaccented vowel gets also the acute accent, when on account of it preceding acute is elided.
A root has the acute on the end syllable.
The word ending in चित्-प्रत्यय becomes अन्तोदात्त.
The word ending in a तद्धितसंज्ञक चित्-प्रत्यय become अन्तोदात्त.
The word ending in a तद्धितसंज्ञक कित्-प्रत्यय become अन्तोदात्त.
The Nominative Plural (जस्) of तिस् has acute accent on the last syllable.
The word चतुर् , followed by the Accusative Plural, has acute accent on the last syllable.
The case affixes of the Instrumental and of the cases that follow it have the acute accent, if the stem in the Locative Plural is monosyllabic.
The same case endings may optionally have the acute accent, if the monosyllabic word stands at the end of a compound, and has acute accent on the final, when the compound can be easily unloosened.
In the छन्दस् , the case-endings other than the सर्वनामस्थान , get the acute accent when coming after अञ्चि।
The same (असर्वनामस्थान) case-endings have the acute accent, when the stem ends in वाह् , also after इदम् after पद् etc. (up to [[6.1.63]]) after अप , पुंस् , रै and दिव्।
The असर्वनामस्थान case-endings after अष्टन् 'eight', have acute accent, when it gets the form अष्टा।

After an oxytone Particle in अत् the feminine suffix ई , (नदि) and the case endings beginning with vowels (with the exception of strong cases) have acute accent, when the participial affix has not the augment न् (i.e. is not अन्त).
The same endings have the acute accent, when for the acutely accented final vowel of the stem, a semi-vowel is substituted, and which is preceded by a consonant.
But not so, when the vowel is of the feminine affix ऊ [[4.1.66]], or the final of a root.
The otherwise unaccented मत् (वत्) takes the acute accent, when an oxytoned stem ends in a light vowel, or the affix has before it the augment न् [[8.2.16]].
After an oxytoned stem which ends in a light vowel, the genitive ending नाम् has optionally the acute accent.
In the छन्दस , the ending नाम् has diversely the acute accent after the feminine affix ई।
The case-endings beginning with a consonant, have the acute accent after the Numerals called षट् [[1.1.24]], as well as after त्रि and चतुर् ।
The above numerals, when taking a case-affix beginning with a भस् or स् , get the acute accent on the penultimate syllable, when the said numerals assume a form consisting of three or more syllables.
In the Secular language this is optional.

The foregoing rules from [[6.1.168]] downwards have no applicability after गो , and श्वन् and words ending in them; nor after a stem which before the case ending of the Nominative Singular has अ or आ , nor after रज् , or after a stem ending in अञ्च् , nor as well as after कुञ्च् and कृत्।
After दिव् a case-ending beginning with भ or स is unaccented.
After नृ , a case-ending beginning with भ or स is optionally unaccented.
The first स्वर of a तित् प्रत्यय becomes स्वरित.

The Personal-endings and their substitutes [[3.2.124]]-126 are, when they are सार्वधातुक [[3.4.113]] etc., unaccented after the characteristic of the Periphrastic Future (तासि) after a root which in the धातुपाठ has an unaccented vowel or a ङ् (with the exception of ह्नुङ् and इङ्) as indicatory letter, as well as after what has a final अ in the Grammatical System of Instruction (उपदेश)।
The सिच् Aorist, the first syllable may optionally have the acute accent.

The acute accent is optionally on the first syllable when a Personal-ending, being सार्वधातुक tense affix beginning with a vowel, provided that the vowel is not the augment इट् , follows after स्वप् etc., or after हिंस्।
The acute accent falls on the first syllable of the reduplicate verbs when followed by an affix beginning with a vowel (the vowel being not नुट्) and being a सार्वधातुक Personal-ending.
Also when the unaccented endings of the three persons in the singular follow, the first syllable of the reduplicate has the acute.
The acute is on the first syllable of सर्व when the case-endings follow.

In भी , ह्री , भृ , हु , मद् , जन् , धन् , दरिद्रा and जागृ , and in their reduplicates, the acute accent is, before the सार्वधातुक unaccented endings of the three persons in singular, (पित्), on the syllable which precedes the affix.
For the प्रकृति-प्रत्यय-समुदाय that ends in a लित्-प्रत्यय, the स्वर that comes before the प्रत्यय becomes उदात्त.
The first syllable may be optionally acute when the absolutive affix णमुल् follows.
The roots which are exhibited in धातुपाठ with a final vowel, may be optionally have the acute on the first syllable, before the affixes of the Passive (यक्), when the sense of the verb is Reflexive.
Before the ending थ of the Perfect, Second Person Singular, when this ending takes the augment इ ; the acute accent falls either on the first syllable, or on this इ , or on the personal ending.
The word ending in a ञित् or a नित् प्रत्यय become आद्युदात्त.
The first syllable of a Vocative gets the acute accent.
The acute accent is on the first syllable of पथिन् and मथिन् when followed by a strong case-ending.
The Infinitive in तवै has the acute on the first syllable and on the last syllable at one and the same time.
The word क्षय has the acute on the first syllable and on the last syllable at one and the same time.
The acute accent falls on the first syllable of जय , in the sense of 'whereby one attains victory'.
The words वृष etc. have the acute on the first syllable.
The acute accent falls on the first syllable of that word with which something is likened, provided that it is a name.
A disyllabic Participle in त (निष्ठा) when a Name has the acute on the first syllable, but not if the first syllable has an आ।
Also शुष्क and धृष्ट have acute on the first syllable.
The word आशित meaning 'having eaten' has acute on the first syllable.
The word रिक्त may have optionally the acute on the first syllable.
In the छन्दस , the words जुष्ट and अर्पित have optionally the acute on the first syllable.
In the मन्त्राः , these words जुष्ट and अर्पित have always the acute on the first syllable.
The acute accent is on the first syllable of युष्मद् and अस्मद् in the Genitive Singular.
The acute accent is on the first syllable of युष्मद् and अस्मद् in the Dative Singular.
Whatever is formed by the affix यत् , has, if it is a disyllabic word, the acute on the first syllable, with the exception of नाव्यः from नौ।
The acute accent is on the first syllable of ईड् , वन्द , वृ , शंस् and दुह् , when they are followed by the affix ण्यत्।
The acute accent is optionally on the first syllable of वेणु and इन्धान।
The acute accent is optionally on the first syllables of त्याग , राग , हास , कुह , श्वठ , and क्रथ।
The second last  स्वर of the प्रकृति-प्रत्यय-समुदाय that ends in a रित् प्रत्यय becomes उदात्त.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास the first member preserves its own original accent.

In a तत्-पुरुष समास the first member preserves its original accent when it is a word - 1. meaning 'a resemblance' or 2. an Instrumental or 3. a Locative or 4. a word with which the second member is compared or 5. an indeclinable or 6. an Accusative or 7. a Future Passive Participle
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when a word denoting colour is compounded with another colour denoting word but not so when it is the word एत।
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second term is गाध or लवण and the compound expresses 'a measure or mass'.
In a तत्-पुरुष समास having the word दायद् as its second member, the first member denoting inheritance preserves its original accent.
In a तत्-पुरुष समास having the words चिर or कृच्छ्र as its second member, the first member, when it denotes that which experiences an obstacle, preserves its original accent.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word पद denoting 'a pretext'.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word निवात in the sense of 'a protection from wind'.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word शारद having any other sense than that of 'autumnal'.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word अध्वर्यु or कषाय denoting a genus.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word सदृश or प्रतिरूप expressing resemblance with someone or something.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) denoting 'measure or quantity'.
Before the word वाणिज 'a trader' the first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its accent when it is a word specifying the place wither one has to go or the ware in which one deals.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the words 1. मात्रा 2. उपज्ञा 3. उपक्रम and 4. छाया when these words appear as neuter.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when its second term is सुख or प्रिय and the sense is 'to feel delight' or 'is good'.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when its second term is सुख or प्रिय and the sense is 'agreeable to one' or 'desired'.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when it denotes a thing possessed and when its second term is स्वामिन्।
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when it ends in पति and means 'master' or 'lord'.
The words भू , वाक् , चित् and दिधिषू however do not preserve their original accent in तत्-पुरुष समास when coming before the word पति denoting 'master' or 'lord'.
The word भुवन may optionally keep its accent in a तत्-पुरुष समास before the word पति denoting 'master' or 'lord'.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent before words आशङ्क , आबाध and नेदीयस् , when it treats about a supposition.
The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word पूर्व and the sense is 'this had been lately…'.

The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is 1. सविध 2. सनीड 3. समर्याद 4. सवेश and 5. सदेश in the sense of 'what can be found in the vicinity thereof'.
The words विस्पष्ट etc. preserve their accent when followed by an adjective word in a compound.

In a कर्मधारय समास the first member consisting of a भाव (verbal noun) preserves its original accent before the adjective forms built from श्र -- प्रशस्यस्य श्रः [[5.3.60]], ज्य -- ज्य च [[5.3.61]], अवम and कन् -- युवाल्पयोः कनन्यतरस्याम् [[5.3.64]], and before a form built from the word पाप।
In a कर्मधारय समास the first member consisting of the word कुमार preserves it original accent.
In a कर्मधारय समास of कुमार followed by प्रत्येनस् the acutely accented (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of कुमार।
The first syllable of कुमार is optionally acutely accented (उदात्त) when the second member is a word denoting 'the name of a horde'.

In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the first member preserves its original accent before a stem ending in a simple vowel with the exception of अ (इक्) before a word denoting time, as well as before 1. कपाल 2. भगाल and 3. शराव।
In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the word बहु may optionally preserve its accent when followed by an इक्-ending stem or by a time-word or by 1. कपाल 2. भगाल and 3. शराव।
In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the first member may optionally preserve its accent when followed by the words दिष्टि and वितस्ति।as its second members.
When a word ending in the Locative -7th case does not denote time preserves its original accent when followed by 1. सिद्ध 2. शुष्क 3. पक्व and 4. बन्ध in a compound.
The particles 1. परि 2. प्रति 3. उप and 4. अप preserve their accent before that word which specifies an exclusion or a portion of day and night (in an अव्ययीभाव समास also).
The first member of a द्वन्द समास formed of names denoting the क्षत्रिय (warrior) clans in the plural number retains its original accent when the warrior belongs to the clan of अन्धक or वृष्णि।
The numeral word standing as the first member of a द्वन्द समास , preserves its accent.
When words denoting scholars are named after their teachers and are compounded into a द्वन्द समास the first member retains its accent.
Also in the द्वन्द समास-s कार्तकौजप etc. the first members retain their accent.
The word महत् (महा) retains its accent before the following - 1. व्रीहि 2. अपराह्ण 3. गृष्टि 4. इष्वास 5. जाबाल 6. भार 7. भारत 8. हैलिहिल 9. रौरव and 10. प्रवृद्धे।
The words महत् and क्षुल्लक retain their accent before the word वैश्वदेव।
The word उष्ट्र retains its accent before सादि and वामि।
The word गो retains its accent before 1. साद 2. सादि and 3. सारथि।
The first member retains its accent in the following - 1. कुरु-गार्हपत 2. रिक्त-गुरु 3. असूत-जरती 4. अश्लील-दृढ-रूपा 5. पारे-वडवा 6. तैतिल-कद्रूः 7. पण्य-कम्बलः and 8. दासीभार etc.
A word in the Dative -4th Case as the first member retains its accent when the second member expresses that which is suited to become the former.
Before the word अर्थ the first member in the Dative -4th Case retains its accent.
The first member in the Dative -4th Case retains its accent before a Past Participle in क्त।
Before the Past Participle in क्त the first member when it itself is not a Past Participle, retains its original accent in a कर्मधारय समास ।
Before the Past Participle in क्त , a word ending in the Accusative -2nd case retains its accent when it does not mean a separation.
A word ending in the Instrumental -3rd case retains its accent before the Past Participle in क्त when it has a Passive meaning.
A word called गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], when standing immediately before a Participle in क्त having a Passive significance, retains its accent.
An immediately preceding गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], retains its original accent before (a word formed by) a कृत्-affix beginning with त् which as an indicatory न् but before तु।

An immediately preceding गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], retains its original accent before an Infinitive in तवै -- कृत्यार्थे तवैकेन्केन्यत्वनः [[3.4.14]], but whereby simultaneously the final has the acute as well.
An immediately preceding गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], not ending in इ or उ retains its accent before an affix having a व् follows.
The गति-s नि and अधि however retain their original accent before अञ्च् when the affix व् follows.
The word ईषत् when the first member of a compound may optionally preserve its original accent.
The first member denoting the quantity of gold retains optionally its original accent before the word धन।
The word प्रथम when first in a compound optionally retains its original accent when meaning 'a novice'.
The words कतर and कतम when as first member of a compound optionally retain their original accent in a कर्मधारय समास।
The word आर्य optionally retains its original accent in a कर्मधारय समास before the words ब्राह्मण and कुमार।
The word राजन् optionally retains its original accent in a कर्मधारय समास before the words ब्राह्मण and कुमार।
The word राजन् ending in Genitive 6th-Case optionally retains its original accent before the word प्रत्येनस्।
A word having the sense of 'always' optionally retains its original accent before a Past Participle in क्त ।
The word ग्राम when first member of a compound optionally retains its original accent before a word denoting 'a professional man or artisan'.
The word राजन् optionally retains its original accent after a profession-denoting noun when praise is expressed.

In the following up to -- न भूताधिकसंजीवमद्राश्मकज्जलम् [[6.2.91]], inclusive, the phrase 'the first syllable in -(the word standing in the Nominative 1st-Case) has the acute accent (उदात्त)' is always to be supplied.

If the first member of a compound is in the Locative -7th case or denoting the name of the Receiver of Tax, has acutely accented (उदात्त) first syllable, when the second member is a word denoting 'what is lawful', but not when it is हरण।
The first member of a compound has acute on the first syllable when the second member denotes that by whom the things denoted by the first are regulated or kept in order.
The acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable is optional when the word अध्यक्ष follows.
The word पाप is optionally acutely accented (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by a word denoting a professional man.
The first syllable of the first member of a compound is acutely accented (उदात्त) before a गोत्र (Patronymic) name or a Scholar-name and also before माणव and ब्राह्मण when a reproach is meant.
The first syllable of the word preceding मैरेय gets the acute accent (उदात्त) when it denotes the ingredient of the same.
A word denoting food gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when before a word which denotes a repository suited to contain that.
A word denoting the object of comparison gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when standing before गो , बिडाल , सिंह and सैन्धव।

A word denoting the object of comparison gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when the second member is a word ending in the affix अक and the compound expresses a calling by which one gets his living.
A compound, the second member of which is a word ending in affix अक and which denotes the sport of the Eastern people, gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
A compound, the second member of which is a word ending in the कृत् -affix अण् and which denotes a functionary, gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

And when such a compound ending in अण् -affix denotes the name of a professional man, but not when the second term कार(derived from कृञ्), the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the first syllable of the first word.
Also when such an उपपद compound ending in अण् -affix denotes a Name, the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable but not when the second term is कार।
The words 1. गो 2. तन्ति and 3. यव get the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by पाल।
A compound ending in कृत् -affix णिनि (इन्) has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable of the first member.

When the first member of a compound expresses that with which resemblance is denoted then it has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable before a word formed by णिनि (इन्) affix, only then, when such latter word is radical without any preposition and means 'giving out a definite sound like so and so'.
The compounds युक्तारोहिन् etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
When the first member is a word ending in a long vowel or is 1. काश 2. तुष 3. भ्राष्ट्र 4. वट and is followed by ज , the acutely accented (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable.
In a word consisting of more than two syllables followed by ज , the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the syllable before the last.
Before ग्राम the first syllable of the first member as acute accent (उदात्त) when thereby inhabitants are not meant.
The first member has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by घोषा etc.
The words छात्रि etc. get acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by the word शाला।
The first member which has not a वृद्धि in the first syllable or which is not कर्की etc. gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable before प्रस्थ।
The first syllable of माला etc. gets the acute accent (उदात्त) when प्रस्थ follows.
The first member has an acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable before the word नगर but not when it is the word महत् or नव , nor when it refers to a city in the lands of the Northern People.
A word of two or three syllables ending in a अ or आ (with the exception of महा and नव) standing before the word अर्म has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
The following words do not get acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when standing before अर्म etc. - 1. भूत 2. अधिक 3. संजीव 4. मद्र 5. अश्मन् and 6. कञ्जल।

In the following sūtras up to निष्ठोपसर्गपूर्वमन्यतरस्याम् [[6.2.110]], inclusive, is to be supplied the phrase 'the last syllable in a word standing in the Nominative 1st-Case has the acute accent (उदात्त)'.
The acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final of the word सर्व standing as the first member before an attributive word in the sense 'whole, through and through'.
The last syllable of the first member before गिरि and निकाय has the acute accent (उदात्त) when the compound is a Name.
The last syllable of the first member get the acute accent (उदात्त) when the word कुमारी follows, the compound denoting age.
Before the word उदक when the compound denotes a mixture, the last syllable of the first member has the acute accent (उदात्त).
Before a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound), when the compound denotes a sacrifice, the last syllable of the first member has the acute accent (उदात्त).
Before the word सभा when it is exhibited as Neuter, the first member of the compound gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.
Before the word पुर , when the compound denotes a city of the Eastern People, the final of the final of the first member as the acute accent (उदात्त).
When the words अरिष्ट and गौड stand first, the first member has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final before the word पुर।
But when the words 1. हास्तिन 2. फलक and 3. मार्देय precede पुर , the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on their final.
The words 1. कुसूल 2. कूप 3. कुम्भ and 4. शाला have the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable before the word बिल।
Words expressing (in space of time) have acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable when followed by a word denoting a village or a country or a narrative before the word चानराट।
The direction denoting words have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final, before the names of scholars when such names derived from those of their teachers.
Words denoting direction and the word सर्व have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final before a word which takes वृद्धि in the first syllable of the second term by सुसर्वार्धाज्जनपदस्य [[7.3.12]].
The word विश्व has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final, being first member in a बहुव्रीहि समास , when it is a Name.
The first member in a बहुव्रीहि समास , before the words 1. उदर 2. अश्व and 3. इषु , gets acute accent (उदात्त) on the final syllable when the compound denotes a Name.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास having the word बन्धु as its second member, the first member ending in the feminine affix ई (नदी word) has the ac on its final syllable.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास a Participle in a क्त preceded by a preposition, standing as the first member of the compound has optionally acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.
In the following sūtras up to कुण्डं वनम् [[6.2.136]], inclusive, should always be supplied the phrase 'the first syllable of the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त)'.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास the word कर्ण standing as second member has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when it is preceded by a word denoting colour or mark.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास the second member कर्ण has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when the compound denotes a Name or Resemblance.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास expressing a Name or comparison the second members 1. कण्ठ 2. पृष्ठ 3. ग्रीवा and 4. जङ्घा have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास denoting age (as well as a Name or a Resemblance), the second member शृङ्ग gets acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
After a Negative Particle, in a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of 1. जर 2. मर 3. मित्र and 4. मृत।
After the adjective सु in a बहुव्रीहि समास a stem ending in मन् and अस् with the exception of लोमन् and उषस् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
After the adjective सु in a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of क्रतु etc.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास in the छन्दस् (Vedas) a word of two syllables with acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when preceded by सु gets acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after सु the words वीर and वीर्य have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
In an अव्ययीभाव समास the following second terms have acute accent (उदात्त) on their first syllable - 1. कूल 2. तीर 3. तूल 4. मूल 5. शाला 6. अक्ष and 7. सम।
In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the following second members get acute accent (उदात्त) on their first syllable - 1. कंस 2. मन्थ 3. शूर्प 3. पाय्य and 4. काण्ड।
The word शाला at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास when exhibited in the Neuter has acute on the first syllable.
In a Neuter तत्-पुरुष समास ending in कन्था the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of the second member.
In a Neuter तत्-पुरुष समास ending in कन्था the first syllable of चिहण etc. have the acute accent (उदात्त).
The words 1. चेल 2. खेट 3. कटुक and 4. काण्ड at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when a reproach is meant.
The word चीर at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when something is compared with it.
In a तत्-पुरुष समास ending in 1. पलल 2. सूप and 3. शाक the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of these when the compound denotes a food mixed or seasoned with something.
The words 1. कूल 2. सूद 3. स्थल and 4. कर्ष have acute accent (उदात्त) on their first syllable when at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास denoting a Name.
The word राज्यम् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास which is not a कर्मधारय समास ।
At the end of a non-कर्मधारय तत्-पुरुष समास the words वर्ग्य etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
The word पुत्र coming after a Masculine noun in a तत्-पुरुष समास has a acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

The word पुत्र does not have an acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when preceded by a word which falls under the category of teachers, kings, priests, wife's relations and agnates and cognates.
The words चूर्ण etc. in a तत्-पुरुष समास have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when preceding word ends in a Genitive 6th-Case and does not denote a living being.
The six words - 1. काण्ड 2. चीर 3. पलल 4. सूप 5. शाक and 6. कूल of sūtras [[6.2.126]]-129 preceded by a non-living Genitive 6th-Case word have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
The word कुण्ड at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास denoting 'a wood or forest' has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.
The word भगाल at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent.
After शिति , a word retains in a बहुव्रीहि समास its original accent when it is always of not more than two syllables with the exception of भसद्.।

In a तत्-पुरुष समास a word ending in a कृत् affix preserves its original accent when preceded by an indeclinable called गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], or a noun standing in intimate relation to a verb (कारक) or any word which gives occasion for compounding (उपपद -- तत्रोपपदं सप्तमीस्थम् [[3.1.92]])
In वनस्पति etc. both members of the compound preserve their original accent simultaneously.
In a द्वन्द compound of the Names of Divinities, both the members retain their original accent.

In a द्वन्द compound of the Names of Divinities, both members of the compound simultaneously do not retain their accent when the first syllable of the second word is अनुदात्त with the exception of 1.पृथिवी 2. रुद्र 3. पूष and 4. मन्थिन्।
In the following sūtras up to the end of this chapter should always be supplied the phrase 'the last syllable of the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त)'.

The last syllable of the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त) in the verbal nouns ending in 1. थ 2. अथ 3. घञ् 4. क्त 5. अच् 6. अप् 7. इत्र and 8. क when preceded by a गति , a कारक or an उपपद -- गतिकारकोपपदात् कृत् [[6.2.139]]
The Participle in क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when it is preceded by सु or by a word with which the second member is compared.
The Participle in क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable when preceded by a गति or a कारक or an उपपद if the compound denotes a Name, but not in आचित etc.
The word प्रवृद्ध etc. ending in क्त have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

The final of Part Participles दत्त and श्रुत alone have the acute accent (उदात्त) in a compound denoting a Name and a Benediction, the preceding word being a word standing in close relation to an action (कारक)।
The Participle in क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when the compound denotes 'done by one in such a condition'.

After a कारक as mentioned in कारकाद्दत्तश्रुतयोरेवाशिषि [[6.2.148]], the second member ending in the affix अन and denoting an action in the Abstract or the object (i.e. having the senses of Passive Adjective), has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

The words ending in मन् or क्तिन् affixes and the words 1. व्याख्यान 2. शयन 3. आसन 4. स्थान and 5. क्रीत as well as याजक etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when at the end of a compound preceded by कारक word.
The word पुण्य has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by a Noun in the Locative -7th case.
The acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the final of words having the sense of ऊन and of कलह when they are second members in a compound, preceded by a term in the Instrumental -3rd case.
The word मिश्र has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after an Instrumental -3rd case when it is not joined with any Preposition and does not mean a 'compact or alliance'.

The words formed with the तद्धित affixes denoting 'fitted for that' -- सम्पादिनि [[5.1.99]], 'deserving that' -- तद् अर्हति [[5.1.63]], 'good for that' -- तस्मै हितम् [[5.1.5]], 'capable to effect that' -- तस्मै प्रभवति संतापादिभ्यः [[5.1.101]], have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by the Negative Particle नञ् , when it makes a negation with regard to the above mentioned attributes.
The words formed with the तद्धित affixes य and यत् when not denoting 'useful for that' have acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable after the particle नञ् negating the attribute.
A word formed with the कृत् affixes अच् and क preceded by the particle नञ् has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when the meaning is 'not capable'.
A word formed by the कृत् affixes अच् and क preceded by a Negative Particle have an acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when one abuses somebody by that word.
When abuse is meant, a word preceded by नञ् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in denoting a Name.
After the Negative Particle, the words formed by the कृत्य affixes -- कृत्याः प्राङ् ण्वुलः [[3.1.95]], by उक and इष्णुच् and the words चारु etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.
After the negative particle, the final of the following is optionally acute accent (उदात्त) - a word formed with the affix तृन् and the words 1. अन्न 2. तीक्ष्ण and 3. शुचि।
In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after the words इदम् , एतद् and तद् the last syllable of प्रथम and of a proper ordinal numeral as the acute accent (उदात्त) when the number of times of an action is meant.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after a numeral the word स्तन has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.
Optionally so, in the छन्दस् (Vedas), the स्तन after a numeral has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in मित्र and अजिन the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the last syllable when the compound denotes a Name.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in अन्तर the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final after a word which denotes 'that which lies between'.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final when the second member is मुख 'mouth' i.e. the actual bodily part of an animal and not used metaphorically.

In a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on such मुख 'mouth' denoting a real mouth when it comes after an indeclinable and a name of a direction or after 1. गो 2. महत् 3. स्थूल 4. मुष्टि 5. पृथु and 6. वत्स।
In a बहुव्रीहि समास the word मुख denoting 'an actual mouth' has optionally the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by a participle in त or by that wherewith something is compared.

After a word denoting a species (with the exception of a word for 'garment or covering') and after a time-denoting word as well as after सुख etc. the Participle in the क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in a बहुव्रीहि समास but not so when the participles are 1. कृत 2. मित 3. प्रतिपन्न।
After a species (with the exception of a word for 'garment or covering') or a time-denoting word or after सुख etc. in a बहुव्रीहि समास the word जात has optionally acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास formed by the negative particle नञ् or by सु has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable of the compound.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास formed by the negative particle नञ् or by सु and ending in the affix कप् -- नद्यृतश्च [[5.4.153]], has acute accent (उदात्त) on the syllable preceding the affix.

When the compound ends in a light vowel the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the syllable before such last, in a बहुव्रीहि समास preceded by नञ् and सु to which the affix कप् -- नद्यृतश्च [[5.4.153]], is added.
A बहुव्रीहि समास with बहु has the same accent as नञ् when it denotes muchness of the object expressed by the second member.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after बहु the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on the final of गुण etc. when they appear in the compound as ingredient of something else.
A word denoting a part of the body which is constant (and indispensable) with the exception of पर्शु has after a preposition in a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.
After a preposition वन has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in compounds of every kind.
After अन्तर् the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the final of वन।
The word अन्तर् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by a preposition.
The word अन्तर् does not have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after the prepositions नि and वि।
After परि a word which expresses something which has both this side and that side, as well as the word मण्डल has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.
After प्र a, a word which does not denote a part of the body has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when the compound is a name.
The words निरुदकetc. Have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.
The word मुख has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by अभि।
The word मुख has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after the preposition अप्।
The words 1. स्फिग 2. पूत 3. वीणा 4. अञ्जस् 5. अध्वम् 6. कुक्षि 6. नामन् and a word denoting 'a plough' have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by the preposition अप्।
After अधि that word which denotes that thing which overlaps or stands upon has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.
After अनु a word which is not the Principal as well as कनीयस् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.
After अनु the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the final of पुरुष when it means a man of whom mention was already made.
After अति , a word not formed by a कृत् affix and the word पद have acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.
After नि the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable when the sense is of 'not laying down'.
In a तत्-पुरुष समास the words अंशु etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by प्रति।
In a तत्-पुरुष समास the words of two syllables and अजिन् have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by उप but not when they are गौर etc.
After सु the second member has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in a तत्-पुरुष समास when reproach is meant, in spite of the addition of सु which denotes praise.
In a तत्-पुरुष समास the word उत्पुच्छ may optionally have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.
In a बहुव्रीहि समास the words 1. पाद् 2. दत् and 3. मूर्धन् have optionally acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after द्वि and त्रि।
The word सक्थ has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final optionally when preceded by any word other than what ends in क्र।
In the following sūtras up to विभाषा स्वसृपत्योः [[6.3.24]], inclusive, is always to be supplied the phrase 'the elision does not take place before the second member of the compound'.
The Ablative -5th case-ending after स्तोक etc. is not elided before the second member of a compound.
The Instrumental -3rd case endings after 1. ओजस् 2. सहस् 3. अम्भस् and 4. तमस् are not elided before the second member of a compound.
After मनस् when the compound is a Name, the Instrumental -3rd case endings are not elided before the second member.
Also before आज्ञायिन् the Instrumental -3rd case endings of मनस् are not elided.
The Instrumental -3rd case endings after आत्मान् are not elided when an Ordinal Numeral follows.
The Dative -4th Case ending is not elided after आत्मान् when the compound is the name of a technical term in grammar.
The Locative -7th case ending is not elided after a stem ending in a consonant or a short अ when the compound is a Name.
The Locative -7th case affix is not elided after a stem ending in a consonant or a short अ in the name of atax of the Eastern People when the second member begins with a consonant.
The Locative -7th case-affix is not elided after मध्य when गुरु follows.
is not elided after a word denoting a part of the body (with the exception of मूर्धन् and मस्तक) before every word other than काम।
The Locative -7th case-affix is optionally not elided after a word ending in a consonant or अ before बन्ध।
In a तत्-पुरुष समास when the second member is a word formed with a कृत् affix the Locative -7th case ending is optionally preserved.
The Locative -7th case-affix ending is retained after 1. प्रावट् 2. काल and 3. दिव् when ज follows.
The Locative -7th case-affix ending is optionally retained after 1. वर्ष 2. क्षर 3. शर and 4. वर when ज follows.
The Locative -7th case-affix ending is optionally retained after a word denoting time ending in a consonant or अ when तरप् or तमप् or the word काल or the affix तन follow.
The Locative -7th case-affix ending is optionally retained after the words 1. शय 2. वास and 3. वासिन् when the preceding word does not denote time and ends in a consonant or a short अ।
The Locative -7th case ending is not preserved before a stem ending in इन् before he word सिद्ध and before a word derived from बन्ध् ।
The Locative -7th case ending is not preserved before स्थ in the spoken language.
The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is retained when the compound expresses an 'affront or insult'.
The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is optionally retained when insult is meant when पुत्र follows.
The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is retained after a word ending in ऋ and expressing a relationship through study or blood.
The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is optionally elided after a stem ending in ऋ when 1. स्वसृ and 2. पितृ follow.
In a द्वन्द समास of words ending in the short ऋ and expressing relationship through study or blood, the आनङ् is the substitute of ऋ of the first member.
The आनङ् is the substitute for the final of the first member in a द्वन्द समास of the names of the देवता-s.
For the final of अग्नि is substituted the long ई when 1. सोम or 2. वरुण follow.
The short इ is the substitute of the final of the अग्नि in such a द्वन्द समास in which both the members take the वृद्धि।
For दिव् is substituted द्यावा in a द्वन्द समास of names of देवता-s.
For दिव् is also substituted दिवस् (as well as a द्यावा) when पृथिवी follows in a द्वन्द समास of names of देवता-s.
For उषस् is substituted उषासा in a देवता - द्वन्द समास।
According to Northern Grammarians मातरपितरौ is a valid form.
In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the form पितरामातरा is a valid form.

In the room of a feminine word there is substituted an equivalent and uniform masculine form when it is a word which has an actual corresponding masculine and does not end in the feminine affix ऊङ् and is followed by another feminine word in the relation of apposition with it, but not when such subsequent word is an ordinal numeral, nor प्रिय etc.

A feminine word not ending in the affix ऊङ् and having an equivalent and uniform masculine is changed into such masculine form, before the affixes beginning with तसिल् etc. -- पञ्चम्यास्तसिल् [[5.3.7]], and ending with कृत्वसुच् -- संख्यायाः क्रियाऽभ्यावृत्तिगणने कृत्वसुच् [[5.4.17]].
A feminine word not ending in ऊङ् and having an equivalent and uniform masculine is changed into masculine before the Denominative कयङ् and the affix मानिन्।
A feminine word having a penultimate क् does not assume the masculine form.
The feminine is not changed to masculine when it is a Name or an Ordinal Numeral.

The feminine is not changed into masculine when it is formed by such a तद्धित affix which causes the वृद्धि of the first syllable with exception however of तद्धित-substitute meaning 'coloured therewith' and 'made thereof'.
A feminine in ई ending in the name of a part of body does not become masculine except the word मानिन् follows.
A feminine noun expressing a class of kind does not become masculine.
The feminine (unless it ends in ऊ) having an equivalent and uniform masculine becomes masculine in a कर्मधारय समास and before 1. जातीय and 2. देशीय।

Before the affixes 1. तर 2. तम 3. रूप 4. कल्प 5. चेल (with the feminine affix ई) 6. ब्रुव 7. गोत्र 8 मत and 9. हत a word ending in the feminine affix ङी becomes short when the feminine consists of two or more syllables and has an equivalent and uniform masculine.
In all the remaining feminine words called नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी [[1.4.3]] and नेयङुवङ्स्थानावस्त्री [[1.4.4]], the substitution of short vowel under the preceding circumstances is optional.
The feminine ङी (ई) added to a word formed by a तद्धित affix having an indicatory उ or ऋ is optionally shortened before the घ etc. -- घरूपकल्पचेलड्ब्रुवगोत्रमतहतेषु ङ्योऽनेकाचो ह्रस्वः [[6.3.43]].
For the final महत् of is substituted आत् (आ) before a word which is in apposition with it and before जातीय।
The words द्वि and अष्टन् get an आकारादेश in presence of a  सङ्ख्याशब्द, provided that there is no बहुव्रीहि समास and the word अशीति is not present.
The words त्रि gets an आकारादेश in presence of a  सङ्ख्याशब्द, provided that there is no बहुव्रीहि समास and the word अशीति is not present.
The above substitution is the case of all (द्वि , त्रि and अष्टन्) is optional when the word चत्वारिंशत् and the numerals which follow it are the second member.
हृद् is substituted for हृदय before लेख and the affixes यत् and अण् and before लास।
हृद् is optionally substituted for हृदय before the words शोक and रोग or the affix ष्यङ् follow.
पद् is substituted for पाद before 1. आजि 2. आति 3. ग and 4. उपहत।
पद् is substituted for पाद before the affix यत् used in any sense other than that of 'suited there to'.
पद् is substituted for पाद before 1. हिम 2. काषिन् and 3. हति।
पद् is substituted for पाद before the affix शस् when the meaning is that of a ऋक् (Hymn).
पद् is optionally substituted for पाद before 1. घोष 2. मिश्र and 3. शब्द।
उद is substituted for उदक when the compound is a Name.
उद is substituted for उदक before 1. पेषं 2. वास 3. वाह and 4. धि।
उद is optionally substituted for उदक before a word beginning with a single consonant and which expresses that which is filled with water.
उद is optionally substituted for उदक before 1. मन्थ 2. ओदन 3. सक्तु 4. बिन्दु 5. वज्र 5. भार 6. हार 7. वीवध and 8. गाह।
According to the opinion of गालव a short vowel is substituted in a compound before the second member for the long इक् vowels (ई , ऊ , ॠ) unless it is the long vowel of the feminine affix ई (ङी).
The short is substituted for the long एका before a तद्धित affix and when a second member follows.
The short is diversely substituted for the feminine affixes ई and आ (ङी and आप्) in a Name and in the छन्दस् (Vedas).
The feminine affixes ई and आ (ङी and आप्) diversely become short before the affix त्व।
For the long vowel a short is substituted in इष्टका before चित in इषीका before तूल and in माला before भारिन्।
A short is always substituted for the final of the first member when the second member is a word formed by an affix having an indicatory ख but not when the first member is an indeclinable.
मुम् is the augment added immediately after the final vowel of अरुस , द्विषत् and of a stem ending in a vowel unless it is an indeclinable, when the word formed by a खित् affix follows.

A monosyllabic word ending in any vowel other than अ when followed by a word formed by a खित् affix receives the augment अम् which is added in the same way as the affix अम् of the Accusative -2nd case singular.
वाचंयम and पुरंदर are irregularly formed.
मुम् is the augment of सत्य and अगद when the word कार follows.
मुम् is the augment of the words श्येन and तिल before पात when the affix ञ् follows.
The word रात्रि optionally takes मुम् augment before a word formed by कृत् affix.
The न of the Negative Particle नञ् is elided when it is the first member of a compound.
After the above न-elided of the Negative Particle नञ् (i.e. after अ) is added the augment नुट् to a word beginning with a vowel.
The Negative Particle remains unchanged in - 1. नभ्राज् 2. नपात् 3. नवेदस् 4. नासत्या (dual) 5. नमुचि 6. नकुल 7. नख 8. नपुंसक 9. नक्षत्र 10. नक्र and 11. नाक।
The Negative Particle remains unchanged in a word which begins with एक and of this एक there is the augment अदुक् (अद्)।
The Negative Particle is optionally retained unchanged in नगो when it does not mean a living animate being.
स is substituted for सह , in a Name.
स is substituted for सह when it has the sense of 'up to the end'.
स is substituted for सह when it is in connection with a word which refers to a second object which latter however is not directly perceived.
स is substituted for सह in an अव्ययीभाव समास when the second member is not a word denoting time.
स is optionally substituted for सह when the compound is a बहुव्रीहि समास।
The word सह retains its original form when the sentence denotes benediction, except when it is गो , वत्स or हल।
स is substituted for समान् in the छन्दस् (Vedas), but not before 1. मूर्धन् 2. प्रभृति and 3. उदर्क।
This substitution of स for समान् takes place before 1. ज्योतिस् 2. जनपद 3. रात्रि 4. गोत्र 5. रूप 6. स्थान 7. वर्ण 8. वयस् 9. वचन and 10. बन्धु in the common language also.
स is substituted for समान् before ब्रह्मचारिन् when it denotes persons engaged in fulfilling a common vow of studying the Vedas.
स is substituted for समान् before तीर्थ when the affix यत् is added to it.
स is optionally substituted for समान् before उदर when the affix यत् is added to it.
स is substituted for समान् before 1. दृग् 2. दृश and the affix वत्।
ई is substituted for इदम् and की for किम् before the words 1. दृग् 2. दृश and the affix वत्।
आ is substituted for the final of the pronouns - सर्वादीनि सर्वनामानि [[1.1.27]], before the words 1. दृग् 2. दृश and the affix वत्।
In the room of the last consonant that follows it, of a pronoun and of the words विषवक् and देव is substituted अद्रि when अञ्च् with the affix व follows.
If the 'सम्' उपसर्ग is followed by an लुप्तप्रत्ययान्त-अञ्च् word, then 'सम्'  is converted to 'समि'.

items.anvaya: अप्रत्यये अलोपे अञ्चतौ उत्तरपदे तिरसः तिरि
items.english: If the word 'तिरस्' is followed by a  लुप्तप्रत्ययान्त-अञ्च् word from which an अकार has not been removed, then the word 'तिरस्' is converted to 'तिरि'.
If the word 'सह' is followed by an लुप्तप्रत्ययान्त-अञ्च् word, then 'सह'  is converted to 'सध्रि'.
सध is substituted for सह in the छन्दस् (Vedas) when माद and स्थ follow.
After 1. द्वि 2. अन्तर and prepositions, long ई is the substitute of अप्।
After अनु , ऊ is substituted for (the अ of) अप् when the sense is that of a locality.
अन्य when not used in the Genitive 6th-Case or the Instrumental -3rd case gets the augment दुक् (द्) before 1. आशिस् 2. आशा 3. आस्था 4. उत्सुक 5. कारक and 6. राग as well as before the affix छ (ईय).
दुक् (द्) is optionally the augment of अन्य when अर्थ follows.
कत् is substituted for कु in a तत्-पुरुष समास when a word beginning with a vowel follows as the second member.
कत् is substituted for कु before रथ and वद।
कत् is substituted for कु when तृण follows denoting a species.
का is the substitute of कु before पथिन् and अक्ष।
का is the substitute of कु when the meaning is 'a small'.
का is optionally the substitute of कु when the word पुरुष follows.
का and कवङ् are optionally the substitutes of कु when उष्ण follows.
This substitution of का and कव for कु takes place in the छन्दस् (Vedas) before पथ।

The elision, augment and mutation of letters to be seen in पृषोदर etc. though not found taught in the treatises of Grammar, are valid to that extent and in the mode, as taught by the usage of the sages.

items.anvaya: संख्या-वि-साय-पूर्वस्य उत्तरपदे अह्नस्य ङौ अहन् अन्यतरस्याम्
items.english: When the word अह्न appears as an उत्तरपद in a समास where the पूर्वपद is either a number, or the words वि or साय, it is optionally converted to अहन् in presence of the प्रत्यय ङि.
When a ढकार is deleted due to a ढकार that follows it, or when a रेफ is deleted due to a रेफ that follows the अण् letter occurring before the deleted ढकार/रेफ becomes दीर्घ.
For the verbs सह् and वह्, when a ढकार is deleted due to a ढकार that follows it,  the अकार occurring before the deleted ढकार is converted to ओ.
1. साढ्यै 2. साढ्वा and 3. साढा are irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).
In the following sūtras up to the end of the पाद are to be supplied the words 'in an uninterrupted flow of speech'.

Before कर्ण there is the substitution of a long vowel for the final of the preceding word when it denotes a proprietorship mark or the ears of cattle, but not when the words 1. विष्ट 2. अष्टन् 3. पञ्चन् 4. मणि 5. भिन्न 6. छिन्न 7. छिद्र 8. स्रुव and 9. स्वस्तिक।
A long vowel is substituted for the final vowel of the preceding word, before the verbs 1. नह् 2. वृत् 3. वृष् 4. व्यध् 5. रुच् 6. सह् and 7. तन् when these roots take the affix क्वि।
For the final vowel of कोटर etc. a long vowel is substituted before वन and also of किंशुलक etc. before गिरि when the compound is a name.
The final of the preceding word is lengthened before the affix वल।
The final vowel of a word consisting of more than two syllables in lengthened before the affix मत् when it is a name, but not of the words अजिर् etc.
The final vowel of शर etc. is lengthened before मत् when it is a name.
The final इ and the उ of a word with the exception of पीलु are lengthened before वह।
The final vowel of a preposition is diversely lengthened before a word formed by the कृत् affix घञ् but not when the compound denotes a human being.
A preposition ending in इ or उ lengthens its final before काश।
A preposition ending in इ or उ lengthens its final before the verb दा when the latter is changed to त।
A long vowel is substituted for the final of अष्टन् before a second member, when the compound is a Name.
In the छन्दस् (Vedas) also, the long vowel is substituted for the final of अष्टन् before a second member.
The final word of चिति is lengthened before the affix कप्।
The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before वसु and राट् (the form assumed by राज्).
The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before नर when the compound is a Name.
The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before मित्र when it is the name of a ऋषि।
In a मन्त्र the final vowels of 1. सोम 2. अश्व 3. इन्द्रिय and 4. विश्वदेव्य are lengthened when the affix मतुप् follows.
In a मन्त्र the final of ओषधि is lengthened before the case-endings but not in the Nominative 1st-Case.
In the ऋग्वेद the finals of the particles 1. तु 2. नु 3. घ 4. मक्षु , the tense-affix तङ् , कु the ending त्र and the word उरुष्य are lengthened.
In a मन्त्र the finals of the preceding member ending in इ or उ are lengthened before the particle सु।
A tense affix ending in अ is lengthened in the ऋग्वेद when the verb consists of two syllables.
In the ऋग्वेद the final of a particle is lengthened.
The elongation of the final is to be found in other words also.
When the अञ्च् word is in a state where its अकार and नकार have been removed, it causes the दीर्घ of the previous अण् letter.
In all the rules starting from this sutra till the end of the seventh chapter the word 'अङ्गस्य' should be included while interpreting the sutras.
The letter which has been generated using सम्प्रसारणम् and which occurs at end of an अङ्ग becomes दीर्घ when there is a हल् letter which occurs just before it in that अङ्ग.
In presence of the   नाम् प्रत्यय, the last letter of the अङ्ग becomes दीर्घ.
The words तिसृ and चतसृ do not become दीर्घ in presence of the  नाम् प्रत्यय.
In presence of the नाम् प्रत्यय, the last letter of the अङ्ग might or might not be made दीर्घ in वेदाः.
In presence of the नाम् प्रत्यय, the last letter of the word नृ becomes दीर्घ optionally.
The उपधा of the नकारान्त words becomes दीर्घ when the नकारान्त word is followed by the नाम्-प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: नः अङ्गस्य उपधायाः असम्बुद्धौ सर्वनामस्थाने दीर्घः
items.english: The  उपधा letter of a नकारान्त अङ्ग becomes दीर्घ when followed by a प्रत्यय which is a सर्वनामस्थान other than सम्बोधन-एकवचन.

items.anvaya: निगमे षपूर्वस्य नः अङ्गस्य उपधायाः असम्बुद्धौ सर्वनामस्थाने वा दीर्घः
items.english: When followed by a प्रत्यय which is a सर्वनामस्थान other than सम्बोधन-एकवचन, the उपधा स्वर of a नकारान्त अङ्ग becomes optionally दीर्घ in वेदाः, if that उपधा स्वर is preceded by a षकार.

items.anvaya: सान्तसंयोगस्य अङ्गस्य, महतः अङ्गस्य नः उपधायाः असम्बुद्धौ सर्वनामस्थाने दीर्घः
items.english:
The स्वर preceding the नकार from (a) महत् and (b) any word that ends in न्स् - becomes दीर्घ in presence of 
प्रत्यय that is also a सर्वनामस्थान, other than सम्बोधन-एकवचन.

The उपधा letter of the words अप्, स्वसृ, नप्तृ, नेष्टृ, त्वष्टृ, क्षत्तृ, होतृ, पोतृ, and प्रशातृ, and also of the words ending in a तृन् or तृच् प्रत्यय becomes दीर्घ in presence of a प्रत्यय that is also a सर्वनामस्थान, other than सम्बोधन-एकवचन.

items.anvaya: इन्-हन्-पूष-अर्यम्णामङ्गस्य असम्बुद्धौ सर्वनामस्थाने उपधायाः दीर्घः शौ
items.english: For the words हन्, पूषन् and अर्यमन्, and for also the words that end in 'इन्', the उपधादीर्घ happens only in case of the 'शि' प्रत्यय, and not in case of other सर्वनामस्थानप्रत्ययाः.

items.anvaya: इन्-हन्-पूष-अर्यम्णामङ्गस्य असम्बुद्धौ सौ सर्वनामस्थाने च उपधायाः दीर्घः
items.english: For the words हन्, पूषन् and अर्यमन्, and for also the words that end in 'इन्', the उपधादीर्घ happens in case of the सुँ-प्रत्यय of प्रथमा-एकवचन.

items.anvaya: अधातोः अतु-अस्-अन्तस्य असम्बुद्धौ सौ उपधायाः दीर्घः
items.english: The उपधा of the words ending in either मत्, वत्, or अस् becomes दीर्घ in presence of the सुँ-प्रत्यय of  प्रथमा एकवचन, provided these words do not end in a धातु.

items.anvaya: अनुनासिकस्य अङ्गस्य उपधायाः क्वि-झलोः क्ङिति दीर्घः
items.english: If an अङ्ग ends in an अनुनासिक, the उपधा letter of that अङ्ग  becomes दीर्घ in presence of a क्विप्-प्रत्यय, झलादि-कित्-प्रत्यय and a झलादि-ङित्-प्रत्यय.

The lengthening of the vowel takes place in the case of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a vowel, as well as of हन् and गम् when the Desiderative affix सन् being झलादि (i.e. not taking the augment इट्) follows.
the lengthened of the अङ्ग (stem) of तन् is optional before the Desiderative सन् when it does not take the augment इट्।
The उपधा letter of the verb-root 'क्रम्' undergoes an optional दीर्घादेश when followed by a झलादि क्त्वा प्रत्यय.
The last 'त्छ्' of an अङ्ग is converted to 'श्', and the last 'व्' of an अङ्ग is converted to 'ऊठ्' when followed by an अनुनासिकादि or झलादि प्रत्यय that is either कित् or ङित् ।

In 1. ज्वर 2. त्वर् 3. श्रिव् 4. अव and 5. मव् before the above mentioned affixes (क्वि and झलादि ङित् and कित् affixes -- अनुनासिकस्य क्विझलोः क्ङिति [[6.4.15]]) there is the single substitution of ऊठ् for the and the vowel preceding the final consonant.
After र् there is the elision of छ् and व् before क्वि and झलादि ङित् and कित् affixes -- अनुनासिकस्य क्विझलोः क्ङिति [[6.4.15]].
All the sutras present from here onward till the the end of this पाद should be considered as असिद्ध towards each other when they are invoked in such a way that their आश्रयs are exactly the same.
After न which is added to the roots of the रुधादिगणः (7th Conjugation) as a गणविकरण - श्नम् (characteristic), there is the elision of the following न।

items.anvaya: अनिदितां हलः अङ्गस्य उपधायाः क्ङिति नलोपः ।
items.english: The उपधा नकार of an अङ्ग that is अनिदित् and हलन्त is removed in presence of a कित् or a ङित्-प्रत्यय.
The उपधा-नकार of the verbs दंश्, सञ्ज् and स्वञ्ज् is removed in presence of the विकरणप्रत्यय शप् ।
The उपधा-नकार of the verb रञ्ज् is removed in presence of the विकरणप्रत्यय शप्.
When followed by the घञ्-प्रत्यय in the meaning of  भाव or करण the उपधा-नकार of the verb root रञ्ज् is removed.
The word स्यद् is formed by घञ् in the sense of 'speed'.
1. अवोद 2. एध 3. ओद्म 4. प्रश्रथ and 5. हिमश्रथ are irregularly formed by the elision.
When used in the meaning of 'to pray', the नकार of the verb root  अञ्च् is not removed.
In presence of the क्त्वा प्रत्यय, the  उपधा-नकार of the verb roots  स्कन्द् and स्यन्द् is not removed.
The उपधा नकार of the  जकारान्त verb roots and the verb root 'नश्' is optionally removed when followed by the क्त्वा प्रत्यय.
The nasal may be optionally elided in भञ्ज before the 3rd person passive of the Aorist in चिण् (ई).
Before the Aorist in अङ् and before an affix beginning with a consonant having an indicatory क् or ङ् there is the substitution of ई for the vowel of शास्।
The शास्-धातु gets the 'शा' आदेश when followed by the हि-प्रत्यय of लोट्लकार.
The 'हन्' धातु gets the 'ज' आदेश when followed by the हि-प्रत्यय of लोट्लकार.

1) For the verb roots that end in an अनुनासिक letter and have an अनुदात्त स्वर in the उपदेश,
2) For the verb root वन्, and
3) For the verb roots that end in an अनुनासिक letter and belong to the तनोत्यादिगण, 

The अनुनासिक is removed when the verb is followed by a झलादि कित् /ङित् प्रत्यय.
The nasal above the roots (i.e. अनुदात्त ending in a nasal and वन and तनादि) is optionally elided before the Absolutive affix ल्यप्।
Before the affix क्तिच् the above roots (वन and तनादि) neither drop their nasal nor lengthen their root-vowel.
The nasal of गम् is always elided before क्वि।
A stem ending in a nasal and followed by the affix विट् or वन् always substitutes for long आ for its nasal.

The long आ is substituted for the final of जन् , सन् and खन् before the consonant beginning Desiderative affix सन् and before any other affix beginning with a इल् consonant which has an indicatory क् or ङ्।
There is optionally the substitution of long आ for the finals of जन् , सन् and खन् before the affix beginning with य and marked with an indicatory क् or ङ्।
The long आ is optionally substituted for the final of तन् before the Passive characteristic यक्।
The long आ is optionally substituted for the final of सन् before the affix क्तिच् and there is also optional elision of the nasal.
From this up to युप्लुवोर्दीर्घश्छन्दसि [[6.4.68]], inclusive, is always to be supplied the words ' before an affix called आर्धधातुक -- आर्द्धधातुकं शेषः [[3.4.114]] etc.'
When followed by an आर्धधातुक प्रत्यय, रेफ and the उपधावर्ण of the the verb root gets the 'रम्' आगम.
The अ standing at the end of a अङ्ग (stem) is elided before an आर्धधातुक affix.
When a consonant precedes the final य in a verbal अङ्ग (stem) this य is also elided before an आर्धधातुक affix.
The elision of य of he Denominative अङ्ग (stem) (क्य) is optional when preceded by a consonant and followed by an आर्धधातुक affix.
The इ of the verbal अङ्ग (stem) formed with the affix णि is elided before an आर्धधातुक affix which does not take the augment इट् ।
The affix णि is elided before the affixes क्त and क्तवतु when these take the augment इट् ।
In a मन्त्र the word जनिता is formed irregularly by the elision of णि before the affix तृ with the augment इट् ।
शमिता is formed irregularly by the elision of णि before an इट् augmented affix when meaning a sacrificial act.
अय् is substituted for the इ of णि before the affixes 1. आम् 2. अन्त 3. आलु 4. आय्य 5. इत्नु and 6. इष्णु।
अय् is substituted for the इ of णि before the Absolutive affix ल्यप् when the vowel preceding the इ is light.
अय् is optionally substituted for the इ of णि before the Absolutive affix ल्यप् , after the verb आप्।
In यु and प्लु , long is substituted for उ in the छन्दस् (Vedas).
A long is substituted for the इ of क्षि before the Absolutive affix ल्यप्।
A long is substituted for the इ in क्षि before the Past Participle in क्त when it is not in the sense of the future Passive Participle in ण्यत्।

The long is optionally substituted for the इ in क्षि before the Past Participle in क्त when it is not in the sense of the future Passive Participle in ण्यत् when the word means 'imprecation' or 'a miserable plight'.

items.sanskrit_text: स्यसिच्सीयुट्तासिषु भावकर्मणोर्- उपदेशेऽज्झनग्रहदृशां वा चिण्वदिट् च
items.english: Before the affixes 1. स्य (First future and Conditional) 2. सिच् (S-Aorist) 3. सीयुद् (Benedictive) and 4. तासि (Periphrastic Future), when they are used in the भाव (Impersonal) and कर्म (Passive) voices 1. the verbal stems ending in a vowel in the Grammatical system of instruction (उपदेश), as well as the verbs 2. हन् 'to kill' 3. ग्रह् 'to seize' and 4. दृश् 'to see' are treated optionally in the same way as in the 3rd Person of the Passive Aorist in चिण् and when so treated, they have the augment इट् ।
युट् is the augment of दीङ् of an आर्धधातुक affix beginning with a vowel and having an indicatory क् or ङ्।
The final आ of a root is elided before an आर्धधातुक affix with the augment इट् as well as when it begins with a vowel and has an indicatory क् or ङ्।
The final आ of a अङ्ग (stem) is changed into ई before the कृत् affix यत्।

For the final of the roots of the form of दा and घा (घु), as well as for that of the roots 1. मा 2. स्था 3. गा 4. पा 5. हा (जुहाति) and 6. सा (सो), there is substituted ई before an आर्धधातुक affix beginning with a consonant which has an indicatory क् or ङ्।
ए is substituted for the आ of the above roots (1. मा 2. स्था 3. गा 4. पा 5. हा (जुहाति) and 6. सा (सो)) in the Benedictive Mood Active.

For the final आ of any other root than those mentioned in घुमास्थागापाजहातिसां हलि [[6.4.66]], ए may optionally be substituted in the Benedictive active, when the root begins with a conjunct consonant.
The ई substitution for आ under sūtra घुमास्थागापाजहातिसां हलि [[6.4.66]] does not apply when the absolutive affix ल्यप् follows 1. मा 2. स्था 3. गा 4. पा 5. हा (जुहाति) 6. सा and 7. घु।
इ may optionally be substituted for the आ of मा (मयति) before ल्यप् ।
In case of the लुङ्लकार, लङ्लकार and लृङ्लकार, the अङ्ग gets an 'अट्' आगम,  which is also उदात्त.
For the लुङ्लकार, लङ्लकार and लृङ्लकार, an अजादि अङ्ग gets an आट्-आगम, which is also उदात्त.

items.anvaya: छन्दसि लुङ्लङ्लृङ्क्षु अङ्गस्य उदात्तः आडागमः अपि
items.english: In वेदाः , even the verbs that are not अजादि can be seen to get आट्-आगम for लुङ्लकार, लङ्लकार, and लृङ्लकार.

items.anvaya: लुङ्-लङ्-लृङ्क्षु माङ् योगे अङ्गस्य अट् आट्  न
items.english: In presence of the अव्यय माङ्, the अडागमः / आडागमः does not happen even in case of लुङ्लकार, लङ्लकार, and लृङ्लकार
In वेदाः, the अडागम आडागम may or may not be seen done in presence of माङ्.
रे is diversely substituted for इरे in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

items.anvaya: अचि श्नु-धातु-भ्रुवाम् य्वोः अङ्गस्य इयङ् उवङौ
items.english: When followed by an अजादि प्रत्यय,  the ending इवर्ण and the उवर्ण are converted respectively to इयङ् / उवङ् आदेशs for  a) विकरणप्रत्यय श्नु,  b) Any धातु, and  c) The word भ्रू.
An  इवर्ण and an उवर्ण occurring at end of an अभ्यास respectively get इयङ् and उवङ् आदेश when followed by an असवर्ण  letter.
The word 'स्त्री' gets an इयङ्-आदेश when followed by an अजादि प्रत्यय.
The word 'स्त्री' gets an इयङ्-आदेश optionally when followed by अम् प्रत्यय or शस् प्रत्यय.
The verb root इण् gets a यणादेश when followed by an अच् letter.

items.anvaya: अनेकाचः अङ्गस्य असंयोगपूर्वस्य एः धातोः अचि यण्
items.english: An इवर्ण occurring at end of an a असंयोगपूर्व धातु which in turn occurs at end of an अनेकाच् अङ्ग is converted to यण् letter when followed by an अजादिप्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: अनेकाचः अङ्गस्य असंयोगपूर्वस्य ओः धातोः सुपि अचि यण्
items.english: An उवर्ण occurring at end of an a असंयोगपूर्व धातु which in turn occurs at end of an अनेकाच् अङ्ग is converted to यण् letter when followed by a सुप् अजादिप्रत्यय.
The word वर्षाभू gets a यणादेश when followed by an अजादि-सुप्-प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: भूसुधियोः अङ्गस्य सुपि अचि यण् न
items.english: The words भू and सुधी do not undergo यणादेश when followed by अजादि सुप् प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: छन्दसि भूसुधियोः अङ्गस्य सुपि अचि यण् , न - उभयथा ।
items.english: In वेदाः, the words भू and सुधी might or might not undergo a यणादेश when followed by an अजादि सुप् प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: अनेकाचः अङ्गस्य हुश्नुवोः असंयोगपूर्वस्य ओः अचि सार्वधातुके यण्
items.english: The उवर्ण of an अनेकाच्-अङ्ग of 'हु' तथा 'श्नु' undergoes a यणादेश, provided that this उवर्ण does not follow a संयोग.
The verb root 'भू' gets a वुक् आगम when followed by an अजादि-प्रत्यय of लुङ्लकार or लिट्लकार.
When the उपधा of verb root गुह् has a chance of undergoing a गुणादेश while followed by an अजादिप्रत्यय, the गुणादेश is blocked and the उपधा becomes दीर्घ instead.
The उपधा letter of the verb root  दुष् is converted to ऊकार when followed by the णिच् प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: चित्तविरागे दोषः उपधायाः णौ ऊत् वा
items.english: To indicate impurification of mind / intellect, the उपधा letter of the verb root दुष् is optionally converted to ऊकार when followed by the णिच् प्रत्यय.
The उपधा letter of a मित्संज्ञक अङ्ग becomes ह्रस्व when followed by the णिच् प्रत्यय.
Optionally a long may be substituted for the penultimate of the causative of मित् roots, before the third person of the Passive Aorist in चिण् (इ) and before the Absolutive affix णमुल् (अम्).
The penultimate of the Causative अङ्ग (stem) is shortened before the affix खच्।
The penultimate of the Causative of ह्लद् (ह्लादि) is shortened before the Participle affixes क्त and क्तवतु।
The penultimate of चुरादि (10th Conjugation) - छद् is shortened before the affix घ -- पुंसि संज्ञायां घः प्रायेण [[3.3.118]], when not preceded by two prepositions (or more).
The penultimate of छादि is shortened before the affixes 1. इस् 2. मन् 3. त्रन् and 4. क्वि।
The उपधा letter of the verb roots गम्, हन्, जन्, खन्, घस् is removed when followed by a कित् / ङित् प्रत्यय, except for the अङ् प्रत्यय.
In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the root-vowel of तन् and पत् is elided before an affix beginning with a vowel, when it has an indicatory क् or ङ् ।
The root-vowel of घस् and भस् is elided in the छन्दस् (Vedas) before any affix whether beginning with a vowel or a consonant which has an indicatory क् or ङ् ।
The 'हि' प्रत्यय that follows the verb root 'हु' or a झल् letter is converted to 'धि'.
धि is substituted for the Imperative affix हि in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after 1. श्रु 2. शृणु 3. पॄ 4. कृ and 5. वृ।
धि is substituted for the Imperative affix हि when the tense-affix is not ङित्।
The तिङ् प्रत्यय that follows the चिण् विकरणप्रत्यय undergoes a लुक्.
The 'हि' प्रत्यय that follows an अदन्त अङ्ग is removed.

The 'हि' प्रत्यय that follows an उकार is deleted, provided -
a) The उकार occurs at end of a प्रत्यय, and
b) A संयोग is not present immediately before this उकार.

items.anvaya: अस्य असंयोगपूर्वस्य उतः प्रत्ययस्य म्वोः अन्यतरस्याम् लोपः
items.english: The उकार which occurs at end of a प्रत्यय is optionally deleted when followed by a मकार / वकार , provided that a संयोग is not present immediately before this उकार.

items.anvaya: करोतेः अङ्गस्य उतः प्रत्ययस्य म्वोः नित्यं लोपः
items.english: The उकार occurring at end of a प्रत्यय that is attached to the verb root  कृ is removed when followed by a मकार or a वकार.

items.anvaya: करोतेः अङ्गस्य उतः प्रत्ययस्य ये नित्यं लोपः
items.english: The उकार occurring at end of a प्रत्यय that is attached to the verb root कृ is removed when followed by a यकार.

items.anvaya: उतः प्रत्ययस्य करोतेः अङ्गस्य अतः सार्वधातुके क्ङिति उत्
items.english: If an अङ्ग of verb root कृ ends in an उकारान्त प्रत्यय, then the अकार of that अङ्ग is converted to उकार when followed by a कित् / ङित् प्रत्यय.
The अकार of the 'श्नम्' विकरण and of  the verb root 'अस्' is removed when followed by a सार्वधातुक किति / ङित् प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: श्ना-अभ्यस्तयोः अङ्गस्य आतः सार्वधातुके क्ङिति लोपः
items.english: The आकार of the विकरण श्ना and also of an अभ्यस्त is removed when followed by a सार्वधातुक कित् and ङित् प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: श्ना-अभ्यस्तयोः आतः हलि सार्वधातुके क्ङिति ई, अघोः
items.english: The आकार of the विकरण श्ना and also of an अभ्यस्त is converted to ई when followed by a हलादि सार्वधातुक कित् and ङित् प्रत्यय. But this does not happen for the verb roots that get the term 'घु'.

items.anvaya: दरिद्रस्य आतः हलि सार्वधातुके क्ङिति इत्
items.english: The आकार of the verb root 'दरिद्रा' is converted to ह्रस्व-इकार when followed by हलादि-सार्वधातुक कित्/ङित्-प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: भियः अङ्गस्य हलि सार्वधातुके क्ङिति इत् अन्यतरस्याम्
items.english: The last letter of the अङ्ग of verb root 'भी' is optionally converted to ह्रस्व-इकार when followed by हलादि-सार्वधातुक कित्/ङित्-प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: जहातेः अङ्गस्य हलि सार्वधातुके क्ङिति इत् अन्यतरस्याम्
items.english: The verb root 'हा' is converted to ह्रस्व-इकार when followed by हलादि-सार्वधातुक कित्/ङित्-प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: जहातेः अङ्गस्य आ, इत् अन्यतरस्याम् हौ
items.english: The verb root 'हा' gets an optional इकारादेश or an आकारादेश when followed by the प्रत्यय 'हि'.

items.anvaya: जहातेः अङ्गस्य सार्वधातुके क्ङिति यि लोपः
items.english: The last letter of हा is removed when followed by a यकारादि प्रत्यय.
The घु-संज्ञक verb roots and the verb root अस् get an एकार as आदेश when followed by the 'हि' प्रत्यय. Also, अभ्यास, if present, is removed.

items.anvaya: एकहल्मध्ये अनादेशादेः अङ्गस्य अतः एत् किति लिटि, अभ्यासलोपः च ।
items.english: When followed by a कित्-प्रत्यय of लिट्-लकार, The अकारः of an अङ्गम् is converted to एकार, and the अभ्यास is removed; provided that there is no संयोग before as well as after this अकार, and that the first letter of the अङ्गम् is not changed due to any आदेश.

ए is substituted for अ of a verbal अङ्ग (stem) standing between two simple consonants, the अङ्ग (stem) not having any different letter substituted in the reduplicate when the ending थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having the augment इट् follows and thereby the reduplicate is elided.

ए is substituted for अ of 1. तॄ 2. फल 3. भज and 4. त्रप and the reduplicate is elided when the affixes of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having an indicatory क् (or ङ्) follow, as well as when थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having the augment इट् follows.
ए is substituted for आ of राध when meaning 'to hurt someone' and the reduplicate is elided before the affixes क् (or ङ्) or as well as before थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having the augment इट्।

ए is optionally substituted for अ of the अङ्ग (stems) 1. जर् (जॄ) 2. भ्रम and 3. त्रस् and the reduplicate is thereby elided before the affixes of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having an indicatory क् (or ङ्)

ए is optionally substituted for अ and आ of the seven roots 1. फण् 2. राज् 3. भ्राज् 4. भ्राश् 5. श्लाश् 6. स्याम् and 7. स्वन् and the reduplicate is elided thereby, before the affixes of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having an indicatory क् (or ङ्) as well as before थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) having the augment इट्।

ए is not substituted for अ of शस् , दद् or of roots beginning with a व् or of such verbal अङ्ग (stems) in which the अ results through the substitution being कित् or ङित् follow, of the सेट् थल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) nor is the reduplicate elided.

तृ (which is changed to न्त् in the strong cases and forms the feminine in ई unaccented) is substituted for the final of the अङ्ग (stem) अर्वन् , except in the Nominative 1st-Case singular or when the word is joined with the Negative particle.
तृ is diversely substituted for the final of मघवन्।
All the rules starting from this sutra, till the end of the sixth chapter are being told for a भसंज्ञक.
The भसंज्ञक अङ्ग of the word पाद् gets पद् as आदेश.
A भसंज्ञक अङ्ग ending in a वसुँ प्रत्यय undergoes सम्प्रसारणम्.
भसंज्ञक वाह् is converted to 'ऊठ्' by सम्प्रसारणम्.
The भसंज्ञक अङ्ग of  श्वन् , युवन् and मघवन् undergoes सम्प्रसारणम् when followed by a प्रत्यय which is not a तद्धितप्रत्यय.
If a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग ends in the word 'अन्' then the 'अ' of this 'अन्' is omitted.
The उपधा-अकार of a भसंज्ञकस्य अङ्ग is omitted in presence of an अण्-प्रत्यय, if the अङ्ग ends in one of (1) षन्, (2) हन् or (3) धृतराजन् .

items.anvaya: अनः भस्य अङ्गस्य अत् ङिश्योः विभाषा लोपः
items.english: If a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग end in the word 'अन्' and is followed by the ङि or शी प्रत्यय, then the 'अ' of this 'अन्' is omitted optionally.

items.anvaya: वमन्तात् संयोगात् अनः भस्य अङ्गस्य अत्-लोपः न
items.english: For a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग which ends in an 'अन्', and also contains a  मकारान्त / वकारान्त संयोगवर्ण before this अन्, the 'अ' of अन् does not get omitted.
The अकार of the word अच् that occurs at end of a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग is omitted if this 'अच्' happens to be derived from the धातु अञ्च् (गतौ).

If the word अच् -
(1) happens to be derived from the धातु अञ्च् (गतौ) ,
(2) follows the word उद्,  and
(3) gets the भसंज्ञा, 
 then the अकार of अच् is converted to ईकार.
The ending आकार of the भसंज्ञक अङ्ग of an आकारान्त धातु is removed.
In the मन्त्र-s , the beginning of आत्मन् is elided when the affix of the Instrumental -3rd case singular follows.
The 'ति' of the भसंज्ञक 'विंशति' word is removed.
The 'टि'component of a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग is removed when followed by a डित् प्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: नः भस्य अङ्गस्य टेः तद्धिते लोपः
items.english: The टिसंज्ञक of a  नकारान्त भसंज्ञक अङ्ग is removed when followed by a तद्धितप्रत्यय.
The अ of अहन् is elided only before the affixes ट and ख।
An उवर्णान्त भसंज्ञक undergoes a गुणादेश when followed by a तद्धितप्रत्यय.

items.anvaya: ओः भस्य अङ्गस्य ढे तद्धिते लोपः अकद्र्वाः
items.english: The last letter of an उवर्णान्त-भसंज्ञक word is removed when followed by a ढकारादि-तद्धितप्रत्यय. But this does not happen for the word 'कद्रू'.

items.anvaya: भस्य अङ्गस्य यस्य तद्धिते ईति च लोपः
items.english: The अकार and इकार of a भसंज्ञक अङ्ग is removed when followed by a तद्धितप्रत्यय or an ईकार.
Of the भ अङ्ग (stems) 1. सूर्य 2. तिष्य 3. अगस्त्य and 4. मत्स्य (and their derivatives when they are भ) the penultimate य् is also is also elided before a तद्धित affix.
The य् of a तद्धित affix when preceded by a consonant and penultimate in a अङ्ग (stem), is elided before the feminine ई।
The य् of a Patronymic affix, preceded by a consonant, is elided before a तद्धित when it does not begin with an आ।
The य् of a Patronymic affix, preceded by a consonant, is elided before the Denominative affix क्य and the adverbial affix च्वि।
The affix छ of the भ अङ्ग (stems) बिल्वक etc. is elided before a तद्धित affix.
The affix तृ is elided before the affixes 1. इष्ठन् 2. इमनिव् and 3. ईयसुन्।
